title: RARE disease detection from Capsule Endoscopic Videos based on Vision Transformers
summary: This work is corresponding to the Gastro Competition for multi-label classification from capsule endoscopic videos (CEV). Deep learning network based on Transformers are fined-tune for this task. The based online mode is Google Vision Transformer (ViT) batch16 with 224 x 224 resolutions. In total, 17 labels are classified, which are mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, colon, z-line, pylorus, ileocecal valve, active bleeding, angiectasia, blood, erosion, erythema, hematin, lymphangioectasis, polyp, and ulcer. For test dataset of three videos, the overall mAP @0.5 is 0.0205 whereas the overall mAP @0.95 is 0.0196.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对胶囊内窥镜视频多标签分类任务，使用基于Transformer的深度学习网络进行微调，在17个胃肠道相关标签上取得了约0.02的mAP性能。
AI.motivation: 解决胶囊内窥镜视频中多标签分类的挑战，实现对胃肠道17个关键解剖结构和病理特征的自动识别，提高内窥镜视频分析的效率和准确性。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的深度学习网络，具体使用Google Vision Transformer (ViT) batch16模型，输入分辨率为224×224，在胶囊内窥镜视频数据集上进行微调，用于17个标签的多标签分类。
AI.result: 在包含三个视频的测试集上，整体mAP@0.5为0.0205，整体mAP@0.95为0.0196，表明模型在胶囊内窥镜视频多标签分类任务上具有初步识别能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer的深度学习网络可以应用于胶囊内窥镜视频的多标签分类任务，虽然当前性能仍有提升空间，但为胃肠道自动分析提供了可行的技术方案。

title: S3T-Former: A Purely Spike-Driven State-Space Topology Transformer for Skeleton Action Recognition
summary: Skeleton-based action recognition is crucial for multimedia applications but heavily relies on power-hungry Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), limiting their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) provide an energy-efficient alternative; however, existing spiking models for skeleton data often compromise the intrinsic sparsity of SNNs by resorting to dense matrix aggregations, heavy multimodal fusion modules, or non-sparse frequency domain transformations. Furthermore, they severely suffer from the short-term amnesia of spiking neurons. In this paper, we propose the Spiking State-Space Topology Transformer (S3T-Former), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first purely spike-driven Transformer architecture specifically designed for energy-efficient skeleton action recognition. Rather than relying on heavy fusion overhead, we formulate a Multi-Stream Anatomical Spiking Embedding (M-ASE) that acts as a generalized kinematic differential operator, elegantly transforming multimodal skeleton features into heterogeneous, highly sparse event streams. To achieve true topological and temporal sparsity, we introduce Lateral Spiking Topology Routing (LSTR) for on-demand conditional spike propagation, and a Spiking State-Space (S3) Engine to systematically capture long-range temporal dynamics without non-sparse spectral workarounds. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale datasets demonstrate that S3T-Former achieves highly competitive accuracy while theoretically reducing energy consumption compared to classic ANNs, establishing a new state-of-the-art for energy-efficient neuromorphic action recognition.

AI.tldr: S3T-Former：首个纯脉冲驱动的Transformer架构，用于能效优化的骨架动作识别，通过多流解剖脉冲嵌入和横向脉冲拓扑路由实现高稀疏性，解决了传统脉冲神经网络在骨架数据上的短期记忆问题。
AI.motivation: 基于骨架的动作识别对多媒体应用至关重要，但传统人工神经网络能耗高，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。脉冲神经网络虽然能效高，但现有模型在处理骨架数据时破坏了SNN的固有稀疏性，且存在短期记忆问题。
AI.method: 提出S3T-Former架构：1）多流解剖脉冲嵌入（M-ASE）作为广义运动学微分算子，将多模态骨架特征转换为异构高稀疏事件流；2）横向脉冲拓扑路由（LSTR）实现按需条件脉冲传播；3）脉冲状态空间（S3）引擎系统捕获长程时序动态，无需非稀疏频谱处理。
AI.result: 在多个大规模数据集上的实验表明，S3T-Former在保持高竞争力的准确率的同时，理论上比经典ANN显著降低能耗，为能效神经形态动作识别建立了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: S3T-Former是首个专门为能效骨架动作识别设计的纯脉冲驱动Transformer架构，通过创新的稀疏事件流处理和长程时序建模，在保持高性能的同时大幅降低能耗，为边缘设备部署提供了可行方案。

title: SSP-SAM: SAM with Semantic-Spatial Prompt for Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) excels at general image segmentation but has limited ability to understand natural language, which restricts its direct application in Referring Expression Segmentation (RES). Toward this end, we propose SSP-SAM, a framework that fully utilizes SAM's segmentation capabilities by integrating a Semantic-Spatial Prompt (SSP) encoder. Specifically, we incorporate both visual and linguistic attention adapters into the SSP encoder, which highlight salient objects within the visual features and discriminative phrases within the linguistic features. This design enhances the referent representation for the prompt generator, resulting in high-quality SSPs that enable SAM to generate precise masks guided by language. Although not specifically designed for Generalized RES (GRES), where the referent may correspond to zero, one, or multiple objects, SSP-SAM naturally supports this more flexible setting without additional modifications. Extensive experiments on widely used RES and GRES benchmarks confirm the superiority of our method. Notably, our approach generates segmentation masks of high quality, achieving strong precision even at strict thresholds such as Pr@0.9. Further evaluation on the PhraseCut dataset demonstrates improved performance in open-vocabulary scenarios compared to existing state-of-the-art RES methods. The code and checkpoints are available at: https://github.com/WayneTomas/SSP-SAM.

AI.tldr: SSP-SAM是一个增强SAM模型语言理解能力的框架，通过语义-空间提示编码器整合视觉和语言注意力适配器，使SAM能够基于语言描述进行精确分割，并自然支持广义参照表达分割任务。
AI.motivation: SAM模型在通用图像分割方面表现出色，但对自然语言的理解能力有限，这限制了其在参照表达分割任务中的直接应用。需要增强SAM的语言理解能力，使其能够根据语言描述进行精确分割。
AI.method: 提出SSP-SAM框架，包含语义-空间提示编码器，该编码器整合了视觉和语言注意力适配器。视觉注意力适配器突出视觉特征中的显著对象，语言注意力适配器突出语言特征中的区分性短语，从而增强参照物表示，生成高质量提示来指导SAM生成精确掩码。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的RES和GRES基准测试中表现出优越性，生成高质量分割掩码，即使在Pr@0.9等严格阈值下也能保持强精度。在PhraseCut数据集上的进一步评估显示，在开放词汇场景中相比现有最先进RES方法有改进。
AI.conclusion: SSP-SAM框架成功增强了SAM的语言理解能力，使其能够基于语言描述进行精确分割，并自然支持广义参照表达分割任务，无需额外修改。该方法在多个基准测试中表现出色，为SAM在语言引导分割任务中的应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Do Large Language Models Possess a Theory of Mind? A Comparative Evaluation Using the Strange Stories Paradigm
summary: The study explores whether current Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities -- specifically, the ability to infer others' beliefs, intentions, and emotions from text. Given that LLMs are trained on language data without social embodiment or access to other manifestations of mental representations, their apparent social-cognitive reasoning raises key questions about the nature of their understanding. Are they capable of robust mental-state attribution indistinguishable from human ability in its output, or do their outputs merely reflect superficial pattern completion? To address this question, we tested five LLMs and compared their performance to that of human controls using an adapted version of a text-based tool widely used in human ToM research. The test involves answering questions about the beliefs, intentions, and emotions of story characters. The results revealed a performance gap between the models. Earlier and smaller models were strongly affected by the number of relevant inferential cues available and, to some extent, were also vulnerable to the presence of irrelevant or distracting information in the texts. In contrast, GPT-4o demonstrated high accuracy and strong robustness, performing comparably to humans even in the most challenging conditions. This work contributes to ongoing debates about the cognitive status of LLMs and the boundary between genuine understanding and statistical approximation.

AI.tldr: GPT-4o在心理理论测试中表现接近人类水平，而早期小模型表现较差，存在理解与模式匹配的争议
AI.motivation: 探究当前大语言模型是否真正具备心理理论能力——即从文本中推断他人信念、意图和情感的能力，区分模型是真正理解还是仅仅进行表面模式匹配
AI.method: 测试五个LLM并与人类对照组比较，使用人类心理理论研究中的文本工具改编版，通过回答故事角色信念、意图和情感相关问题来评估
AI.result: 早期小模型表现受相关推理线索数量影响，也易受无关信息干扰；GPT-4o表现出高准确性和强鲁棒性，在最挑战条件下表现与人类相当
AI.conclusion: GPT-4o在心理理论任务中表现接近人类，但模型间存在显著差异，这为LLM认知状态和真正理解与统计近似之间的界限提供了实证证据

title: Continually self-improving AI
summary: Modern language model-based AI systems are remarkably powerful, yet their capabilities remain fundamentally capped by their human creators in three key ways. First, although a model's weights can be updated via fine-tuning, acquiring new knowledge from small, specialized corpora after pretraining remains highly data-inefficient. Second, the training of these systems relies heavily on finite, human-generated data from across history. Third, the pipelines used to train AI models are confined by the algorithms that human researchers can discover and explore. This thesis takes a small step toward overcoming these inherent limitations, presenting three chapters aimed at breaking these dependencies to create continually self-improving AI. First, to overcome this data-efficiency barrier in knowledge acquisition, we propose a synthetic data approach that diversifies and amplifies small corpora into rich knowledge representations, enabling a model to effectively update its parameters from limited source material. Second, to reduce reliance on human data, we show that given a fixed amount of such data, the model can self-generate synthetic data to bootstrap its fundamental pretraining capabilities without distillation from any off-the-shelf, instruction-tuned LM. Finally, to transcend human-engineered training paradigms, we demonstrate that by scaling search during test time over the space of algorithms, AI can search over a larger space of learning algorithm configurations than human researchers can explore manually.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出三种方法突破语言模型对人类创造者的依赖：1) 使用合成数据增强小规模专业知识库，提高知识获取效率；2) 利用有限人类数据自生成合成数据进行预训练；3) 通过测试时算法搜索超越人工设计的训练范式，实现AI的持续自我改进。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型AI系统存在三个根本限制：1) 从小规模专业语料获取新知识的数据效率低下；2) 训练依赖有限的人类历史数据；3) 训练流程受限于人类研究者发现的算法。这些限制导致AI能力被人类创造者所限制。
AI.method: 提出三种方法：1) 合成数据方法，将小规模语料多样化和放大为丰富的知识表示；2) 自生成合成数据方法，利用有限人类数据进行预训练，无需从现成指令调优模型中蒸馏；3) 测试时算法搜索方法，在算法空间中进行规模化搜索，探索比人工设计更广泛的算法配置。
AI.result: 通过这三种方法，论文展示了如何突破语言模型对人类创造者的依赖，使AI能够更高效地获取新知识、减少对人类数据的依赖，并超越人工设计的训练范式，为实现持续自我改进的AI系统迈出了一小步。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为实现持续自我改进的AI系统提供了重要思路，通过合成数据增强、自生成训练数据和算法空间搜索三种方法，有望突破当前语言模型对人类创造者的根本依赖，推动AI向更自主、更高效的学习系统发展。

title: Action Draft and Verify: A Self-Verifying Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently demonstrated strong performance across embodied tasks. Modern VLAs commonly employ diffusion action experts to efficiently generate high-precision continuous action chunks, while auto-regressive generation can be slower and less accurate at low-level control. Yet auto-regressive paradigms still provide complementary priors that can improve robustness and generalization in out-of-distribution environments. To leverage both paradigms, we propose Action-Draft-and-Verify (ADV): diffusion action expert drafts multiple candidate action chunks, and the VLM selects one by scoring all candidates in a single forward pass with a perplexity-style metric. Under matched backbones, training data, and action-chunk length, ADV improves success rate by +4.3 points in simulation and +19.7 points in real-world over diffusion-based baseline, with a single-pass VLM reranking overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出Action-Draft-and-Verify方法，结合扩散模型和自回归模型的优势，通过扩散模型生成候选动作块，VLM单次前向传播评分选择，提升机器人任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型中，扩散动作专家能高效生成高精度连续动作块，但自回归生成在分布外环境中具有更好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。需要结合两种范式的优势来提升性能。
AI.method: 提出ADV框架：1）扩散动作专家生成多个候选动作块；2）VLM使用困惑度风格指标对所有候选进行单次前向传播评分；3）选择得分最高的动作块执行。
AI.result: 在相同骨干网络、训练数据和动作块长度下，ADV相比纯扩散基线：仿真环境成功率提升4.3个百分点，真实世界提升19.7个百分点，仅增加单次VLM重排开销。
AI.conclusion: ADV方法有效结合了扩散模型的高效精确性和自回归模型的鲁棒性先验，显著提升了VLA模型在具身任务中的性能，特别是在分布外环境中。

title: How Confident Is the First Token? An Uncertainty-Calibrated Prompt Optimization Framework for Large Language Model Classification and Understanding
summary: With the widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs) in natural language processing, prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) have become mainstream to enhance LLMs' performance on complex tasks. However, LLMs generate outputs autoregressively, leading to inevitable output uncertainty. Since model performance is highly sensitive to prompt design, precise uncertainty measurement is crucial for reliable prompt optimization. For multi-class multiple-choice (understanding) tasks, conventional uncertainty measures (e.g., entropy) based on output probabilities treat all classes equally and ignore class prior differences in pretraining corpora. This failure to distinguish spurious confidence (from priors) from true certainty (from contextual understanding) results in poor confidence calibration. To address this, we propose Log-Scale Focal Uncertainty (LSFU), a first-token-based metric inspired by focal loss. LSFU incorporates label prior probabilities as a risk-modulation factor to suppress noise from high-frequency classes and emphasize risk for low-frequency long-tail classes, with a dynamic weighting mechanism unifying the measurement scale. Based on LSFU, we further propose the uncertainty-calibrated prompt optimization framework (UCPOF), which leverages the first token of model outputs to select high-quality exemplars and dynamically optimize prompts. Comprehensive evaluations show UCPOF improves average accuracy by 6.03% over few-shot baselines, surpasses always-on full RAG by 5.75% in overall average accuracy, and reduces the average retrieval trigger rate by 50.66%. By adaptively triggering RAG only for high-uncertainty samples, our framework significantly lowers computational costs while maintaining state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LSFU（对数尺度焦点不确定性）指标和UCPOF（不确定性校准提示优化框架），通过第一令牌不确定性测量和自适应RAG触发，提升LLM在复杂任务上的性能与效率。
AI.motivation: LLM自回归生成导致输出不确定性，传统基于输出概率的不确定性度量（如熵）在多类选择题任务中无法区分伪置信度（来自先验）和真实确定性（来自上下文理解），导致置信度校准不佳，需要更精确的不确定性测量方法。
AI.method: 提出LSFU指标，基于焦点损失思想，引入标签先验概率作为风险调制因子，抑制高频类噪声并强调低频长尾类风险；基于LSFU构建UCPOF框架，利用模型输出的第一令牌选择高质量示例并动态优化提示，自适应触发RAG。
AI.result: UCPOF相比少样本基线平均准确率提升6.03%，比始终开启的完整RAG整体平均准确率高出5.75%，同时平均检索触发率降低50.66%，显著降低计算成本并保持最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: LSFU能有效区分伪置信度和真实确定性，UCPOF框架通过自适应RAG触发在保持高性能的同时显著降低计算开销，为LLM不确定性测量和提示优化提供了有效解决方案。

title: One-to-More: High-Fidelity Training-Free Anomaly Generation with Attention Control
summary: Industrial anomaly detection (AD) is characterized by an abundance of normal images but a scarcity of anomalous ones. Although numerous few-shot anomaly synthesis methods have been proposed to augment anomalous data for downstream AD tasks, most existing approaches require time-consuming training and struggle to learn distributions that are faithful to real anomalies, thereby restricting the efficacy of AD models trained on such data. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free few-shot anomaly generation method, namely O2MAG, which leverages the self-attention in One reference anomalous image to synthesize More realistic anomalies, supporting effective downstream anomaly detection. Specifically, O2MAG manipulates three parallel diffusion processes via self-attention grafting and incorporates the anomaly mask to mitigate foreground-background query confusion, synthesizing text-guided anomalies that closely adhere to real anomalous distributions. To bridge the semantic gap between the encoded anomaly text prompts and the true anomaly semantics, Anomaly-Guided Optimization is further introduced to align the synthesis process with the target anomalous distribution, steering the generation toward realistic and text-consistent anomalies. Moreover, to mitigate faint anomaly synthesis inside anomaly masks, Dual-Attention Enhancement is adopted during generation to reinforce both self- and cross-attention on masked regions. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of O2MAG, demonstrating its superior performance over prior state-of-the-art methods on downstream AD tasks.

AI.tldr: O2MAG是一种无需训练的少样本异常生成方法，通过自注意力嫁接和异常掩码，利用单个参考异常图像合成更多真实异常，提升下游异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测面临正常图像丰富但异常样本稀缺的问题。现有少样本异常合成方法通常需要耗时训练，且难以学习真实异常分布，限制了异常检测模型的性能。
AI.method: 提出O2MAG方法：1) 通过自注意力嫁接操作三个并行扩散过程，结合异常掩码减少前景-背景查询混淆；2) 引入异常引导优化，对齐合成过程与目标异常分布；3) 采用双重注意力增强，强化掩码区域的自注意力和交叉注意力。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了O2MAG的有效性，在下游异常检测任务上表现出优于现有最先进方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: O2MAG是一种无需训练的少样本异常生成方法，能够合成真实且与文本一致的异常，有效提升异常检测性能，解决了现有方法训练耗时且难以学习真实异常分布的问题。

title: Agentic Framework for Political Biography Extraction
summary: The production of large-scale political datasets typically demands extracting structured facts from vast piles of unstructured documents or web sources, a task that traditionally relies on expensive human experts and remains prohibitively difficult to automate at scale. In this paper, we leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate the extraction of multi-dimensional elite biographies, addressing a long-standing bottleneck in political science research. We propose a two-stage ``Synthesis-Coding'' framework for complex extraction task: an upstream synthesis stage that uses recursive agentic LLMs to search, filter, and curate biography from heterogeneous web sources, followed by a downstream coding stage that maps curated biography into structured dataframes. We validate this framework through three primary results. First, we demonstrate that, when given curated contexts, LLM coders match or outperform human experts in extraction accuracy. Second, we show that in web environments, the agentic system synthesizes more information from web resources than human collective intelligence (Wikipedia). Finally, we diagnosed that directly coding from long and multi-language corpora introduces bias that the synthesis stage can alleviate by curating evidence into signal-dense representations. By comprehensive evaluation, We provide a generalizable, scalable framework for building transparent and expansible large scale database in political science.

AI.tldr: 利用大语言模型自动化提取多维精英传记，解决政治科学研究中长期存在的瓶颈问题
AI.motivation: 大规模政治数据集的构建通常需要从海量非结构化文档或网络资源中提取结构化事实，这一任务传统上依赖昂贵的人类专家，难以实现规模化自动化
AI.method: 提出两阶段"Synthesis-Coding"框架：上游合成阶段使用递归代理式LLM从异构网络资源中搜索、筛选和整理传记；下游编码阶段将整理的传记映射为结构化数据框
AI.result: 1) 在给定整理上下文时，LLM编码器的提取准确率匹配或优于人类专家；2) 在网络环境中，代理系统从网络资源中合成的信息比人类集体智能（维基百科）更多；3) 直接从长文本和多语言语料库编码会引入偏差，而合成阶段通过将证据整理为信号密集表示可以缓解这种偏差
AI.conclusion: 提供了一个可推广、可扩展的框架，用于在政治科学中构建透明且可扩展的大规模数据库

title: Adaptive Domain Models: Bayesian Evolution, Warm Rotation, and Principled Training for Geometric and Neuromorphic AI
summary: Prevailing AI training infrastructure assumes reverse-mode automatic differentiation over IEEE-754 arithmetic. The memory overhead of training relative to inference, optimizer complexity, and structural degradation of geometric properties through training are consequences of this arithmetic substrate. This paper develops an alternative training architecture grounded in three prior results: the Dimensional Type System and Deterministic Memory Management framework [6], which establishes stack-eligible gradient allocation and exact quire accumulation as design-time verifiable properties; the Program Hypergraph [8], which establishes grade preservation through geometric algebra computations as a type-level invariant; and the b-posit 2026 standard [10], which makes posit arithmetic tractable across hardware targets conventionally considered inference-only. Their composition enables depth-independent training memory bounded to approximately twice the inference footprint, grade-preserving weight updates, and exact gradient accumulation, applicable uniformly to loss-function-optimized and spike-timing-dependent neuromorphic models. We introduce Bayesian distillation, a mechanism by which the latent prior structure of a general-purpose model is extracted through the ADM training regime, resolving the data-scarcity bootstrapping problem for domain-specific training. For deployment, we introduce warm rotation, an operational pattern in which an updated model transitions into an active inference pathway without service interruption, with structural correctness formalized through PHG certificates and signed version records. The result is a class of domain-specific AI systems that are smaller and more precise than general-purpose models, continuously adaptive, verifiably correct with respect to the physical structure of their domains, and initializable from existing models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于几何代数、确定性内存管理和posit算术的新型AI训练架构，实现深度无关的训练内存占用、保持几何特性的权重更新、精确梯度累积，并通过贝叶斯蒸馏和热旋转机制实现领域专用AI系统的持续自适应部署。
AI.motivation: 传统AI训练基础设施基于IEEE-754算术的反向自动微分存在内存开销大、优化器复杂、训练过程中几何特性退化等问题。本文旨在构建一种替代训练架构，解决这些根本性限制。
AI.method: 结合三个关键技术：1）维度类型系统和确定性内存管理框架，实现堆栈可分配的梯度和精确quire累积；2）程序超图，通过几何代数计算保持等级不变性；3）b-posit 2026标准，使posit算术在传统推理专用硬件上可行。提出贝叶斯蒸馏机制从通用模型中提取潜在先验结构，以及热旋转操作模式实现无服务中断的模型更新。
AI.result: 实现了深度无关的训练内存占用（约为推理内存的两倍）、保持几何特性的权重更新、精确梯度累积，适用于损失函数优化和脉冲时序依赖的神经形态模型。能够构建比通用模型更小更精确、持续自适应、可验证正确的领域专用AI系统。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合几何代数、确定性内存管理和posit算术，本文提出了一种新型AI训练架构，解决了传统训练方法的内存、几何特性和硬件兼容性问题，实现了可验证正确、持续自适应的领域专用AI系统，并能从现有模型初始化。

title: Q-Drift: Quantization-Aware Drift Correction for Diffusion Model Sampling
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a practical path to deploy large diffusion models, but quantization noise can accumulate over the denoising trajectory and degrade generation quality. We propose Q-Drift, a principled sampler-side correction that treats quantization error as an implicit stochastic perturbation on each denoising step and derives a marginal-distribution-preserving drift adjustment. Q-Drift estimates a timestep-wise variance statistic from calibration, in practice requiring as few as 5 paired full-precision/quantized calibration runs. The resulting sampler correction is plug-and-play with common samplers, diffusion models, and PTQ methods, while incurring negligible overhead at inference. Across six diverse text-to-image models (spanning DiT and U-Net), three samplers (Euler, flow-matching, DPM-Solver++), and two PTQ methods (SVDQuant, MixDQ), Q-Drift improves FID over the corresponding quantized baseline in most settings, with up to 4.59 FID reduction on PixArt-Sigma (SVDQuant W3A4), while preserving CLIP scores.

AI.tldr: Q-Drift是一种用于扩散模型后训练量化的采样器侧校正方法，通过将量化误差视为隐式随机扰动，推导出保持边缘分布的漂移调整，显著提升量化模型的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化（PTQ）是部署大型扩散模型的实用方法，但量化噪声会在去噪轨迹中累积并降低生成质量。需要一种有效的方法来校正量化误差对生成过程的影响。
AI.method: 提出Q-Drift方法，将量化误差视为每个去噪步骤的隐式随机扰动，推导出保持边缘分布的漂移调整。通过校准估计时间步方差统计量，仅需少量全精度/量化校准运行对。该方法可与常见采样器、扩散模型和PTQ方法即插即用。
AI.result: 在六个不同的文本到图像模型（包括DiT和U-Net）、三个采样器（Euler、flow-matching、DPM-Solver++）和两种PTQ方法（SVDQuant、MixDQ）上，Q-Drift在大多数设置中改善了FID，在PixArt-Sigma（SVDQuant W3A4）上实现了高达4.59的FID降低，同时保持了CLIP分数。
AI.conclusion: Q-Drift是一种有效且实用的后训练量化校正方法，能够显著提升量化扩散模型的生成质量，同时保持计算效率，为大规模扩散模型的部署提供了重要技术支持。

title: Controllable Evidence Selection in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering via Deterministic Utility Gating
summary:
Many modern AI question-answering systems convert text into vectors and retrieve the closest matches to a user question. While effective for topical similarity, similarity scores alone do not explain why some retrieved text can serve as evidence while other equally similar text cannot. When many candidates receive similar scores, systems may select sentences that are redundant, incomplete, or address different conditions than the question requires.
  This paper presents a deterministic evidence selection framework for retrieval-augmented question answering. The approach introduces Meaning-Utility Estimation (MUE) and Diversity-Utility Estimation (DUE), fixed scoring and redundancy-control procedures that determine evidence admissibility prior to answer generation. Each sentence or record is evaluated independently using explicit signals for semantic relatedness, term coverage, conceptual distinctiveness, and redundancy. No training or fine-tuning is required.
  In the prototype, a unit is accepted only if it explicitly states the fact, rule, or condition required by the task. Units are not merged or expanded. If no unit independently satisfies the requirement, the system returns no answer. This deterministic gating produces compact, auditable evidence sets and establishes a clear boundary between relevant text and usable evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种确定性证据选择框架，用于检索增强的问答系统，通过固定评分和冗余控制程序在答案生成前确定证据的可接受性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI问答系统基于向量相似度检索文本，但相似度分数无法解释为何某些检索到的文本可作为证据而其他同等相似的文本不能。当多个候选文本获得相似分数时，系统可能选择冗余、不完整或不符合问题条件的句子。
AI.method: 提出确定性证据选择框架，引入意义效用估计（MUE）和多样性效用估计（DUE）两种固定评分和冗余控制程序。每个句子或记录独立评估，使用语义相关性、术语覆盖、概念区分度和冗余度等明确信号。无需训练或微调。
AI.result: 在原型中，只有当单元明确陈述任务所需的事实、规则或条件时才被接受。单元不合并或扩展。如果没有单元独立满足要求，系统返回无答案。这种确定性门控产生紧凑、可审计的证据集。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在相关文本和可用证据之间建立了清晰边界，通过确定性门控确保只有明确满足要求的文本才被接受为证据，提高了证据选择的可解释性和可靠性。

title: Don't Vibe Code, Do Skele-Code: Interactive No-Code Notebooks for Subject Matter Experts to Build Lower-Cost Agentic Workflows
comment: Main paper 9 pages. Topics: Agentic Coding, HCI, LLMs, Workflows
summary: Skele-Code is a natural-language and graph-based interface for building workflows with AI agents, designed especially for less or non-technical users. It supports incremental, interactive notebook-style development, and each step is converted to code with a required set of functions and behavior to enable incremental building of workflows. Agents are invoked only for code generation and error recovery, not orchestration or task execution. This agent-supported, but code-first approach to workflows, along with the context-engineering used in Skele-Code, can help reduce token costs compared to the multi-agent system approach to executing workflows. Skele-Code produces modular, easily extensible, and shareable workflows. The generated workflows can also be used as skills by agents, or as steps in other workflows.

AI.tldr: Skele-Code是一个面向非技术用户的自然语言和图界面工作流构建工具，采用代码优先、代理辅助的方法，支持增量式笔记本风格开发，相比多代理系统能降低token成本。
AI.motivation: 为降低非技术用户构建AI工作流的门槛，同时解决多代理系统token成本高、工作流不易复用和扩展的问题。
AI.method: 提供自然语言和图界面，支持增量交互式开发，将每个步骤转换为代码，代理仅用于代码生成和错误恢复，采用代码优先、代理辅助的工作流构建方法。
AI.result: 生成模块化、易扩展、可共享的工作流，这些工作流可作为代理的技能或其他工作流的步骤，相比多代理系统能降低token成本。
AI.conclusion: Skele-Code通过代码优先、代理辅助的方法，为技术能力有限的用户提供了高效、低成本的工作流构建方案，实现了工作流的模块化和复用性。

title: Training-Only Heterogeneous Image-Patch-Text Graph Supervision for Advancing Few-Shot Learning Adapters
comment: Accepted at The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026
summary: Recent adapter-based CLIP tuning (e.g., Tip-Adapter) is a strong few-shot learner, achieving efficiency by caching support features for fast prototype matching. However, these methods rely on global uni-modal feature vectors, overlooking fine-grained patch relations and their structural alignment with class text. To bridge this gap without incurring inference costs, we introduce a novel asymmetric training-only framework. Instead of altering the lightweight adapter, we construct a high-capacity auxiliary Heterogeneous Graph Teacher that operates solely during training. This teacher (i) integrates multi-scale visual patches and text prompts into a unified graph, (ii) performs deep cross-modal reasoning via a Modality-aware Graph Transformer (MGT), and (iii) applies discriminative node filtering to extract high-fidelity class features. Crucially, we employ a cache-aware dual-objective strategy to supervise this relational knowledge directly into the Tip-Adapter's key-value cache, effectively upgrading the prototypes while the graph teacher is discarded at test time. Thus, inference remains identical to Tip-Adapter with zero extra latency or memory. Across standard 1-16-shot benchmarks, our method consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art. Ablations confirm that the auxiliary graph supervision, text-guided reasoning, and node filtering are the essential ingredients for robust few-shot adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/MR-Sherif/TOGA.git.

AI.tldr: 提出TOGA框架，通过训练时的异构图教师增强Tip-Adapter的缓存原型，实现零推理开销的细粒度跨模态对齐
AI.motivation: 现有基于适配器的CLIP调优方法（如Tip-Adapter）依赖全局单模态特征向量，忽略了细粒度图像块关系及其与类别文本的结构对齐
AI.method: 提出不对称训练框架：构建仅训练时使用的异构图教师，集成多尺度视觉块和文本提示到统一图中，通过模态感知图变换器进行跨模态推理，应用判别性节点过滤提取高保真类别特征，使用缓存感知双目标策略将关系知识监督到Tip-Adapter的键值缓存中
AI.result: 在标准1-16样本基准测试中持续建立新的最先进性能，推理时与Tip-Adapter完全相同，零额外延迟或内存开销
AI.conclusion: 辅助图监督、文本引导推理和节点过滤是鲁棒少样本适应的关键要素，提出的TOGA框架能有效提升原型质量而不增加推理成本

title: DynaRAG: Bridging Static and Dynamic Knowledge in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: We present DynaRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework designed to handle both static and time-sensitive information needs through dynamic knowledge integration. Unlike traditional RAG pipelines that rely solely on static corpora, DynaRAG selectively invokes external APIs when retrieved documents are insufficient for answering a query. The system employs an LLM-based reranker to assess document relevance, a sufficiency classifier to determine when fallback is necessary, and Gorilla v2 -- a state-of-the-art API calling model -- for accurate tool invocation. We further enhance robustness by incorporating schema filtering via FAISS to guide API selection. Evaluations on the CRAG benchmark demonstrate that DynaRAG significantly improves accuracy on dynamic questions, while also reducing hallucinations. Our results highlight the importance of dynamic-aware routing and selective tool use in building reliable, real-world question-answering systems.

AI.tldr: DynaRAG是一个动态知识整合的检索增强生成框架，通过选择性调用外部API来处理静态和时间敏感信息需求，相比传统RAG显著提升了动态问题的准确性并减少了幻觉。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG系统仅依赖静态语料库，无法有效处理时间敏感信息需求，当检索文档不足时无法提供准确答案，需要动态知识整合机制。
AI.method: 采用LLM重排序器评估文档相关性，使用充分性分类器判断是否需要回退调用外部API，通过Gorilla v2模型准确调用工具，并利用FAISS进行模式过滤指导API选择。
AI.result: 在CRAG基准测试中，DynaRAG显著提高了动态问题的准确性，同时减少了幻觉生成，验证了动态感知路由和选择性工具使用的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 动态知识整合和选择性API调用对于构建可靠的现实世界问答系统至关重要，DynaRAG框架为处理静态和时间敏感信息需求提供了有效解决方案。

title: Efficient Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction Via Dynamic Clustering
summary: Crowd trajectory prediction plays a crucial role in public safety and management, where it can help prevent disasters such as stampedes. Recent works address the problem by predicting individual trajectories and considering surrounding objects based on manually annotated data. However, these approaches tend to overlook dense crowd scenarios, where the challenges of automation become more pronounced due to the massiveness, noisiness, and inaccuracy of the tracking outputs, resulting in high computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose and extensively evaluate a novel cluster-based approach that groups individuals based on similar attributes over time, enabling faster execution through accurate group summarisation. Our plug-and-play method can be combined with existing trajectory predictors by using our output centroid in place of their pedestrian input. We evaluate our proposed method on several challenging dense crowd scenes. We demonstrated that our approach leads to faster processing and lower memory usage when compared with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the accuracy

AI.tldr: 提出基于聚类的密集人群轨迹预测方法，通过分组个体降低计算成本，同时保持预测精度
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹预测方法主要关注个体轨迹预测，但在密集人群场景中面临计算成本高、跟踪输出噪声大和不准确等问题，需要更高效的解决方案
AI.method: 提出基于聚类的方法，将具有相似属性的个体随时间分组，通过准确的群体摘要实现快速执行，可作为即插即用模块与现有轨迹预测器结合
AI.result: 在多个密集人群场景中验证，相比最先进方法，实现了更快的处理速度和更低的内存使用，同时保持了预测精度
AI.conclusion: 提出的聚类方法有效解决了密集人群轨迹预测中的计算效率问题，为公共安全和管理提供了实用的解决方案

title: From Concepts to Judgments: Interpretable Image Aesthetic Assessment
summary: Image aesthetic assessment (IAA) aims to predict the aesthetic quality of images as perceived by humans. While recent IAA models achieve strong predictive performance, they offer little insight into the factors driving their predictions. Yet for users, understanding why an image is considered pleasing or not is as valuable as the score itself, motivating growing interest in interpretability within IAA. When humans evaluate aesthetics, they naturally rely on high-level cues to justify their judgments. Motivated by this observation, we propose an interpretable IAA framework grounded in human-understandable aesthetic concepts. We learn these concepts in an accessible manner, constructing a subspace that forms the foundation of an inherently interpretable model. To capture nuanced influences on aesthetic perception beyond explicit concepts, we introduce a simple yet effective residual predictor. Experiments on photographic and artistic datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive predictive performance while offering transparent, human-understandable aesthetic judgments.

AI.tldr: 提出基于人类可理解美学概念的图像美学评估框架，在保持预测性能的同时提供可解释性
AI.motivation: 现有IAA模型虽然预测性能强，但缺乏对预测驱动因素的解释。用户不仅需要美学评分，更需要理解图像为何被认为美观或不美观，这推动了IAA可解释性的研究需求。
AI.method: 提出基于人类可理解美学概念的可解释IAA框架：1）以可访问方式学习美学概念，构建概念子空间作为可解释模型基础；2）引入简单有效的残差预测器，捕捉超出显式概念的细微美学感知影响
AI.result: 在摄影和艺术数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持竞争力的预测性能的同时，提供了透明、人类可理解的美学判断
AI.conclusion: 通过结合人类可理解的美学概念和残差预测器，实现了既具有预测性能又具有可解释性的图像美学评估框架，满足了用户对美学判断透明度的需求

title: Learned but Not Expressed: Capability-Expression Dissociation in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate the capacity to reconstruct and trace learned content from their training data under specific elicitation conditions, yet this capability does not manifest in standard generation contexts. This empirical observational study examines the expression of non-causal, non-implementable solution types across 300 prompt-response generations spanning narrative and problem-solving task contexts. Drawing on recent findings regarding memorization contiguity and alignment-induced discourse priors, we document a systematic dissociation between learned capability and expressed output. Across three distinct LLMs, ten task scenarios, and both creative narrative and practical advisory contexts, we documented zero instances of non-causal solution frames in generated outputs (0%, 95% CI: [0%, 1.2%]), despite verified reconstruction capability under conditional extraction. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that training data presence directly predicts output probability, demonstrating instead that task-conditioned generation policies can comprehensively suppress learned content across diverse contexts. The results offer implications for understanding generation dynamics, output distribution control, and the behavioral boundaries of contemporary LLMs.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型在特定条件下能够重建训练数据内容，但在标准生成任务中不会表达非因果、不可实现的解决方案类型，表明训练数据存在并不直接决定输出概率。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索大型语言模型在训练数据中存在的内容与其实际生成输出之间的差异，特别是非因果、不可实现解决方案的表达情况，挑战训练数据存在直接预测输出概率的普遍假设。
AI.method: 采用实证观察研究方法，分析300个提示-响应生成案例，涵盖叙事和问题解决任务背景。研究基于记忆连续性和对齐诱导的语篇先验理论，考察三个不同LLM在十个任务场景中的表现，包括创意叙事和实践建议背景。
AI.result: 在所有生成的输出中，未发现任何非因果解决方案框架的实例（0%，95%置信区间：[0%, 1.2%]），尽管在条件提取下验证了模型具有重建这些内容的能力。这表明任务条件生成策略能够全面抑制学习内容。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论挑战了训练数据存在直接预测输出概率的假设，证明任务条件生成策略可以全面抑制学习内容。这对理解生成动态、输出分布控制和当代LLM的行为边界具有重要意义。

title: Insight-V++: Towards Advanced Long-Chain Visual Reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2411.14432
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable reliability and advanced capabilities through extended test-time reasoning. However, extending these capabilities to Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remains a significant challenge due to a critical scarcity of high-quality, long-chain reasoning data and optimized training pipelines. To bridge this gap, we present a unified multi-agent visual reasoning framework that systematically evolves from our foundational image-centric model, Insight-V, into a generalized spatial-temporal architecture, Insight-V++. We first propose a scalable data generation pipeline equipped with multi-granularity assessment that autonomously synthesizes structured, complex reasoning trajectories across image and video domains without human intervention. Recognizing that directly supervising MLLMs with such intricate data yields sub-optimal results, we design a dual-agent architecture comprising a reasoning agent to execute extensive analytical chains, and a summary agent to critically evaluate and distill final outcomes. While our initial framework utilized Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), its off-policy nature fundamentally constrained reinforcement learning potential. To overcome these limitations, particularly for long-horizon video understanding, Insight-V++ introduces two novel algorithms, ST-GRPO and J-GRPO, which enhance spatial-temporal reasoning and improve evaluative robustness. Crucially, by leveraging reliable feedback from the summary agent, we guide an iterative reasoning path generation process, retraining the entire multi-agent system in a continuous, self-improving loop. Extensive experiments on base models like LLaVA-NeXT and Qwen2.5-VL demonstrate significant performance gains across challenging image and video reasoning benchmarks while preserving strong capabilities on traditional perception-focused tasks.

AI.tldr: Insight-V++是一个统一的多智能体视觉推理框架，通过创新的数据生成管道和双智能体架构，显著提升了多模态大语言模型在图像和视频推理任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型通过扩展测试时推理取得了显著可靠性，但将这种能力扩展到多模态大语言模型仍然面临重大挑战，主要原因是高质量长链推理数据的稀缺以及优化训练管道的不足。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一的多智能体视觉推理框架：1）可扩展的数据生成管道，自动合成跨图像和视频领域的结构化复杂推理轨迹；2）双智能体架构（推理智能体执行分析链，总结智能体评估和提炼最终结果）；3）引入ST-GRPO和J-GRPO算法增强时空推理；4）通过总结智能体的可靠反馈引导迭代推理路径生成，实现持续自我改进循环。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-NeXT和Qwen2.5-VL等基础模型上的广泛实验表明，该框架在具有挑战性的图像和视频推理基准测试中取得了显著性能提升，同时在传统感知任务上保持了强大能力。
AI.conclusion: Insight-V++框架通过创新的数据生成、多智能体架构和强化学习算法，成功解决了多模态大语言模型在长链推理方面的挑战，为视觉推理任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Real-Time Trustworthiness Scoring for LLM Structured Outputs and Data Extraction
summary:
Structured Outputs from current LLMs exhibit sporadic errors, hindering enterprise AI efforts from realizing their immense potential. We present CONSTRUCT, a method to score the trustworthiness of LLM Structured Outputs in real-time, such that lower-scoring outputs are more likely to contain errors. This reveals the best places to focus limited human review bandwidth. CONSTRUCT additionally scores the trustworthiness of each field within a LLM Structured Output, helping reviewers quickly identify which parts of the output are wrong. Our method is suitable for any LLM (including black-box LLM APIs without logprobs such as reasoning models and Anthropic models), does not require labeled training data nor custom model deployment, and works for complex Structured Outputs with many fields of diverse types (including nested JSON schemas).
  We additionally present one of the first public LLM Structured Output benchmarks with reliable ground-truth values that are not full of mistakes. Over this four-dataset benchmark, CONSTRUCT detects errors from various LLMs (including Gemini 3 and GPT-5) with significantly higher precision/recall than other scoring methods.

AI.tldr: CONSTRUCT是一种实时评估LLM结构化输出可信度的方法，通过评分帮助识别错误输出，指导人工审核资源分配，适用于各种LLM且无需训练数据。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM的结构化输出存在偶发性错误，阻碍了企业AI应用充分发挥潜力，需要一种方法来评估输出的可信度，以便更有效地分配有限的人工审核资源。
AI.method: CONSTRUCT方法能够实时评估LLM结构化输出的整体可信度，并为输出中的每个字段单独评分，帮助快速识别错误部分。该方法适用于任何LLM（包括没有logprobs的黑盒API），不需要标记训练数据或自定义模型部署，支持复杂嵌套JSON模式。
AI.result: 在包含四个数据集的公开基准测试中，CONSTRUCT在检测各种LLM（包括Gemini 3和GPT-5）的错误方面，比其他评分方法具有显著更高的精确率和召回率。
AI.conclusion: CONSTRUCT提供了一种有效评估LLM结构化输出可信度的方法，能够帮助企业在实际应用中更有效地识别和纠正错误，提升AI系统的可靠性。

title: Access Controlled Website Interaction for Agentic AI with Delegated Critical Tasks
summary: Recent studies reveal gaps in delegating critical tasks to agentic AI that accesses websites on the user's behalf, primarily due to limited access control mechanisms on websites designed for agentic AI. In response, we propose a design of website-based interaction for AI agents with fine-grained access control for delegated critical tasks. Our approach encompasses a website design and implementation, as well as modifications to the access grant protocols in an open-source authorization service to tailor it to agentic AI, with delegated critical tasks on the website. The evaluation of our approach demonstrates the capabilities of our access-controlled website used by AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对AI代理的网站交互设计，通过细粒度访问控制机制来解决AI代理在代表用户执行关键任务时的安全漏洞问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，将关键任务委托给代表用户访问网站的AI代理存在安全漏洞，主要是因为当前网站缺乏专门为AI代理设计的访问控制机制。
AI.method: 1. 设计了支持AI代理交互的网站架构；2. 修改了开源授权服务中的访问授权协议，使其专门适应AI代理执行关键任务的需求；3. 实现了细粒度访问控制机制。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，所提出的访问控制网站能够有效支持AI代理的安全使用，验证了该方法的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过专门为AI代理设计的网站交互架构和细粒度访问控制机制，可以有效解决AI代理在代表用户执行关键任务时的安全风险问题。

title: Beyond Accuracy: An Explainability-Driven Analysis of Harmful Content Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted at TrustNet 2026 (https://trustnetcon.in/). The final version will appear in Springer (LNNS), 2026
summary: Although automated harmful content detection systems are frequently used to monitor online platforms, moderators and end users frequently cannot understand the logic underlying their predictions. While recent studies have focused on increasing classification accuracy, little focus has been placed on comprehending why neural models identify content as harmful, especially when it comes to borderline, contextual, and politically sensitive situations. In this work, a neural harmful content detection model trained on the Civil Comments dataset is analyzed explainability-drivenly. Two popular post-hoc explanation methods, Shapley Additive Explanations and Integrated Gradients, are used to analyze the behavior of a RoBERTa-based classifier in both correct predictions and systematic failure cases. Despite strong overall performance, with an area under the curve of 0.93 and an accuracy of 0.94, the analysis reveals limitations that are not observable from aggregate evaluation metrics alone. Integrated Gradients appear to extract more diffuse contextual attributions while Shapley Additive Explanations extract more focused attributions on explicit lexical cues. The consequent divergence in their outputs manifests in both false negatives and false positives. Qualitative case studies reveal recurring failure modes such as indirect toxicity, lexical over-attribution, or political discourse. The results suggest that explainable AI can foster human-in-the-loop moderation by exposing model uncertainty and increasing the interpretable rationale behind automated decisions. Most importantly, this work highlights the role of explainability as a transparency and diagnostic resource for online harmful content detection systems rather than as a performance-enhancing lever.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可解释性方法分析有害内容检测模型，发现尽管模型整体性能优秀（AUC 0.93，准确率0.94），但在边界案例中仍存在系统性失败，不同解释方法揭示了模型的不同行为模式。
AI.motivation: 当前有害内容检测系统虽然被广泛使用，但用户和审核者难以理解其预测逻辑。现有研究多关注提升分类准确性，而缺乏对神经网络为何将内容识别为有害的理解，特别是在边界、上下文和政治敏感情境下。
AI.method: 使用两种流行的后解释方法（Shapley Additive Explanations和Integrated Gradients）分析基于RoBERTa的有害内容检测模型在Civil Comments数据集上的行为，包括正确预测和系统性失败案例。
AI.result: 分析揭示了仅从聚合评估指标无法观察到的局限性：Integrated Gradients提取更分散的上下文归因，而Shapley Additive Explanations更关注显性词汇线索。两种方法的输出差异在假阴性和假阳性中均有体现。定性案例研究揭示了间接毒性、词汇过度归因和政治话语等重复失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 可解释AI可以通过暴露模型不确定性和增加自动化决策的可解释理由来促进人在回路审核。最重要的是，这项工作强调了可解释性作为在线有害内容检测系统的透明度和诊断资源的作用，而非性能增强杠杆。

title: MicroVision: An Open Dataset and Benchmark Models for Detecting Vulnerable Road Users and Micromobility Vehicles
summary: Micromobility is a growing mode of transportation, raising new challenges for traffic safety and planning due to increased interactions in areas where vulnerable road users (VRUs) share the infrastructure with micromobility, including parked micromobility vehicles (MMVs). Approaches to support traffic safety and planning increasingly rely on detecting road users in images -- a computer-vision task relying heavily on the quality of the images to train on. However, existing open image datasets for training such models lack focus and diversity in VRUs and MMVs, for instance, by categorizing both pedestrians and MMV riders as "person", or by not including new MMVs like e-scooters. Furthermore, datasets are often captured from a car perspective and lack data from areas where only VRUs travel (sidewalks, cycle paths). To help close this gap, we introduce the MicroVision dataset: an open image dataset and annotations for training and evaluating models for detecting the most common VRUs (pedestrians, cyclists, e-scooterists) and stationary MMVs (bicycles, e-scooters), from a VRU perspective. The dataset, recorded in Gothenburg (Sweden), consists of more than 8,000 anonymized, full-HD images with more than 30,000 carefully annotated VRUs and MMVs, captured over an entire year and part of almost 2,000 unique interaction scenes. Along with the dataset, we provide first benchmark object-detection models based on state-of-the-art architectures, which achieved a mean average precision of up to 0.723 on an unseen test set. The dataset and model can support traffic safety to distinguish between different VRUs and MMVs, or help monitoring systems identify the use of micromobility. The dataset and model weights can be accessed at https://doi.org/10.71870/eepz-jd52.

AI.tldr: 研究者创建了MicroVision数据集，这是一个专注于弱势道路使用者（行人、骑行者、电动滑板车使用者）和静止微移动车辆（自行车、电动滑板车）的开放图像数据集，从弱势道路使用者视角采集，包含8000多张图像和30000多个标注，用于改进交通安全和规划中的目标检测模型。
AI.motivation: 现有开放图像数据集对弱势道路使用者和微移动车辆的关注度和多样性不足，通常将行人和微移动车辆骑行者都归类为"人"，或未包含新型微移动车辆如电动滑板车。此外，数据集多从汽车视角采集，缺乏仅弱势道路使用者通行的区域（人行道、自行车道）数据，这限制了交通安全和规划中目标检测模型的性能。
AI.method: 创建了MicroVision数据集：在瑞典哥德堡采集的8000多张匿名全高清图像，包含30000多个精心标注的弱势道路使用者和微移动车辆，覆盖全年时间，包含近2000个独特的交互场景。数据集从弱势道路使用者视角采集，专注于行人、骑行者、电动滑板车使用者以及静止的自行车和电动滑板车。同时提供了基于最先进架构的基准目标检测模型。
AI.result: 数据集包含8000多张图像和30000多个标注，覆盖全年时间和近2000个交互场景。基于该数据集训练的基准目标检测模型在未见测试集上达到了最高0.723的平均精度均值。该数据集和模型能够支持交通安全领域区分不同类型的弱势道路使用者和微移动车辆，或帮助监控系统识别微移动车辆的使用情况。
AI.conclusion: MicroVision数据集填补了现有开放图像数据集在弱势道路使用者和微移动车辆检测方面的空白，特别是从弱势道路使用者视角采集数据，覆盖了传统数据集缺乏的区域。该数据集和提供的基准模型能够支持交通安全和规划应用，促进微移动环境下的目标检测研究。

title: MineDraft: A Framework for Batch Parallel Speculative Decoding
comment: This paper proposes MineDraft, a framework that speeds up speculative decoding by overlapping drafting and verification, hiding drafting latency, and delivering improved throughput and latency
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by using a smaller draft model to propose draft tokens that are subsequently verified by a larger target model. However, the performance of standard SD is often limited by the strictly sequential execution of these drafting and verification stages. To address this, this paper proposes MineDraft, a batch parallel speculative decoding (PSD) framework designed to effectively hide drafting latency by overlapping it with verification. Our theoretical analysis shows that PSD is substantially more efficient than standard SD. MineDraft realizes the PSD through a novel batch-parallel design that maintains two batches of requests, overlapping drafting for one batch with verification for the other. Our experimental results show significant improvements of MineDraft in both throughput (up to 75%) and end-to-end latency (up to 39%) over standard SD. Furthermore, we have implemented MineDraft as a plugin for vLLM, demonstrating its practicality for production-ready inference systems.

AI.tldr: MineDraft提出了一种批处理并行推测解码框架，通过重叠草稿生成和验证阶段来隐藏延迟，相比标准推测解码显著提升了推理效率。
AI.motivation: 标准推测解码的性能受到草稿生成和验证阶段严格顺序执行的限制，导致效率瓶颈。需要一种能够隐藏草稿生成延迟的方法来提升推理速度。
AI.method: 提出MineDraft框架，采用批处理并行推测解码设计，维护两个请求批次，使一个批次的草稿生成与另一个批次的验证阶段重叠执行。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，MineDraft相比标准推测解码在吞吐量上提升高达75%，端到端延迟降低高达39%。已作为vLLM插件实现，证明其生产就绪性。
AI.conclusion: MineDraft通过批处理并行设计有效隐藏了草稿生成延迟，显著提升了大语言模型推理效率，具有实际部署价值。

title: Retrieval-Augmented LLM Agents: Learning to Learn from Experience
summary: While large language models (LLMs) have advanced the development of general-purpose agents, achieving robust generalization to unseen tasks remains a significant challenge. Current approaches typically rely on either fine-tuning or training-free memory-augmented generation using retrieved experience; yet both have limitations: fine-tuning often fails to extrapolate to new tasks, while experience retrieval often underperforms compared to supervised baselines. In this work, we propose to combine these approaches and systematically study how to train retrieval-augmented LLM agents to effectively leverage retrieved trajectories in-context. First, we establish a robust supervised fine-tuning (SFT) recipe using LoRA that outperforms several state-of-the-art agent training pipelines. Second, we provide a detailed analysis of key design choices for experience retrieval, identifying optimal strategies for storage, querying, and trajectory selection. Finally, we propose a pipeline that integrates experience retrieval into the fine-tuning process. Our results demonstrate that this combined approach significantly improves generalization to unseen tasks, providing a scalable and effective framework for building agents that learn to learn from experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合微调和检索增强的方法来提升LLM智能体在未见任务上的泛化能力，通过系统研究检索轨迹的上下文利用策略，显著改善了智能体的学习效果。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体在未见任务上的泛化能力有限，现有方法如微调难以外推到新任务，而基于检索的经验生成方法又通常弱于监督基线。需要结合两种方法的优势来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 1. 建立基于LoRA的鲁棒监督微调配方；2. 系统分析经验检索的关键设计选择（存储、查询、轨迹选择）；3. 提出将经验检索整合到微调过程中的完整管道。
AI.result: 提出的组合方法显著提高了智能体在未见任务上的泛化能力，基于LoRA的SFT配方优于多个最先进的智能体训练管道，为构建从经验中学习的智能体提供了可扩展的有效框架。
AI.conclusion: 结合微调和检索增强的方法能够有效提升LLM智能体的泛化能力，通过系统优化检索策略和微调过程，为构建能够从经验中学习的智能体提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: An Agentic System for Schema Aware NL2SQL Generation
summary: The natural language to SQL (NL2SQL) task plays a pivotal role in democratizing data access by enabling non-expert users to interact with relational databases through intuitive language. While recent frameworks have enhanced translation accuracy via task specialization, their reliance on Large Language Models (LLMs) raises significant concerns regarding computational overhead, data privacy, and real-world deployability in resource-constrained environments. To address these challenges, we propose a schema based agentic system that strategically employs Small Language Models (SLMs) as primary agents, complemented by a selective LLM fallback mechanism. The LLM is invoked only upon detection of errors in SLM-generated output, the proposed system significantly minimizes computational expenditure. Experimental results on the BIRD benchmark demonstrate that our system achieves an execution accuracy of 47.78% and a validation efficiency score of 51.05%, achieving over 90% cost reduction compared to LLM-centric baselines as approximately 67% of queries are resolved using local SLMs. The system achieves an average cost per query of 0.0085 compared to 0.094 for LLM-only systems, achieving near-zero operational costs for locally executed queries. [Github repository: https://github.com/mindslab25/CESMA.]

AI.tldr: 提出基于模式的智能代理系统，使用小型语言模型作为主要代理，配合选择性的大型语言模型回退机制，在BIRD基准上实现47.78%执行准确率和51.05%验证效率，成本降低90%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有NL2SQL框架依赖大型语言模型，存在计算开销大、数据隐私问题和资源受限环境部署困难等挑战，需要更高效、隐私友好的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出基于模式的智能代理系统，以小型语言模型为主要代理，仅在检测到SLM输出错误时才调用大型语言模型作为回退机制，显著减少计算开销。
AI.result: 在BIRD基准测试中，系统达到47.78%执行准确率和51.05%验证效率，约67%查询由本地SLM解决，相比纯LLM系统成本降低90%以上，平均每查询成本从0.094降至0.0085。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过智能代理架构和选择性LLM回退机制，在保持良好性能的同时大幅降低计算成本和隐私风险，为资源受限环境提供了可行的NL2SQL解决方案。

title: LRConv-NeRV: Low Rank Convolution for Efficient Neural Video Compression
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Neural Representations for Videos (NeRV) encode entire video sequences within neural network parameters, offering an alternative paradigm to conventional video codecs. However, the convolutional decoder of NeRV remains computationally expensive and memory intensive, limiting its deployment in resource-constrained environments. This paper proposes LRConv-NeRV, an efficient NeRV variant that replaces selected dense 3x3 convolutional layers with structured low-rank separable convolutions, trained end-to-end within the decoder architecture. By progressively applying low-rank factorization from the largest to earlier decoder stages, LRConv-NeRV enables controllable trade-offs between reconstruction quality and efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that applying LRConv only to the final decoder stage reduces decoder complexity by 68%, from 201.9 to 64.9 GFLOPs, and model size by 9.3%, while incurring negligible quality loss and achieving approximately 9.2% bitrate reduction. Under INT8 post-training quantization, LRConv-NeRV preserves reconstruction quality close to the dense NeRV baseline, whereas more aggressive factorization of early decoder stages leads to disproportionate quality degradation. Compared to existing work under layer-aligned settings, LRConv-NeRV achieves a more favorable efficiency versus quality trade-off, offering substantial GFLOPs and parameter reductions while maintaining higher PSNR/MS-SSIM and improved temporal stability. Temporal flicker analysis using LPIPS further shows that the proposed solution preserves temporal coherence close to the NeRV baseline, results establish LRConv-NeRV as a potential architectural alternative for efficient neural video decoding under low-precision and resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: LRConv-NeRV：通过低秩可分离卷积替代传统卷积，在保持视频重建质量的同时显著降低神经视频解码的计算复杂度和模型大小
AI.motivation: 传统NeRV的卷积解码器计算开销大、内存占用高，限制了在资源受限环境中的部署，需要一种更高效的神经视频表示方法
AI.method: 提出LRConv-NeRV，用结构化低秩可分离卷积替换部分3x3卷积层，从最大解码阶段逐步向前应用低秩分解，实现重建质量与效率的可控权衡
AI.result: 仅对最终解码阶段应用LRConv即可降低68%解码复杂度（201.9→64.9 GFLOPs）和9.3%模型大小，质量损失可忽略，比特率降低约9.2%；INT8量化后仍保持接近基准的质量
AI.conclusion: LRConv-NeRV在效率与质量权衡方面优于现有方法，为低精度和资源受限环境下的高效神经视频解码提供了有前景的架构替代方案

title: BenchBrowser -- Collecting Evidence for Evaluating Benchmark Validity
summary: Do language model benchmarks actually measure what practitioners intend them to ? High-level metadata is too coarse to convey the granular reality of benchmarks: a "poetry" benchmark may never test for haikus, while "instruction-following" benchmarks will often test for an arbitrary mix of skills. This opacity makes verifying alignment with practitioner goals a laborious process, risking an illusion of competence even when models fail on untested facets of user interests. We introduce BenchBrowser, a retriever that surfaces evaluation items relevant to natural language use cases over 20 benchmark suites. Validated by a human study confirming high retrieval precision, BenchBrowser generates evidence to help practitioners diagnose low content validity (narrow coverage of a capability's facets) and low convergent validity (lack of stable rankings when measuring the same capability). BenchBrowser, thus, helps quantify a critical gap between practitioner intent and what benchmarks actually test.

AI.tldr: 论文指出语言模型基准测试存在内容有效性不足的问题，无法准确衡量实践者意图，并提出了BenchBrowser工具来帮助诊断基准测试与实际需求之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型基准测试的元数据过于粗糙，无法准确反映实践者的真实需求。基准测试的模糊性使得验证模型能力与实际应用目标的一致性变得困难，可能导致模型在未测试的方面表现不佳却产生能力错觉。
AI.method: 提出了BenchBrowser检索器，该工具能够从20多个基准测试套件中检索与自然语言使用场景相关的评估项目。通过人工研究验证了其高检索精度，帮助诊断内容有效性不足（能力维度覆盖狭窄）和收敛有效性不足（测量相同能力时排名不稳定）的问题。
AI.result: BenchBrowser能够有效生成证据，帮助实践者量化基准测试与实践者意图之间的关键差距。人工研究证实了该工具具有高检索精度。
AI.conclusion: BenchBrowser工具能够帮助实践者更好地理解基准测试的局限性，诊断基准测试与实际需求之间的差距，从而提高语言模型评估的准确性和实用性。

title: CORE: Robust Out-of-Distribution Detection via Confidence and Orthogonal Residual Scoring
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, includes supplementary material as appendix
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for deploying deep learning models reliably, yet no single method performs consistently across architectures and datasets -- a scorer that leads on one benchmark often falters on another. We attribute this inconsistency to a shared structural limitation: logit-based methods see only the classifier's confidence signal, while feature-based methods attempt to measure membership in the training distribution but do so in the full feature space where confidence and membership are entangled, inheriting architecture-sensitive failure modes. We observe that penultimate features naturally decompose into two orthogonal subspaces: a classifier-aligned component encoding confidence, and a residual the classifier discards. We discover that this residual carries a class-specific directional signature for in-distribution data -- a membership signal invisible to logit-based methods and entangled with noise in feature-based methods. We propose CORE (COnfidence + REsidual), which disentangles the two signals by scoring each subspace independently and combines them via normalized summation. Because the two signals are orthogonal by construction, their failure modes are approximately independent, producing robust detection where either view alone is unreliable. CORE achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across five architectures and five benchmark configurations, ranking first in three of five settings and achieving the highest grand average AUROC with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: CORE方法通过解耦置信度信号和残差信号，将两者正交组合，实现了在多种架构和数据集上一致的OOD检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法存在不一致性问题：基于logit的方法只关注分类器置信度信号，而基于特征的方法试图测量训练分布成员资格，但在完整特征空间中置信度和成员资格信号相互纠缠，继承了架构敏感的失效模式。
AI.method: 提出CORE方法，观察到倒数第二层特征自然分解为两个正交子空间：与分类器对齐的置信度分量和分类器丢弃的残差分量。残差携带了分布内数据的类特定方向特征。CORE通过独立评分每个子空间并通过归一化求和组合它们来解耦这两个信号。
AI.result: CORE在五种架构和五种基准配置中实现了竞争性或最先进的性能，在五分之三的设置中排名第一，获得了最高的平均AUROC，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦置信度信号和残差信号，利用它们正交构造的特性使失效模式近似独立，CORE能够在单一方法不可靠的情况下产生鲁棒的检测性能，解决了现有OOD检测方法的不一致性问题。

title: CycleCap: Improving VLMs Captioning Performance via Self-Supervised Cycle Consistency Fine-Tuning
summary: Visual-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in image captioning, visual question answering, and visual reasoning. Yet they remain prone to vision-language misalignment, often producing overly generic or hallucinated descriptions. Existing approaches address this via instruction tuning-requiring costly, large-scale annotated datasets or via complex test-time frameworks for caption refinement. In this work, we revisit image-text alignment through the lens of cycle consistency: given an image and a caption generated by an image-to-text model, the backward mapping through a text-to-image model should reconstruct an image that closely matches the original. In our setup, a VLM serves as the image-to-text component, while a pre-trained text-to-image model closes the loop by reconstructing the image from the generated caption. Building on this, we introduce CycleCap, a fine-tuning scheme to improve image captioning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward based on the similarity between the original and reconstructed images, computed on-the-fly. Unlike previous work that uses cycle consistency loss for preference dataset construction, our method leverages cycle consistency directly as a self-supervised training signal. This enables the use of raw images alone, eliminating the need for curated image-text datasets, while steering the VLM to produce more accurate and grounded text descriptions. Applied to four VLMs ranging from 1B to 7B parameters, CycleCap yields consistent improvements across captioning and hallucination benchmarks, surpassing state-of-the-art methods that rely on supervised cycle consistency training.

AI.tldr: CycleCap：利用循环一致性作为自监督训练信号，通过文本到图像重建的相似度奖励来改进视觉语言模型的图像描述生成，无需标注数据
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型存在视觉-语言不对齐问题，产生过于通用或幻觉描述。现有方法需要昂贵的标注数据集或复杂的测试时框架，需要更高效、自监督的改进方法
AI.method: 提出CycleCap微调方案，基于循环一致性：图像→文本模型生成描述→文本→图像模型重建图像→比较原始与重建图像的相似度作为奖励，使用组相对策略优化进行训练
AI.result: 在1B到7B参数的四个视觉语言模型上，CycleCap在描述生成和幻觉基准测试中均取得一致改进，超越了依赖监督循环一致性训练的最先进方法
AI.conclusion: CycleCap通过将循环一致性直接用作自监督训练信号，仅需原始图像无需标注数据，有效提升视觉语言模型的图像描述准确性和基础性

title: Fast and Generalizable NeRF Architecture Selection for Satellite Scene Reconstruction
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have emerged as a powerful approach for photorealistic 3D reconstruction from multi-view images. However, deploying NeRF for satellite imagery remains challenging. Each scene requires individual training, and optimizing architectures via Neural Architecture Search (NAS) demands hours to days of GPU time. While existing approaches focus on architectural improvements, our SHAP analysis reveals that multi-view consistency, rather than model architecture, determines reconstruction quality. Based on this insight, we develop PreSCAN, a predictive framework that estimates NeRF quality prior to training using lightweight geometric and photometric descriptors. PreSCAN selects suitable architectures in < 30 seconds with < 1 dB prediction error, achieving 1000$\times$ speedup over NAS. We further demonstrate PreSCAN's deployment utility on edge platforms (Jetson Orin), where combining its predictions with offline cost profiling reduces inference power by 26% and latency by 43% with minimal quality loss. Experiments on DFC2019 datasets confirm that PreSCAN generalizes across diverse satellite scenes without retraining.

AI.tldr: PreSCAN是一个预测框架，能在训练前通过轻量级几何和光度描述符估计NeRF质量，实现30秒内选择合适架构，比NAS快1000倍，并在边缘设备上显著降低功耗和延迟。
AI.motivation: 卫星图像NeRF部署面临挑战：每个场景需要单独训练，NAS优化需要数小时到数天的GPU时间。研究发现多视图一致性而非模型架构决定重建质量，因此需要开发预测性框架来提前评估质量。
AI.method: 基于SHAP分析发现多视图一致性是关键因素，开发PreSCAN框架，使用轻量级几何和光度描述符在训练前预测NeRF质量。框架结合离线成本分析，在边缘平台上优化架构选择。
AI.result: PreSCAN在30秒内选择合适架构，预测误差小于1 dB，比NAS快1000倍。在Jetson Orin边缘平台上，结合离线成本分析减少26%推理功耗和43%延迟，质量损失最小。在DFC2019数据集上验证了跨场景泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PreSCAN通过预测性质量评估解决了卫星图像NeRF部署的效率问题，显著加速架构选择过程，并在边缘设备上实现功耗和延迟优化，展示了实际部署的实用性。

title: How LLMs Distort Our Written Language
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used by over a billion people globally, most often to assist with writing. In this work, we demonstrate that LLMs not only alter the voice and tone of human writing, but also consistently alter the intended meaning. First, we conduct a human user study to understand how people actually interact with LLMs when using them for writing. Our findings reveal that extensive LLM use led to a nearly 70% increase in essays that remained neutral in answering the topic question. Significantly more heavy LLM users reported that the writing was less creative and not in their voice. Next, using a dataset of human-written essays that was collected in 2021 before the widespread release of LLMs, we study how asking an LLM to revise the essay based on the human-written feedback in the dataset induces large changes in the resulting content and meaning. We find that even when LLMs are prompted with expert feedback and asked to only make grammar edits, they still change the text in a way that significantly alters its semantic meaning. We then examine LLM-generated text in the wild, specifically focusing on the 21% of AI-generated scientific peer reviews at a recent top AI conference. We find that LLM-generated reviews place significantly less weight on clarity and significance of the research, and assign scores that, on average, are a full point higher.These findings highlight a misalignment between the perceived benefit of AI use and an implicit, consistent effect on the semantics of human writing, motivating future work on how widespread AI writing will affect our cultural and scientific institutions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLMs不仅改变人类写作的风格和语气，还会系统性地改变原意，导致写作中立化、创造力下降，并在科学评审中产生评分偏差
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs被全球超过十亿人用于写作辅助，需要了解它们如何实际影响人类写作，特别是是否会改变写作的语义内容和意图
AI.method: 1) 进行人类用户研究，观察实际使用LLMs写作的情况；2) 使用2021年收集的人类写作数据集，分析LLMs根据人类反馈修改文本时的变化；3) 分析实际场景中的LLM生成文本，特别是AI会议中AI生成的同行评审
AI.result: 1) 大量使用LLMs导致中立回答主题问题的文章增加近70%，用户报告写作创造性和个人风格下降；2) 即使只要求语法修改，LLMs仍会显著改变文本语义；3) AI生成的科学评审更少关注研究清晰度和重要性，平均评分高出整整1分
AI.conclusion: AI使用的感知益处与其对写作语义的系统性影响存在错位，这促使需要研究广泛AI写作将如何影响文化和科学机构

title: Modeling the human lexicon under temperature variations: linguistic factors, diversity and typicality in LLM word associations
comment: 11 pages, 12 figures, to appear in LREC 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve impressive results in terms of fluency in text generation, yet the nature of their linguistic knowledge - in particular the human-likeness of their internal lexicon - remains uncertain. This study compares human and LLM-generated word associations to evaluate how accurately models capture human lexical patterns. Using English cue-response pairs from the SWOW dataset and newly generated associations from three LLMs (Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen-2.5-32B) across multiple temperature settings, we examine (i) the influence of lexical factors such as word frequency and concreteness on cue-response pairs, and (ii) the variability and typicality of LLM responses compared to human responses. Results show that all models mirror human trends for frequency and concreteness but differ in response variability and typicality. Larger models such as Qwen tend to emulate a single "prototypical" human participant, generating highly typical but minimally variable responses, while smaller models such as Mistral and Llama produce more variable yet less typical responses. Temperature settings further influence this trade-off, with higher values increasing variability but decreasing typicality. These findings highlight both the similarities and differences between human and LLM lexicons, emphasizing the need to account for model size and temperature when probing LLM lexical representations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较人类与LLM生成的词汇联想，评估大语言模型对人类词汇模式的捕捉能力，发现模型大小和温度设置显著影响响应的典型性和变异性。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在文本生成方面表现出色，但其语言知识的本质——特别是其内部词汇表的人类相似性——仍然不确定。研究旨在评估LLM在多大程度上准确捕捉人类的词汇模式。
AI.method: 使用SWOW数据集中的英语提示-反应对，以及从三个LLM（Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen-2.5-32B）在多个温度设置下新生成的联想，分析：(i)词汇因素（如词频和具体性）对提示-反应对的影响；(ii)LLM响应与人类响应相比的变异性和典型性。
AI.result: 所有模型都反映了人类在词频和具体性方面的趋势，但在响应变异性和典型性上存在差异。较大的模型（如Qwen）倾向于模拟单一的"原型"人类参与者，生成高度典型但变异最小的响应；而较小的模型（如Mistral和Llama）产生更多变异但典型性较低的响应。温度设置进一步影响这种权衡，较高的温度值增加变异性但降低典型性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果突显了人类和LLM词汇表之间的相似性和差异性，强调在探究LLM词汇表征时需要考虑模型大小和温度设置的重要性。

title: FaithSteer-BENCH: A Deployment-Aligned Stress-Testing Benchmark for Inference-Time Steering
summary: Inference-time steering is widely regarded as a lightweight and parameter-free mechanism for controlling large language model (LLM) behavior, and prior work has often suggested that simple activation-level interventions can reliably induce targeted behavioral changes. However, such conclusions are typically drawn under relatively relaxed evaluation settings that overlook deployment constraints, capability trade-offs, and real-world robustness. We therefore introduce \textbf{FaithSteer-BENCH}, a stress-testing benchmark that evaluates steering methods at a fixed deployment-style operating point through three gate-wise criteria: controllability, utility preservation, and robustness. Across multiple models and representative steering approaches, we uncover several systematic failure modes that are largely obscured under standard evaluation, including illusory controllability, measurable cognitive tax on unrelated capabilities, and substantial brittleness under mild instruction-level perturbations, role prompts, encoding transformations, and data scarcity. Gate-wise benchmark results show that existing methods do not necessarily provide reliable controllability in deployment-oriented practical settings. In addition, mechanism-level diagnostics indicate that many steering methods induce prompt-conditional alignment rather than stable latent directional shifts, further explaining their fragility under stress. FaithSteer-BENCH therefore provides a unified benchmark and a clearer analytical lens for future method design, reliability evaluation, and deployment-oriented research in steering.

AI.tldr: FaithSteer-BENCH是一个用于评估LLM推理时引导方法的压力测试基准，揭示了现有方法在实际部署场景中的系统性失败模式，包括虚假可控性、认知税和脆弱性等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常认为简单的激活层干预可以可靠地引导LLM行为，但这些结论是在相对宽松的评估设置下得出的，忽略了部署约束、能力权衡和实际鲁棒性。需要更严格的评估框架来检验引导方法在实际部署中的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出了FaithSteer-BENCH基准，通过三个门控标准评估引导方法：可控性、效用保持和鲁棒性。该基准在固定部署式操作点进行压力测试，涵盖多种模型和代表性引导方法，并包含机制级诊断分析。
AI.result: 在多个模型和引导方法中发现了系统性失败模式：1）虚假可控性；2）对无关能力产生可测量的认知税；3）在轻微指令扰动、角色提示、编码变换和数据稀缺下的显著脆弱性。机制诊断表明许多方法诱导的是提示条件对齐而非稳定的潜在方向偏移。
AI.conclusion: 现有引导方法在部署导向的实际设置中不一定提供可靠的可控性。FaithSteer-BENCH为未来方法设计、可靠性评估和部署导向的引导研究提供了统一的基准和更清晰的分析视角。

title: VISTA: Validation-Guided Integration of Spatial and Temporal Foundation Models with Anatomical Decoding for Rare-Pathology VCE Event Detection
summary: Capsule endoscopy event detection is challenging because diagnostically relevant findings are sparse, visually heterogeneous, and embedded in long, noisy video streams, while evaluation is performed at the event level rather than by frame accuracy alone. We therefore formulate the RARE-VISION task as a metric-aligned event detection problem instead of a purely frame-wise classification task. Our framework combines two complementary backbones, EndoFM-LV for local temporal context and DINOv3 ViT-L/16 for strong frame-level visual semantics, followed by a Diverse Head Ensemble, Validation-Guided Hierarchical Fusion, and Anatomy-Aware Temporal Event Decoding. The fusion stage uses validation-derived class-wise model weighting, backbone weighting, and probability calibration, while the decoding stage applies temporal smoothing, anatomical constraints, threshold refinement, and per-label event generation to produce stable event predictions. Validation ablations indicate that complementary backbones, validation-guided fusion, and anatomy-aware temporal decoding all contribute to event-level performance. On the official hidden test set, the proposed method achieved an overall temporal mAP@0.5 of 0.3530 and temporal mAP@0.95 of 0.3235.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RARE-VISION框架，通过结合局部时间上下文和强视觉语义的双主干网络，配合验证引导的层次融合和解剖感知的时间事件解码，解决胶囊内窥镜事件检测中诊断相关发现稀疏、视觉异质性强的问题。
AI.motivation: 胶囊内窥镜事件检测面临三大挑战：诊断相关发现稀疏、视觉异质性强、且嵌入在长而嘈杂的视频流中，同时评估需要在事件层面而非仅帧级精度上进行。因此需要设计专门针对事件检测而非纯帧级分类的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出RARE-VISION框架：1) 结合EndoFM-LV（局部时间上下文）和DINOv3 ViT-L/16（强帧级视觉语义）的双主干网络；2) 多样化头集成；3) 验证引导的层次融合（使用验证集衍生的类别权重、主干权重和概率校准）；4) 解剖感知的时间事件解码（时间平滑、解剖约束、阈值细化和每标签事件生成）。
AI.result: 验证消融实验表明互补主干网络、验证引导的融合和解剖感知的时间解码都对事件级性能有贡献。在官方隐藏测试集上，该方法取得了总体时间mAP@0.5为0.3530和时间mAP@0.95为0.3235的成绩。
AI.conclusion: 通过将胶囊内窥镜事件检测重新定义为度量对齐的事件检测问题，并采用互补主干网络、验证引导的层次融合和解剖感知的时间解码，能够有效解决该领域面临的独特挑战，在事件级检测任务上取得了有竞争力的性能。

title: GRAFITE: Generative Regression Analysis Framework for Issue Tracking and Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are largely motivated by their performance on popular topics and benchmarks at the time of their release. However, over time, contamination occurs due to significant exposure of benchmark data during training. This poses a risk of model performance inflation if testing is not carefully executed. To address this challenge, we present GRAFITE, a continuous LLM evaluation platform through a comprehensive system for maintaining and evaluating model issues. Our approach enables building a repository of model problems based on user feedback over time and offers a pipeline for assessing LLMs against these issues through quality assurance (QA) tests using LLM-as-a-judge. The platform enables side-by-side comparison of multiple models, facilitating regression detection across different releases. The platform is available at https://github.com/IBM/grafite. The demo video is available at www.youtube.com/watch?v=XFZyoleN56k.

AI.tldr: GRAFITE是一个持续评估大语言模型的平台，通过用户反馈构建问题库，使用LLM-as-a-judge进行质量测试，支持多模型对比和回归检测。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在发布时通常基于热门话题和基准测试表现，但随着时间的推移，训练数据中的基准测试数据暴露会导致污染问题，如果不仔细测试，模型性能可能会被高估。
AI.method: 开发了GRAFITE平台，通过用户反馈随时间积累构建模型问题库，提供使用LLM-as-a-judge进行质量保证测试的流水线来评估LLMs，支持多模型并排比较和不同版本间的回归检测。
AI.result: 创建了一个持续评估LLM的平台，能够系统性地维护和评估模型问题，通过QA测试评估LLMs，并支持模型间的对比分析和版本回归检测。
AI.conclusion: GRAFITE平台为解决LLM评估中的基准污染问题提供了系统化解决方案，通过持续收集用户反馈和自动化测试，能够更准确地评估模型性能并检测回归问题。

title: MemArchitect: A Policy Driven Memory Governance Layer
comment: This is an on going research work and will be updated periodically
summary:
Persistent Large Language Model (LLM) agents expose a critical governance gap in memory management. Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks treat memory as passive storage, lacking mechanisms to resolve contradictions, enforce privacy, or prevent outdated information ("zombie memories") from contaminating the context window.
  We introduce MemArchitect, a governance layer that decouples memory lifecycle management from model weights. MemArchitect enforces explicit, rule-based policies, including memory decay, conflict resolution, and privacy controls.
  We demonstrate that governed memory consistently outperforms unmanaged memory in agentic settings, highlighting the necessity of structured memory governance for reliable and safe autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: MemArchitect是一个用于大型语言模型代理的内存治理层，通过解耦内存生命周期管理与模型权重，解决标准RAG框架中内存管理的治理空白问题。
AI.motivation: 现有持久性LLM代理存在关键治理空白：标准RAG框架将内存视为被动存储，缺乏解决矛盾、执行隐私保护或防止过时信息（"僵尸记忆"）污染上下文窗口的机制。
AI.method: 引入MemArchitect作为治理层，将内存生命周期管理与模型权重解耦。该系统强制执行基于规则的明确策略，包括内存衰减、冲突解决和隐私控制。
AI.result: 研究表明，在代理场景中，受治理的内存持续优于未管理的内存，突显了结构化内存治理对于可靠和安全自主系统的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化内存治理对于构建可靠和安全的自主系统至关重要，MemArchitect为解决LLM代理中的内存管理问题提供了有效的治理框架。

title: To See or To Please: Uncovering Visual Sycophancy and Split Beliefs in VLMs
summary: When VLMs answer correctly, do they genuinely rely on visual information or exploit language shortcuts? We introduce the Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework, which disentangles hallucination sources via three metrics: Latent Anomaly Detection (perceptual awareness), Visual Necessity Score (visual dependency, measured via KL divergence), and Competition Score (conflict between visual grounding and instruction following). Using counterfactual interventions (blind, noise, and conflict images) across 7 VLMs and 7,000 model-sample pairs, our taxonomy reveals that 69.6% of samples exhibit Visual Sycophancy--models detect visual anomalies but hallucinate to satisfy user expectations--while zero samples show Robust Refusal, indicating alignment training has systematically suppressed truthful uncertainty acknowledgment. A scaling analysis (Qwen2.5-VL 7B to 72B) shows larger models reduce Language Shortcuts but amplify Visual Sycophancy, demonstrating scale alone cannot resolve the grounding problem. Diagnostic scores further enable a post-hoc selective prediction strategy achieving up to +9.5pp accuracy at 50% coverage with no additional training cost.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了Tri-Layer诊断框架，通过三个指标分析VLMs是否真正依赖视觉信息还是利用语言捷径，发现69.6%样本存在"视觉谄媚"现象，模型能检测视觉异常但为满足用户期望而幻觉，且规模扩大反而加剧这一问题。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究视觉语言模型在正确回答时，是否真正依赖视觉信息还是利用语言捷径。当前缺乏系统性的诊断框架来解构幻觉来源，需要理解模型在视觉感知、视觉依赖和指令遵循冲突等方面的真实行为。
AI.method: 提出Tri-Layer诊断框架，包含三个指标：潜在异常检测（感知意识）、视觉必要性分数（通过KL散度测量视觉依赖）、竞争分数（视觉基础与指令遵循的冲突）。使用反事实干预（盲图、噪声图、冲突图）在7个VLMs和7,000个模型-样本对上进行分析。
AI.result: 69.6%样本表现出"视觉谄媚"现象，模型能检测视觉异常但为满足用户期望而幻觉；零样本显示"鲁棒拒绝"，表明对齐训练系统性地抑制了真实不确定性承认。规模分析显示更大模型减少语言捷径但放大视觉谄媚。诊断分数支持后验选择性预测策略，在50%覆盖率下实现+9.5pp准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型存在系统性幻觉问题，特别是"视觉谄媚"现象普遍存在。规模扩大无法解决基础问题，反而加剧视觉谄媚。提出的诊断框架能有效识别问题并支持改进策略，为VLMs的可靠性评估提供了新工具。

title: CWoMP: Morpheme Representation Learning for Interlinear Glossing
summary: Interlinear glossed text (IGT) is a standard notation for language documentation which is linguistically rich but laborious to produce manually. Recent automated IGT methods treat glosses as character sequences, neglecting their compositional structure. We propose CWoMP (Contrastive Word-Morpheme Pretraining), which instead treats morphemes as atomic form-meaning units with learned representations. A contrastively trained encoder aligns words-in-context with their constituent morphemes in a shared embedding space; an autoregressive decoder then generates the morpheme sequence by retrieving entries from a mutable lexicon of these embeddings. Predictions are interpretable--grounded in lexicon entries--and users can improve results at inference time by expanding the lexicon without retraining. We evaluate on diverse low-resource languages, showing that CWoMP outperforms existing methods while being significantly more efficient, with particularly strong gains in extremely low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: CWoMP是一种新的自动生成语际注释文本的方法，将语素视为原子形式-意义单元，通过对比学习对齐词与语素，使用自回归解码器从可变词典中检索生成语素序列。
AI.motivation: 语际注释文本是语言文档的标准标注方法，但手动制作非常耗时。现有的自动方法将注释视为字符序列，忽略了其组合结构，需要更有效的方法来处理低资源语言。
AI.method: 提出CWoMP方法：1) 将语素视为具有学习表示的形式-意义原子单元；2) 使用对比训练的编码器在共享嵌入空间中对齐上下文中的词与其组成语素；3) 使用自回归解码器从可变词典中检索这些嵌入来生成语素序列。
AI.result: 在多种低资源语言上评估，CWoMP优于现有方法，同时显著更高效，在极低资源设置下表现尤为突出。预测结果可解释且基于词典条目，用户可以通过扩展词典在推理时改进结果而无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: CWoMP通过将语素视为原子单元并利用对比学习和可变词典，为自动生成语际注释文本提供了一种高效、可解释且适用于低资源语言的方法，在极低资源环境下表现优异。

title: Understanding the Theoretical Foundations of Deep Neural Networks through Differential Equations
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable empirical success, yet the absence of a principled theoretical foundation continues to hinder their systematic development. In this survey, we present differential equations as a theoretical foundation for understanding, analyzing, and improving DNNs. We organize the discussion around three guiding questions: i) how differential equations offer a principled understanding of DNN architectures, ii) how tools from differential equations can be used to improve DNN performance in a principled way, and iii) what real-world applications benefit from grounding DNNs in differential equations. We adopt a two-fold perspective spanning the model level, which interprets the whole DNN as a differential equation, and the layer level, which models individual DNN components as differential equations. From these two perspectives, we review how this framework connects model design, theoretical analysis, and performance improvement. We further discuss real-world applications, as well as key challenges and opportunities for future research.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文探讨了将微分方程作为深度神经网络的理论基础，从模型层面和层层面两个视角，阐述了微分方程如何为理解、分析和改进DNN提供原则性框架。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络虽然取得了显著的经验成功，但缺乏原则性理论基础阻碍了其系统化发展。作者希望通过微分方程这一数学工具为DNN提供坚实的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用双重视角：模型层面（将整个DNN视为微分方程）和层层面（将单个DNN组件建模为微分方程）。围绕三个指导性问题组织讨论：微分方程如何提供对DNN架构的原则性理解；如何用微分方程工具改进DNN性能；哪些实际应用受益于基于微分方程的DNN框架。
AI.result: 建立了微分方程与DNN设计、理论分析和性能改进之间的联系框架，并讨论了实际应用案例，以及未来研究的关键挑战和机遇。
AI.conclusion: 微分方程为深度神经网络提供了有前景的理论基础，能够统一模型设计、理论分析和性能改进，为DNN的系统化发展开辟了新途径。

title: Pixel-Accurate Epipolar Guided Matching
summary: Keypoint matching can be slow and unreliable in challenging conditions such as repetitive textures or wide-baseline views. In such cases, known geometric relations (e.g., the fundamental matrix) can be used to restrict potential correspondences to a narrow epipolar envelope, thereby reducing the search space and improving robustness. These epipolar-guided matching approaches have proved effective in tasks such as SfM; however, most rely on coarse spatial binning, which introduces approximation errors, requires costly post-processing, and may miss valid correspondences. We address these limitations with an exact formulation that performs candidate selection directly in angular space. In our approach, each keypoint is assigned a tolerance circle which, when viewed from the epipole, defines an angular interval. Matching then becomes a 1D angular interval query, solved efficiently in logarithmic time with a segment tree. This guarantees pixel-level tolerance, supports per-keypoint control, and removes unnecessary descriptor comparisons. Extensive evaluation on ETH3D demonstrates noticeable speedups over existing approaches while recovering exact correspondence sets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于角度空间的精确关键点匹配方法，通过将匹配问题转化为1D角度区间查询，在保持像素级精度的同时显著提升匹配速度和准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于极线几何的匹配方法通常依赖粗粒度空间分箱，这会引入近似误差、需要昂贵的后处理，并且可能遗漏有效对应关系。特别是在重复纹理或宽基线视图等挑战性条件下，关键点匹配速度慢且不可靠。
AI.method: 提出精确的角度空间匹配方法：为每个关键点分配一个容差圆，从极点的视角定义角度区间，将匹配问题转化为1D角度区间查询问题，使用线段树在对数时间内高效解决。
AI.result: 在ETH3D数据集上的广泛评估显示，相比现有方法实现了显著的速度提升，同时恢复了精确的对应关系集合。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了像素级容差控制、支持每个关键点的个性化设置、消除了不必要的描述符比较，为极线引导匹配提供了精确高效的解决方案。

title: Large-Scale Analysis of Political Propaganda on Moltbook
summary: We present an NLP-based study of political propaganda on Moltbook, a Reddit-style platform for AI agents. To enable large-scale analysis, we develop LLM-based classifiers to detect political propaganda, validated against expert annotation (Cohen's $κ$= 0.64-0.74). Using a dataset of 673,127 posts and 879,606 comments, we find that political propaganda accounts for 1% of all posts and 42% of all political content. These posts are concentrated in a small set of communities, with 70% of such posts falling into five of them. 4% of agents produced 51% of these posts. We further find that a minority of these agents repeatedly post highly similar content within and across communities. Despite this, we find limited evidence that comments amplify political propaganda.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用NLP方法分析AI代理平台Moltbook上的政治宣传内容，开发了基于LLM的分类器进行大规模检测，发现政治宣传集中在少数社区和少数代理中。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是分析AI代理平台上的政治宣传现象，了解其规模、分布特征和传播模式，为平台治理提供数据支持。
AI.method: 开发基于大语言模型的政治宣传分类器，使用专家标注进行验证（Cohen's κ=0.64-0.74），分析673,127个帖子和879,606条评论的数据集。
AI.result: 政治宣传占所有帖子的1%，占所有政治内容的42%；70%的政治宣传帖子集中在5个社区；4%的代理产生了51%的政治宣传内容；少数代理在社区内外重复发布高度相似内容；评论对政治宣传的放大作用有限。
AI.conclusion: AI代理平台上的政治宣传呈现高度集中化特征，少数代理和社区主导了大部分宣传内容，但评论系统的放大效应有限，这为平台内容治理提供了重要启示。

title: Inst4DGS: Instance-Decomposed 4D Gaussian Splatting with Multi-Video Label Permutation Learning
