summary: We present Inst4DGS, an instance-decomposed 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) approach with long-horizon per-Gaussian trajectories. While dynamic 4DGS has advanced rapidly, instance-decomposed 4DGS remains underexplored, largely due to the difficulty of associating inconsistent instance labels across independently segmented multi-view videos. We address this challenge by introducing per-video label-permutation latents that learn cross-video instance matches through a differentiable Sinkhorn layer, enabling direct multi-view supervision with consistent identity preservation. This explicit label alignment yields sharp decision boundaries and temporally stable identities without identity drift. To further improve efficiency, we propose instance-decomposed motion scaffolds that provide low-dimensional motion bases per object for long-horizon trajectory optimization. Experiments on Panoptic Studio and Neural3DV show that Inst4DGS jointly supports tracking and instance decomposition while achieving state-of-the-art rendering and segmentation quality. On the Panoptic Studio dataset, Inst4DGS improves PSNR from 26.10 to 28.36, and instance mIoU from 0.6310 to 0.9129, over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: Inst4DGS提出了一种实例分解的4D高斯泼溅方法，通过标签排列潜在变量和可微Sinkhorn层解决多视角视频实例标签不一致问题，支持长时程轨迹优化，在渲染和分割质量上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 动态4DGS发展迅速，但实例分解的4DGS仍未被充分探索，主要挑战在于如何关联独立分割的多视角视频中不一致的实例标签。
AI.method: 1) 引入每个视频的标签排列潜在变量，通过可微Sinkhorn层学习跨视频实例匹配，实现具有一致身份保持的多视角监督；2) 提出实例分解的运动支架，为每个对象提供低维运动基，用于长时程轨迹优化。
AI.result: 在Panoptic Studio和Neural3DV数据集上，Inst4DGS同时支持跟踪和实例分解，达到最先进的渲染和分割质量。在Panoptic Studio上，PSNR从26.10提升到28.36，实例mIoU从0.6310提升到0.9129。
AI.conclusion: Inst4DGS通过显式的标签对齐产生清晰的决策边界和时间稳定的身份，避免了身份漂移，为实例分解的4D高斯泼溅提供了有效的解决方案。

title: From Noise to Signal: When Outliers Seed New Topics
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 15th Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026)
summary: Outliers in dynamic topic modeling are typically treated as noise, yet we show that some can serve as early signals of emerging topics. We introduce a temporal taxonomy of news-document trajectories that defines how documents relate to topic formation over time. It distinguishes anticipatory outliers, which precede the topics they later join, from documents that either reinforce existing topics or remain isolated. By capturing these trajectories, the taxonomy links weak-signal detection with temporal topic modeling and clarifies how individual articles anticipate, initiate, or drift within evolving clusters. We implement it in a cumulative clustering setting using document embeddings from eleven state-of-the-art language models and evaluate it retrospectively on HydroNewsFr, a French news corpus on the hydrogen economy. Inter-model agreement reveals a small, high-consensus subset of anticipatory outliers, increasing confidence in these labels. Qualitative case studies further illustrate these trajectories through concrete topic developments.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种时间分类法，将新闻文档轨迹分为不同类型，特别是识别出能够预示新兴主题的"预期异常值"，而非简单地将异常值视为噪声。
AI.motivation: 传统动态主题建模通常将异常值视为噪声，但作者认为其中一些异常值实际上是新兴主题的早期信号，需要系统性地识别和分类这些文档轨迹。
AI.method: 引入时间分类法定义文档随时间与主题形成的关系，区分预期异常值、强化现有主题的文档和孤立文档。在累积聚类设置中使用11个最先进语言模型的文档嵌入实现，并在HydroNewsFr法语新闻语料库上进行回顾性评估。
AI.result: 模型间一致性分析揭示了一个小而高共识的预期异常值子集，增加了这些标签的可信度。定性案例研究通过具体主题发展进一步说明了这些轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该时间分类法将弱信号检测与时间主题建模联系起来，阐明了个别文章如何在演化聚类中预期、启动或漂移，为识别新兴主题提供了新视角。

title: Synthetic Data Generation for Training Diversified Commonsense Reasoning Models
summary: Conversational agents are required to respond to their users not only with high quality (i.e. commonsense bearing) responses, but also considering multiple plausible alternative scenarios, reflecting the diversity in their responses. Despite the growing need to train diverse commonsense generators, the progress of this line of work has been significantly hindered by the lack of large-scale high-quality diverse commonsense training datasets. Due to the high annotation costs, existing Generative Commonsense Reasoning (GCR) datasets are created using a small number of human annotators, covering only a narrow set of commonsense scenarios. To address this training resource gap, we propose a two-stage method to create the first-ever synthetic dataset CommonSyn for diversified (GCR). The model fine-tuned on our synthetic data jointly increase both generation diversity and quality compared with vanilla models and the model fine-tuned on human-crafted dataset across different size Large Language Models (LLMs)

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段方法创建首个合成数据集CommonSyn，用于多样化生成式常识推理，提升模型生成多样性和质量
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏大规模高质量多样化常识训练数据集，现有数据集标注成本高、覆盖场景有限，阻碍了多样化常识生成器的训练进展
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法创建合成数据集CommonSyn：第一阶段生成多样化常识场景，第二阶段进行质量筛选和优化
AI.result: 在CommonSyn上微调的模型相比原始模型和在人工标注数据集上微调的模型，在不同规模的大语言模型中均能同时提高生成多样性和质量
AI.conclusion: 提出的合成数据集创建方法有效解决了多样化常识推理训练资源不足的问题，为开发更优秀的多样化对话代理提供了重要工具

title: SynQ: Accurate Zero-shot Quantization by Synthesis-aware Fine-tuning
summary: How can we accurately quantize a pre-trained model without any data? Quantization algorithms are widely used for deploying neural networks on resource-constrained edge devices. Zero-shot Quantization (ZSQ) addresses the crucial and practical scenario where training data are inaccessible for privacy or security reasons. However, three significant challenges hinder the performance of existing ZSQ methods: 1) noise in the synthetic dataset, 2) predictions based on off-target patterns, and the 3) misguidance by erroneous hard labels. In this paper, we propose SynQ (Synthesis-aware Fine-tuning for Zero-shot Quantization), a carefully designed ZSQ framework to overcome the limitations of existing methods. SynQ minimizes the noise from the generated samples by exploiting a low-pass filter. Then, SynQ trains the quantized model to improve accuracy by aligning its class activation map with the pre-trained model. Furthermore, SynQ mitigates misguidance from the pre-trained model's error by leveraging only soft labels for difficult samples. Extensive experiments show that SynQ provides the state-of-the-art accuracy, over existing ZSQ methods.

AI.tldr: SynQ是一个无数据量化框架，通过低通滤波器减少合成数据噪声，对齐量化模型与预训练模型的类激活图，并使用软标签避免错误硬标签误导，在零样本量化任务中达到最先进精度。
AI.motivation: 解决零样本量化中的三个关键挑战：合成数据中的噪声、基于离靶模式的预测、以及错误硬标签的误导。这些挑战限制了现有ZSQ方法的性能，特别是在隐私或安全原因导致训练数据不可访问的实际场景中。
AI.method: SynQ框架包含三个核心组件：1) 使用低通滤波器最小化生成样本的噪声；2) 通过对齐量化模型与预训练模型的类激活图来提升精度；3) 对困难样本仅使用软标签来减轻预训练模型错误的误导。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SynQ在零样本量化任务中提供了最先进的精度，超越了现有的ZSQ方法。
AI.conclusion: SynQ通过系统解决零样本量化中的三个主要挑战，有效提升了无数据场景下的模型量化性能，为资源受限边缘设备上的神经网络部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: PowerFlow: Unlocking the Dual Nature of LLMs via Principled Distribution Matching
summary: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) has emerged as a promising paradigm for eliciting the latent capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) without external supervision. However, current methods rely on heuristic intrinsic rewards, which often lack a well-defined theoretical optimization target and are prone to degenerative biases. In this work, we introduce PowerFlow, a principled framework that reformulates unsupervised fine-tuning as a distribution matching problem. By casting GFlowNet as an amortized variational sampler for unnormalized densities, we propose a length-aware Trajectory-Balance objective that explicitly neutralizes the structural length biases inherent in autoregressive generation. By targeting $α$-power distributions, PowerFlow enables the directional elicitation of the dual nature of LLMs: sharpening the distribution ($α> 1$) to intensify logical reasoning, or flattening it ($α< 1$) to unlock expressive creativity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PowerFlow consistently outperforms existing RLIF methods, matching or even exceeding supervised GRPO. Furthermore, by mitigating over-sharpening in aligned models, our approach achieves simultaneous gains in diversity and quality, shifting the Pareto frontier in creative tasks.

AI.tldr: PowerFlow是一个基于分布匹配的无监督强化学习框架，通过GFlowNet作为变分采样器，使用长度感知的轨迹平衡目标来消除自回归生成中的结构长度偏差，实现对LLM逻辑推理和创造性表达的双重激发。
AI.motivation: 当前无监督强化学习方法依赖启发式内在奖励，缺乏明确的理论优化目标且容易产生退化性偏差。需要一种原则性框架来更好地激发大型语言模型的潜在能力。
AI.method: 将无监督微调重新表述为分布匹配问题，将GFlowNet作为未归一化密度的摊销变分采样器，提出长度感知的轨迹平衡目标来中和自回归生成中的结构长度偏差，通过α-power分布实现对LLM双重特性的定向激发。
AI.result: PowerFlow在实验中持续优于现有的RLIF方法，匹配甚至超过有监督的GRPO。通过缓解对齐模型中的过度锐化问题，在创造性任务中同时提高了多样性和质量，推动了帕累托前沿的移动。
AI.conclusion: PowerFlow提供了一个原则性框架，通过分布匹配和长度偏差中和，能够定向激发大型语言模型的逻辑推理能力和创造性表达，在无监督强化学习领域取得了显著进展。

title: From Weak Cues to Real Identities: Evaluating Inference-Driven De-Anonymization in LLM Agents
summary: Anonymization is widely treated as a practical safeguard because re-identifying anonymous records was historically costly, requiring domain expertise, tailored algorithms, and manual corroboration. We study a growing privacy risk that may weaken this barrier: LLM-based agents can autonomously reconstruct real-world identities from scattered, individually non-identifying cues. By combining these sparse cues with public information, agents resolve identities without bespoke engineering. We formalize this threat as \emph{inference-driven linkage} and systematically evaluate it across three settings: classical linkage scenarios (Netflix and AOL), \emph{InferLink} (a controlled benchmark varying task intent, shared cues, and attacker knowledge), and modern text-rich artifacts. Without task-specific heuristics, agents successfully execute both fixed-pool matching and open-ended identity resolution. In the Netflix Prize setting, an agent reconstructs 79.2\% of identities, significantly outperforming a 56.0\% classical baseline. Furthermore, linkage emerges not only under explicit adversarial prompts but also as a byproduct of benign cross-source analysis in \emph{InferLink} and unstructured research narratives. These findings establish that identity inference -- not merely explicit information disclosure -- must be treated as a first-class privacy risk; evaluations must measure what identities an agent can infer.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体能够从分散的非识别性线索中自主重建真实身份，这种推理驱动的链接威胁显著降低了匿名化的保护效果。
AI.motivation: 传统匿名化依赖于重新识别成本高昂的假设，但LLM智能体的出现可能削弱这一屏障，因为它们能够自主地从分散线索中重建身份，而无需专门工程化。
AI.method: 将威胁形式化为"推理驱动的链接"，在三个场景中系统评估：经典链接场景（Netflix和AOL）、受控基准InferLink（变化任务意图、共享线索和攻击者知识）以及现代文本丰富的工件。
AI.result: 在Netflix Prize场景中，智能体成功重建79.2%的身份，显著优于56.0%的经典基线。链接不仅出现在明确的对抗性提示下，也作为良性跨源分析和非结构化研究叙述的副产品出现。
AI.conclusion: 身份推理——不仅仅是明确的信息披露——必须被视为一级隐私风险；评估必须衡量智能体能够推断出什么身份。

title: AutoScreen-FW: An LLM-based Framework for Resume Screening
summary: Corporate recruiters often need to screen many resumes within a limited time, which increases their burden and may cause suitable candidates to be overlooked. To address these challenges, prior work has explored LLM-based automated resume screening. However, some methods rely on commercial LLMs, which may pose data privacy risks. Moreover, since companies typically do not make resumes with evaluation results publicly available, it remains unclear which resume samples should be used during learning to improve an LLM's judgment performance. To address these problems, we propose AutoScreen-FW, an LLM-based locally and automatically resume screening framework. AutoScreen-FW uses several methods to select a small set of representative resume samples. These samples are used for in-context learning together with a persona description and evaluation criteria, enabling open-source LLMs to act as a career advisor and evaluate unseen resumes. Experiments with multiple ground truths show that the open-source LLM judges consistently outperform GPT-5-nano. Under one ground truth setting, it also surpass GPT-5-mini. Although it is slightly weaker than GPT-5-mini under other ground-truth settings, it runs substantially faster per resume than commercial GPT models. These findings indicate the potential for deploying AutoScreen-FW locally in companies to support efficient screening while reducing recruiters' burden.

AI.tldr: AutoScreen-FW是一个基于开源LLM的本地自动简历筛选框架，通过选择代表性简历样本进行上下文学习，让LLM扮演职业顾问角色，在保护数据隐私的同时提高筛选效率。
AI.motivation: 企业招聘人员需要在有限时间内筛选大量简历，负担重且可能错过合适候选人。现有LLM方法依赖商业模型存在数据隐私风险，且缺乏公开的带评估结果的简历样本用于学习。
AI.method: 提出AutoScreen-FW框架，使用多种方法选择少量代表性简历样本，结合角色描述和评估标准进行上下文学习，使开源LLM能够扮演职业顾问评估未见过的简历。
AI.result: 实验表明，开源LLM在多个基准测试中一致优于GPT-5-nano，在一种基准设置下甚至超过GPT-5-mini。虽然在其他基准设置下略逊于GPT-5-mini，但处理每份简历的速度显著快于商业GPT模型。
AI.conclusion: AutoScreen-FW有潜力在企业本地部署，支持高效简历筛选，减轻招聘人员负担，同时保护数据隐私。

title: Reflection in the Dark: Exposing and Escaping the Black Box in Reflective Prompt Optimization
summary: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving LLM performance without manual prompt engineering. Reflective APO methods such as GEPA iteratively refine prompts by diagnosing failure cases, but the optimization process remains black-box and label-free, leading to uninterpretable trajectories and systematic failure. We identify and empirically demonstrate four limitations: on GSM8K with a defective seed, GEPA degrades accuracy from 23.81% to 13.50%. We propose VISTA, a multi-agent APO framework that decouples hypothesis generation from prompt rewriting, enabling semantically labeled hypotheses, parallel minibatch verification, and interpretable optimization trace. A two-layer explore-exploit mechanism combining random restart and epsilon-greedy sampling further escapes local optima. VISTA recovers accuracy to 87.57% on the same defective seed and consistently outperforms baselines across all conditions on GSM8K and AIME2025.

AI.tldr: VISTA是一个多智能体自动提示优化框架，通过解耦假设生成与提示重写，结合探索-利用机制，显著提升了LLM性能，在GSM8K和AIME2025上优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有反射式自动提示优化方法（如GEPA）存在黑盒优化、缺乏解释性、容易陷入局部最优等局限性，特别是在有缺陷的种子提示下性能会显著下降。
AI.method: 提出VISTA多智能体框架：1）解耦假设生成与提示重写；2）支持语义标记假设和并行小批量验证；3）采用两层探索-利用机制（随机重启和epsilon-greedy采样）避免局部最优；4）提供可解释的优化轨迹。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上，对有缺陷的种子提示，VISTA将准确率从GEPA的13.50%恢复到87.57%；在所有条件下，VISTA在GSM8K和AIME2025上都一致优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VISTA通过多智能体架构和探索-利用机制解决了现有自动提示优化方法的局限性，实现了更稳健、可解释和高效的提示优化。

title: AndroTMem: From Interaction Trajectories to Anchored Memory in Long-Horizon GUI Agents
summary: Long-horizon GUI agents are a key step toward real-world deployment, yet effective interaction memory under prevailing paradigms remains under-explored. Replaying full interaction sequences is redundant and amplifies noise, while summaries often erase dependency-critical information and traceability. We present AndroTMem, a diagnostic framework for anchored memory in long-horizon Android GUI agents. Its core benchmark, AndroTMem-Bench, comprises 1,069 tasks with 34,473 interaction steps (avg. 32.1 per task, max. 65). We evaluate agents with TCR (Task Complete Rate), focusing on tasks whose completion requires carrying forward critical intermediate state; AndroTMem-Bench is designed to enforce strong step-to-step causal dependencies, making sparse yet essential intermediate states decisive for downstream actions and centering interaction memory in evaluation. Across open- and closed-source GUI agents, we observe a consistent pattern: as interaction sequences grow longer, performance drops are driven mainly by within-task memory failures, not isolated perception errors or local action mistakes. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose Anchored State Memory (ASM), which represents interaction sequences as a compact set of causally linked intermediate-state anchors to enable subgoal-targeted retrieval and attribution-aware decision making. Across multiple settings and 12 evaluated GUI agents, ASM consistently outperforms full-sequence replay and summary-based baselines, improving TCR by 5%-30.16% and AMS by 4.93%-24.66%, indicating that anchored, structured memory effectively mitigates the interaction-memory bottleneck in long-horizon GUI tasks. The code, benchmark, and related resources are publicly available at [https://github.com/CVC2233/AndroTMem](https://github.com/CVC2233/AndroTMem).

AI.tldr: AndroTMem是一个用于长时程Android GUI智能体的诊断框架，包含包含1069个任务、34473个交互步骤的基准测试，发现随着交互序列变长，性能下降主要由任务内记忆失败引起，而非感知或局部动作错误。提出的锚定状态记忆（ASM）方法通过因果链接的中间状态锚点表示交互序列，在12个GUI智能体上相比完整序列重放和摘要基线提升了5%-30.16%的任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 当前长时程GUI智能体的交互记忆机制存在不足：完整交互序列重放冗余且放大噪声，而摘要方法往往抹除依赖关键信息和可追溯性。需要一种更有效的交互记忆方法来支持长时程GUI任务。
AI.method: 提出了AndroTMem诊断框架，包含AndroTMem-Bench基准测试（1069个任务，34473个交互步骤，平均32.1步/任务）。基于诊断结果，提出锚定状态记忆（ASM）方法，将交互序列表示为紧凑的因果链接中间状态锚点集合，支持子目标导向的检索和归因感知的决策制定。
AI.result: 在12个GUI智能体上的评估显示，ASM相比完整序列重放和摘要基线，任务完成率（TCR）提升5%-30.16%，AMS提升4.93%-24.66%。基准测试发现随着交互序列变长，性能下降主要由任务内记忆失败引起，而非感知或局部动作错误。
AI.conclusion: 锚定、结构化的记忆能有效缓解长时程GUI任务中的交互记忆瓶颈。ASM方法通过因果链接的中间状态锚点表示交互序列，在多个设置和GUI智能体上一致优于现有基线，为长时程GUI智能体的实际部署提供了有效的记忆解决方案。

title: TopoChunker: Topology-Aware Agentic Document Chunking Framework
summary: Current document chunking methods for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) typically linearize text. This forced linearization strips away intrinsic topological hierarchies, creating ``semantic fragmentation'' that degrades downstream retrieval quality. In this paper, we propose TopoChunker, an agentic framework that maps heterogeneous documents onto a Structured Intermediate Representation (SIR) to explicitly preserve cross-segment dependencies. To balance structural fidelity with computational cost, TopoChunker employs a dual-agent architecture. An Inspector Agent dynamically routes documents through cost-optimized extraction paths, while a Refiner Agent performs capacity auditing and topological context disambiguation to reconstruct hierarchical lineage. Evaluated on unstructured narratives (GutenQA) and complex reports (GovReport), TopoChunker demonstrates state-of-the-art performance. It outperforms the strongest LLM-based baseline by 8.0% in absolute generation accuracy and achieves an 83.26% Recall@3, while simultaneously reducing token overhead by 23.5%, offering a scalable approach for structure-aware RAG.

AI.tldr: TopoChunker是一个用于RAG的智能文档分块框架，通过结构化中间表示保留文档拓扑层次结构，解决传统线性分块导致的语义碎片化问题，在提升检索质量的同时减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG中的文档分块方法通常将文本线性化处理，这种强制线性化剥离了文档内在的拓扑层次结构，导致"语义碎片化"问题，从而降低了下游检索质量。
AI.method: TopoChunker采用双智能体架构：检查器智能体动态路由文档通过成本优化的提取路径；精炼器智能体执行容量审计和拓扑上下文消歧，以重建层次结构谱系。框架将异构文档映射到结构化中间表示来显式保留跨片段依赖关系。
AI.result: 在非结构化叙事（GutenQA）和复杂报告（GovReport）上的评估显示，TopoChunker实现了最先进的性能：比最强的基于LLM的基线在生成准确率上绝对提升8.0%，Recall@3达到83.26%，同时减少23.5%的token开销。
AI.conclusion: TopoChunker提供了一种可扩展的结构感知RAG方法，在保持结构保真度的同时平衡计算成本，有效解决了文档分块中的语义碎片化问题。

title: From Topic to Transition Structure: Unsupervised Concept Discovery at Corpus Scale via Predictive Associative Memory
summary: Embedding models group text by semantic content, what text is about. We show that temporal co-occurrence within texts discovers a different kind of structure: recurrent transition-structure concepts or what text does. We train a 29.4M-parameter contrastive model on 373 million co-occurrence pairs from 9,766 Project Gutenberg texts (24.96 million passages), mapping pre-trained embeddings into an association space where passages with similar transition structure cluster together. Under capacity constraint (42.75% accuracy), the model must compress across recurring patterns rather than memorise individual co-occurrences. Clustering at six granularities (k=50 to k=2,000) produces a multi-resolution concept map; from broad modes like "direct confrontation" and "lyrical meditation" to precise registers and scene templates like "sailor dialect" and "courtroom cross-examination." At k=100, clusters average 4,508 books each (of 9,766), confirming corpus-wide patterns. Direct comparison with embedding-similarity clustering shows that raw embeddings group by topic while association-space clusters group by function, register, and literary tradition. Unseen novels are assigned to existing clusters without retraining; the association model concentrates each novel into a selective subset of coherent clusters, while raw embedding assignment saturates nearly all clusters. Validation controls address positional, length, and book-concentration confounds. The method extends Predictive Associative Memory (PAM, arXiv:2602.11322) from episodic recall to concept formation: where PAM recalls specific associations, multi-epoch contrastive training under compression extracts structural patterns that transfer to unseen texts, the same framework producing qualitatively different behaviour in a different regime.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过文本内时间共现训练对比模型，从预训练嵌入中提取文本的过渡结构概念（文本做什么），而非语义内容（文本关于什么），形成多粒度概念图谱
AI.motivation: 传统嵌入模型基于语义内容对文本进行分组，但文本内的时间共现能揭示另一种结构：反复出现的过渡结构概念，即文本的功能和模式
AI.method: 在3730万个共现对上训练2940万参数的对比模型，将预训练嵌入映射到关联空间，在容量约束下压缩重复模式而非记忆单个共现，通过k=50到2000的聚类创建多分辨率概念图谱
AI.result: 模型在容量约束下达到42.75%准确率，聚类产生从"直接对抗"、"抒情冥想"等广泛模式到"水手方言"、"法庭交叉询问"等具体模板的多粒度概念，k=100时每个聚类平均包含4508本书，证实了语料库范围的模式
AI.conclusion: 关联空间聚类按功能、语域和文学传统分组，而非按主题分组，该方法将预测性关联记忆从情景回忆扩展到概念形成，在压缩下提取可迁移到未见文本的结构模式

title: SR-Nav: Spatial Relationships Matter for Zero-shot Object Goal Navigation
summary: Zero-shot object-goal navigation aims to find target objects in unseen environments using only egocentric observation. Recent methods leverage foundation models' comprehension and reasoning capabilities to enhance navigation performance. However, when faced with poor viewpoints or weak semantic cues, foundation models often fail to support reliable reasoning in both perception and planning, resulting in inefficient or failed navigation. We observe that inherent relationships among objects and regions encode structured scene priors, which help agents infer plausible target locations even under partial observations. Motivated by this insight, we propose Spatial Relation-aware Navigation (SR-Nav), a framework that models both observed and experience-based spatial relationships to enhance both perception and planning. Specifically, SR-Nav first constructs a Dynamic Spatial Relationship Graph (DSRG) that encodes the target-centered spatial relationships through the foundation models and updates dynamically with real-time observations. We then introduce a Relation-aware Matching Module. It utilizes relationship matching instead of naive detection, leveraging diverse relationships in the DSRG to verify and correct errors, enhancing visual perception robustness. Finally, we design a Dynamic Relationship Planning Module to reduce the planning search space by dynamically computing the optimal paths based on the DSRG from the current position, thereby guiding planning and reducing exploration redundancy. Experiments on HM3D show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both success rate and navigation efficiency. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/Mzyw-1314/SR-Nav

AI.tldr: SR-Nav提出了一种空间关系感知的零样本目标导航框架，通过建模目标为中心的空间关系图来增强感知和规划能力，在HM3D数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于基础模型的零样本目标导航方法在面对较差视角或弱语义线索时，感知和规划能力不可靠，导致导航效率低或失败。作者观察到物体和区域之间的内在关系编码了结构化场景先验，可以帮助智能体在部分观测下推断合理的目标位置。
AI.method: 提出了空间关系感知导航框架SR-Nav：1）构建动态空间关系图（DSRG），通过基础模型编码以目标为中心的空间关系，并随实时观测动态更新；2）关系感知匹配模块，利用关系匹配而非简单检测，通过DSRG中的多样化关系验证和纠正错误，增强视觉感知鲁棒性；3）动态关系规划模块，基于DSRG从当前位置动态计算最优路径，减少规划搜索空间，指导规划并减少探索冗余。
AI.result: 在HM3D数据集上的实验表明，该方法在成功率和导航效率方面都达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过建模观察到的和基于经验的空间关系，SR-Nav框架能够有效增强零样本目标导航中的感知和规划能力，在复杂环境中实现更可靠和高效的导航。

title: Prune-then-Quantize or Quantize-then-Prune? Understanding the Impact of Compression Order in Joint Model Compression
summary: What happens when multiple compression methods are combined-does the order in which they are applied matter? Joint model compression has emerged as a powerful strategy to achieve higher efficiency by combining multiple methods such as pruning and quantization. A central but underexplored factor in joint model compression is the compression order, or the sequence of different methods within the compression pipeline. Most prior studies have either sidestepped the issue by assuming orthogonality between techniques, while a few have examined them only in highly constrained cases. Consequently, the broader role of compression order in shaping model performance remains poorly understood. In this paper, we address the overlooked problem of compression order and provide both theoretical and empirical analysis. We formulate the problem of optimizing the compression order and introduce the Progressive Intensity Hypothesis, which states that weaker perturbations should precede stronger ones. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that the relative benefit of one order increases with the underlying performance gap. Extensive experiments on both language and vision models validate the hypothesis, and further show its generality to broader setups such as multi-stage compression and mixed-precision quantization.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨了联合模型压缩中压缩顺序的重要性，提出了渐进强度假设，并通过理论和实验验证了压缩顺序对模型性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多假设不同压缩技术之间是正交的，忽略了压缩顺序的重要性，导致对联合模型压缩中压缩顺序的作用理解不足。本文旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 1. 形式化压缩顺序优化问题；2. 提出渐进强度假设：较弱的扰动应该先于较强的扰动；3. 提供理论保证；4. 在语言和视觉模型上进行广泛实验验证。
AI.result: 实验验证了渐进强度假设的正确性，并展示了该假设在更广泛设置下的通用性，包括多阶段压缩和混合精度量化。
AI.conclusion: 压缩顺序在联合模型压缩中起着重要作用，渐进强度假设为压缩顺序选择提供了理论指导，能够显著影响最终模型性能。

title: Learning Consistent Temporal Grounding between Related Tasks in Sports Coaching
summary: Video-LLMs often attend to irrelevant frames, which is especially detrimental for sports coaching tasks requiring precise temporal grounding. Yet obtaining frame-level supervision is challenging: expensive to collect from humans and unreliable from other models. We improve temporal grounding without additional annotations by exploiting the observation that related tasks, such as generation and verification, must attend to the same frames. We enforce this via a self-consistency objective over select visual attention maps of tightly-related tasks. Using VidDiffBench, which provides ground-truth keyframe annotations, we first validate that attention misallocation is a significant bottleneck. We then show that training with our objective yields gains of +3.0%, +14.1% accuracy and +0.9 BERTScore over supervised finetuning across three sports coaching tasks: Exact, FitnessQA, and ExpertAF, even surpassing closed-source models.

AI.tldr: 通过自一致性目标改进视频LLMs的时间定位，无需额外标注，在体育教练任务中显著提升性能
AI.motivation: 视频LLMs经常关注不相关的帧，这对需要精确时间定位的体育教练任务尤其不利。获取帧级监督既昂贵（人工标注）又不可靠（其他模型），因此需要一种无需额外标注的改进方法。
AI.method: 利用相关任务（如生成和验证）必须关注相同帧的观察，通过对紧密相关任务的选择性视觉注意力图施加自一致性目标来改进时间定位。
AI.result: 在VidDiffBench上验证注意力分配错误是主要瓶颈。使用该方法在三个体育教练任务（Exact、FitnessQA、ExpertAF）上相比监督微调分别获得+3.0%、+14.1%准确率和+0.9 BERTScore的提升，甚至超过闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过自一致性目标利用任务间注意力一致性，可以有效改进视频LLMs的时间定位能力，无需额外标注，在体育教练任务中取得显著性能提升。

title: Multimodal Task Interference: A Benchmark and Analysis of History-Target Mismatch in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Task interference, the performance degradation caused by task switches within a single conversation, has been studied exclusively in text-only settings despite the growing prevalence of multimodal dialogue systems. We introduce a benchmark for evaluating this phenomenon in multimodal LLMs, covering six tasks across text and vision with systematic variation of history-target along three axes: modality mismatch, reasoning mismatch, and answer format mismatch. Experiments on both open-weights and proprietary models reveal that task interference is highly directional: switching from text-only to image-based targets causes severe performance drops, while the reverse transition yields minimal degradation. Interference is further amplified when mismatches co-occur across multiple dimensions, and is driven most strongly by modality differences, followed by answer format, while reasoning requirement shifts cause minimal degradation.

AI.tldr: 多模态对话系统中任务干扰的评估基准，发现文本到图像切换导致严重性能下降，而反向切换影响最小
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态对话系统日益普及，但任务干扰（单次对话中任务切换导致的性能下降）研究仅限于纯文本环境，需要扩展到多模态场景
AI.method: 引入多模态LLMs任务干扰评估基准，涵盖文本和视觉的六个任务，系统性地在三个维度上变化历史-目标：模态不匹配、推理不匹配和答案格式不匹配
AI.result: 实验显示任务干扰具有高度方向性：从纯文本切换到基于图像的目标导致严重性能下降，而反向切换影响最小；多维度不匹配共同出现时干扰加剧；干扰主要由模态差异驱动，其次是答案格式，推理要求变化影响最小
AI.conclusion: 多模态对话系统中任务干扰存在显著方向性，模态差异是主要驱动因素，这为多模态LLMs的优化提供了重要见解

title: AS2 -- Attention-Based Soft Answer Sets: An End-to-End Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Reasoning Architecture
summary: Neuro-symbolic artificial intelligence (AI) systems typically couple a neural perception module to a discrete symbolic solver through a non-differentiable boundary, preventing constraint-satisfaction feedback from reaching the perception encoder during training. We introduce AS2 (Attention-Based Soft Answer Sets), a fully differentiable neuro-symbolic architecture that replaces the discrete solver with a soft, continuous approximation of the Answer Set Programming (ASP) immediate consequence operator $T_P$. AS2 maintains per-position probability distributions over a finite symbol domain throughout the forward pass and trains end-to-end by minimizing the fixed-point residual of a probabilistic lift of $T_P$, thereby differentiating through the constraint check without invoking an external solver at either training or inference time. The architecture is entirely free of conventional positional embeddings. Instead, it encodes problem structure through constraint-group membership embeddings that directly reflect the declarative ASP specification, making the model agnostic to arbitrary position indexing. On Visual Sudoku, AS2 achieves 99.89% cell accuracy and 100% constraint satisfaction (verified by Clingo) across 1,000 test boards, using a greedy constrained decoding procedure that requires no external solver. On MNIST Addition with $N \in \{2, 4, 8\}$ addends, AS2 achieves digit accuracy above 99.7% across all scales. These results demonstrate that a soft differentiable fixpoint operator, combined with constraint-aware attention and declarative constraint specification, can match or exceed pipeline and solver-based neuro-symbolic systems while maintaining full end-to-end differentiability.

AI.tldr: AS2是一种完全可微的神经符号架构，用软连续近似替代离散求解器，通过最小化固定点残差实现端到端训练，无需外部求解器。
AI.motivation: 传统神经符号AI系统在神经感知模块和离散符号求解器之间存在不可微边界，阻碍了训练期间约束满足反馈传递到感知编码器。
AI.method: 引入基于注意力的软答案集(AS2)，用软连续近似替代ASP立即后果算子T_P，通过最小化概率提升的T_P固定点残差进行端到端训练，使用约束组成员嵌入编码问题结构。
AI.result: 在Visual Sudoku上达到99.89%单元格准确率和100%约束满足率；在MNIST Addition上所有规模的数字准确率超过99.7%。
AI.conclusion: 软可微固定点算子结合约束感知注意力和声明式约束规范，能够匹配或超越传统管道和基于求解器的神经符号系统，同时保持完全端到端可微性。

title: Interpretable Prostate Cancer Detection using a Small Cohort of MRI Images
summary: Prostate cancer is a leading cause of mortality in men, yet interpretation of T2-weighted prostate MRI remains challenging due to subtle and heterogeneous lesions. We developed an interpretable framework for automatic cancer detection using a small dataset of 162 T2-weighted images (102 cancer, 60 normal), addressing data scarcity through transfer learning and augmentation. We performed a comprehensive comparison of Vision Transformers (ViT, Swin), CNNs (ResNet18), and classical methods (Logistic Regression, SVM, HOG+SVM). Transfer-learned ResNet18 achieved the best performance (90.9% accuracy, 95.2% sensitivity, AUC 0.905) with only 11M parameters, while Vision Transformers showed lower performance despite substantially higher complexity. Notably, HOG+SVM achieved comparable accuracy (AUC 0.917), highlighting the effectiveness of handcrafted features in small datasets. Unlike state-of-the-art approaches relying on biparametric MRI (T2+DWI) and large cohorts, our method achieves competitive performance using only T2-weighted images, reducing acquisition complexity and computational cost. In a reader study of 22 cases, five radiologists achieved a mean sensitivity of 67.5% (Fleiss Kappa = 0.524), compared to 95.2% for the AI model, suggesting potential for AI-assisted screening to reduce missed cancers and improve consistency. Code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于小数据集的T2加权前列腺MRI自动癌症检测框架，通过迁移学习和数据增强解决数据稀缺问题，发现迁移学习的ResNet18性能最佳，而传统HOG+SVM方法也表现出色，AI模型在读者研究中显著优于放射科医生。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌是男性主要死因，但T2加权前列腺MRI解释具有挑战性，因为病变细微且异质性高。现有方法通常需要双参数MRI（T2+DWI）和大规模数据集，本研究旨在开发仅使用T2加权图像且适用于小数据集的自动癌症检测方法。
AI.method: 使用162张T2加权图像（102癌症，60正常）的小数据集，通过迁移学习和数据增强解决数据稀缺问题。系统比较了Vision Transformers（ViT、Swin）、CNN（ResNet18）和传统方法（逻辑回归、SVM、HOG+SVM）。进行了包含22个病例的读者研究，比较5名放射科医生与AI模型的性能。
AI.result: 迁移学习的ResNet18获得最佳性能（准确率90.9%，敏感性95.2%，AUC 0.905），仅需1100万参数。Vision Transformers性能较低但复杂度更高。HOG+SVM达到可比性能（AUC 0.917）。在读者研究中，放射科医生平均敏感性67.5%（Fleiss Kappa=0.524），而AI模型敏感性95.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明在小数据集上，迁移学习的CNN和传统手工特征方法都能有效检测前列腺癌，仅使用T2加权图像即可达到竞争性性能。AI辅助筛查有潜力减少漏诊并提高一致性，特别是在资源有限的环境中。

title: Adaptive Decoding via Test-Time Policy Learning for Self-Improving Generation
summary: Decoding strategies largely determine the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs, yet widely used heuristics such as greedy or fixed temperature/top-p decoding are static and often task-agnostic, leading to suboptimal or inconsistent generation quality across domains that demand stylistic or structural flexibility. We introduce a reinforcement learning-based decoder sampler that treats decoding as sequential decision-making and learns a lightweight policy to adjust sampling parameters at test-time while keeping LLM weights frozen. We evaluated summarization datasets including BookSum, arXiv, and WikiHow using Granite-3.3-2B and Qwen-2.5-0.5B. Our policy sampler consistently outperforms greedy and static baselines, achieving relative gains of up to +88% (BookSum, Granite) and +79% (WikiHow, Qwen). Reward ablations show that overlap-only objectives underperform compared to composite rewards, while structured shaping terms (length, coverage, repetition, completeness) enable stable and sustained improvements. These findings highlight reinforcement learning as a practical mechanism for test-time adaptation in decoding, enabling domain-aware and user-controllable generation without retraining large models.

AI.tldr: 提出基于强化学习的解码器采样器，将解码视为序列决策过程，学习轻量级策略在测试时调整采样参数，保持LLM权重不变，在多个摘要数据集上显著优于传统静态解码方法。
AI.motivation: 现有解码策略（如贪婪解码或固定温度/top-p解码）是静态且任务无关的，导致在不同领域需要风格或结构灵活性时生成质量不理想或不一致，需要更灵活的自适应解码方法。
AI.method: 使用强化学习框架，将解码过程建模为序列决策问题，训练轻量级策略网络在测试时动态调整采样参数（如温度、top-p等），同时保持大型语言模型的权重冻结不变。
AI.result: 在BookSum、arXiv和WikiHow等摘要数据集上，使用Granite-3.3-2B和Qwen-2.5-0.5B模型评估，策略采样器相比贪婪和静态基线有显著提升，相对增益最高达+88%（BookSum, Granite）和+79%（WikiHow, Qwen）。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习为解码过程中的测试时适应提供了实用机制，能够实现领域感知和用户可控的生成，无需重新训练大型模型，结构化奖励项（长度、覆盖率、重复性、完整性）对稳定持续改进至关重要。

title: AlignMamba-2: Enhancing Multimodal Fusion and Sentiment Analysis with Modality-Aware Mamba
summary: In the era of large-scale pre-trained models, effectively adapting general knowledge to specific affective computing tasks remains a challenge, particularly regarding computational efficiency and multimodal heterogeneity. While Transformer-based methods have excelled at modeling inter-modal dependencies, their quadratic computational complexity limits their use with long-sequence data. Mamba-based models have emerged as a computationally efficient alternative; however, their inherent sequential scanning mechanism struggles to capture the global, non-sequential relationships that are crucial for effective cross-modal alignment. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AlignMamba-2}, an effective and efficient framework for multimodal fusion and sentiment analysis. Our approach introduces a dual alignment strategy that regularizes the model using both Optimal Transport distance and Maximum Mean Discrepancy, promoting geometric and statistical consistency between modalities without incurring any inference-time overhead. More importantly, we design a Modality-Aware Mamba layer, which employs a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with modality-specific and modality-shared experts to explicitly handle data heterogeneity during the fusion process. Extensive experiments on four challenging benchmarks, including dynamic time-series (on the CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI datasets) and static image-related tasks (on the NYU-Depth V2 and MVSA-Single datasets), demonstrate that AlignMamba-2 establishes a new state-of-the-art in both effectiveness and efficiency across diverse pattern recognition tasks, ranging from dynamic time-series analysis to static image-text classification.

AI.tldr: AlignMamba-2是一个用于多模态融合和情感分析的高效框架，通过双对齐策略和模态感知Mamba层，在保持计算效率的同时提升跨模态对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 在大规模预训练模型时代，将通用知识有效适应到特定情感计算任务面临挑战，特别是在计算效率和多模态异质性方面。Transformer方法虽然擅长建模模态间依赖关系，但其二次计算复杂度限制了长序列数据处理；而Mamba模型虽然计算高效，但其顺序扫描机制难以捕捉跨模态对齐所需的全局非顺序关系。
AI.method: 提出AlignMamba-2框架：1）引入双对齐策略，使用最优传输距离和最大均值差异进行正则化，促进模态间的几何和统计一致性；2）设计模态感知Mamba层，采用混合专家架构，包含模态特定和模态共享专家，显式处理融合过程中的数据异质性。
AI.result: 在四个具有挑战性的基准测试（包括动态时间序列的CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI数据集，以及静态图像任务的NYU-Depth V2和MVSA-Single数据集）上进行广泛实验，结果表明AlignMamba-2在多样化的模式识别任务中（从动态时间序列分析到静态图像文本分类）在效果和效率上都达到了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: AlignMamba-2通过创新的双对齐策略和模态感知Mamba层设计，有效解决了多模态融合中的计算效率和异质性挑战，在保持高效性的同时显著提升了跨模态对齐能力，为多模态情感分析提供了新的解决方案。

title: UT-ACA: Uncertainty-Triggered Adaptive Context Allocation for Long-Context Inference
summary: Long-context inference remains challenging for large language models due to attention dilution and out-of-distribution degradation. Context selection mitigates this limitation by attending to a subset of key-value cache entries, yet most methods allocate a fixed context budget throughout decoding despite highly non-uniform token-level contextual demands. To address this issue, we propose Uncertainty-Triggered Adaptive Context Allocation (UT-ACA), an inference-time framework that dynamically adjusts the context window based on token-wise uncertainty. UT-ACA learns an uncertainty detector that combines semantic embeddings with logit-based confidence while accounting for uncertainty accumulation across decoding steps. When insufficient evidence is indicated, UT-ACA selectively rolls back, expands the context window, and regenerates the token with additional support. Experiments show that UT-ACA substantially reduces average context usage while preserving generation quality in long-context settings.

AI.tldr: 提出UT-ACA框架，通过基于不确定性的自适应上下文分配，动态调整长文本推理中的上下文窗口，减少平均上下文使用量同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 长文本推理对大型语言模型具有挑战性，主要因为注意力稀释和分布外退化。现有上下文选择方法在整个解码过程中分配固定的上下文预算，但忽略了不同token级别的上下文需求差异很大。
AI.method: 提出不确定性触发自适应上下文分配(UT-ACA)框架：1)学习结合语义嵌入和基于logit置信度的不确定性检测器；2)考虑解码步骤间不确定性的累积；3)当证据不足时，选择性回滚、扩展上下文窗口并重新生成token。
AI.result: 实验表明，UT-ACA在长文本设置中显著减少了平均上下文使用量，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.conclusion: UT-ACA通过动态调整上下文窗口，有效解决了长文本推理中的注意力稀释问题，实现了更高效的上下文使用。

title: Cognitive Mismatch in Multimodal Large Language Models for Discrete Symbol Understanding
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in interpreting natural scenes, their ability to process discrete symbols -- the fundamental building blocks of human cognition -- remains a critical open question. Unlike continuous visual data, symbols such as mathematical formulas, chemical structures, and linguistic characters require precise, deeper interpretation. This paper introduces a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate how top-tier MLLMs navigate these "discrete semantic spaces" across five domains: language, culture, mathematics, physics, and chemistry. Our investigation uncovers a counterintuitive phenomenon: models often fail at basic symbol recognition yet succeed in complex reasoning tasks, suggesting they rely on linguistic probability rather than true visual perception. By exposing this "cognitive mismatch", we highlight a significant gap in current AI capabilities: the struggle to truly perceive and understand the symbolic languages that underpin scientific discovery and abstract thought. This work offers a roadmap for developing more rigorous, human-aligned intelligent systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个评估多模态大语言模型处理离散符号能力的基准测试，发现模型在基础符号识别上表现不佳但在复杂推理任务中表现良好，揭示了模型依赖语言概率而非真正视觉感知的"认知不匹配"问题。
AI.motivation: 虽然多模态大语言模型在解释自然场景方面取得了显著成功，但它们在处理离散符号（人类认知的基本构建块）方面的能力仍然是一个关键未解问题。与连续视觉数据不同，数学公式、化学结构和语言字符等符号需要精确、深入的解释。
AI.method: 引入一个全面的基准测试，评估顶级多模态大语言模型在五个领域（语言、文化、数学、物理和化学）中导航"离散语义空间"的能力。通过系统性的评估揭示模型在处理离散符号时的表现模式。
AI.result: 研究发现了一个反直觉的现象：模型经常在基础符号识别上失败，却在复杂推理任务中成功，这表明它们依赖语言概率而非真正的视觉感知。这种"认知不匹配"暴露了当前AI能力的显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作强调了当前AI系统在真正感知和理解支撑科学发现和抽象思维的符号语言方面的困难，为开发更严谨、与人类对齐的智能系统提供了路线图。

title: Cross-Domain Demo-to-Code via Neurosymbolic Counterfactual Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled video-instructed robotic programming, allowing agents to interpret video demonstrations and generate executable control code. We formulate video-instructed robotic programming as a cross-domain adaptation problem, where perceptual and physical differences between demonstration and deployment induce procedural mismatches. However, current VLMs lack the procedural understanding needed to reformulate causal dependencies and achieve task-compatible behavior under such domain shifts. We introduce NeSyCR, a neurosymbolic counterfactual reasoning framework that enables verifiable adaptation of task procedures, providing a reliable synthesis of code policies. NeSyCR abstracts video demonstrations into symbolic trajectories that capture the underlying task procedure. Given deployment observations, it derives counterfactual states that reveal cross-domain incompatibilities. By exploring the symbolic state space with verifiable checks, NeSyCR proposes procedural revisions that restore compatibility with the demonstrated procedure. NeSyCR achieves a 31.14% improvement in task success over the strongest baseline Statler, showing robust cross-domain adaptation across both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: NeSyCR是一个神经符号反事实推理框架，用于解决视频指导机器人编程中的跨域适应问题，通过抽象视频演示为符号轨迹、识别跨域不兼容性并验证性地调整程序，实现了比基线方法Statler高出31.14%的任务成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在视频指导机器人编程中缺乏程序理解能力，无法在演示和部署之间存在感知和物理差异时重新制定因果依赖关系，导致跨域适应时出现程序不匹配问题。
AI.method: NeSyCR框架将视频演示抽象为捕捉底层任务程序的符号轨迹，根据部署观察推导反事实状态以揭示跨域不兼容性，通过可验证检查探索符号状态空间，提出恢复与演示程序兼容性的程序修订。
AI.result: NeSyCR在模拟和现实世界操作任务中实现了强大的跨域适应能力，相比最强基线Statler，任务成功率提高了31.14%。
AI.conclusion: NeSyCR通过神经符号反事实推理框架，为视频指导机器人编程提供了可验证的任务程序适应方法，有效解决了跨域不兼容性问题，显著提升了任务成功率。

title: Recolour What Matters: Region-Aware Colour Editing via Token-Level Diffusion
summary: Colour is one of the most perceptually salient yet least controllable attributes in image generation. Although recent diffusion models can modify object colours from user instructions, their results often deviate from the intended hue, especially for fine-grained and local edits. Early text-driven methods rely on discrete language descriptions that cannot accurately represent continuous chromatic variations. To overcome this limitation, we propose ColourCrafter, a unified diffusion framework that transforms colour editing from global tone transfer into a structured, region-aware generation process. Unlike traditional colour driven methods, ColourCrafter performs token-level fusion of RGB colour tokens and image tokens in latent space, selectively propagating colour information to semantically relevant regions while preserving structural fidelity. A perceptual Lab-space Loss further enhances pixel-level precision by decoupling luminance and chrominance and constraining edits within masked areas. Additionally, we build ColourfulSet, a largescale dataset of high-quality image pairs with continuous and diverse colour variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ColourCrafter achieves state-of-the-art colour accuracy, controllability and perceptual fidelity in fine-grained colour editing. Our project is available at https://yangyuqi317.github.io/ColourCrafter.github.io/.

AI.tldr: ColourCrafter是一个统一的扩散框架，通过RGB颜色令牌与图像令牌的融合实现细粒度颜色编辑，解决了传统方法在连续色度变化和局部编辑上的不足。
AI.motivation: 颜色是图像生成中最显著但最难控制的属性之一。现有扩散模型虽然可以根据用户指令修改对象颜色，但结果常常偏离预期色调，特别是在细粒度和局部编辑方面。早期基于文本的方法依赖离散语言描述，无法准确表示连续的色度变化。
AI.method: 提出ColourCrafter框架：1）在潜在空间进行RGB颜色令牌和图像令牌的令牌级融合，选择性传播颜色信息到语义相关区域；2）使用感知Lab空间损失，解耦亮度和色度，将编辑约束在掩码区域内；3）构建ColourfulSet大规模高质量图像对数据集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ColourCrafter在细粒度颜色编辑中实现了最先进的颜色准确性、可控性和感知保真度。
AI.conclusion: ColourCrafter将颜色编辑从全局色调转移转变为结构化、区域感知的生成过程，显著提升了颜色编辑的精确度和可控性。

title: WASD: Locating Critical Neurons as Sufficient Conditions for Explaining and Controlling LLM Behavior
summary: Precise behavioral control of large language models (LLMs) is critical for complex applications. However, existing methods often incur high training costs, lack natural language controllability, or compromise semantic coherence. To bridge this gap, we propose WASD (unWeaving Actionable Sufficient Directives), a novel framework that explains model behavior by identifying sufficient neural conditions for token generation. Our method represents candidate conditions as neuron-activation predicates and iteratively searches for a minimal set that guarantees the current output under input perturbations. Experiments on SST-2 and CounterFact with the Gemma-2-2B model demonstrate that our approach produces explanations that are more stable, accurate, and concise than conventional attribution graphs. Moreover, through a case study on controlling cross-lingual output generation, we validated the practical effectiveness of WASD in controlling model behavior.

AI.tldr: WASD框架通过识别保证特定token生成的充分神经条件来解释LLM行为，相比传统归因图更稳定、准确、简洁，并能有效控制模型行为
AI.motivation: 现有方法在控制大型语言模型行为时存在训练成本高、缺乏自然语言可控性或损害语义连贯性的问题，需要更有效的模型行为解释和控制方法
AI.method: 提出WASD框架，将候选条件表示为神经元激活谓词，通过迭代搜索最小条件集，保证在输入扰动下当前输出的确定性
AI.result: 在SST-2和CounterFact数据集上使用Gemma-2-2B模型的实验表明，WASD产生的解释比传统归因图更稳定、准确、简洁；跨语言输出生成案例研究验证了其行为控制的实际有效性
AI.conclusion: WASD框架为大型语言模型提供了有效的神经条件解释方法，能够实现精确的行为控制，在模型可解释性和可控性方面具有实际应用价值

title: Expert Personas Improve LLM Alignment but Damage Accuracy: Bootstrapping Intent-Based Persona Routing with PRISM
summary: Persona prompting can steer LLM generation towards a domain-specific tone and pattern. This behavior enables use cases in multi-agent systems where diverse interactions are crucial and human-centered tasks require high-level human alignment. Prior works provide mixed opinions on their utility: some report performance gains when using expert personas for certain domains and their contribution to data diversity in synthetic data creation, while others find near-zero or negative impact on general utility. To fully leverage the benefits of the LLM persona and avoid its harmfulness, a more comprehensive investigation of the mechanism is crucial. In this work, we study how model optimization, task type, prompt length, and placement can impact expert persona effectiveness across instruction-tuned and reasoning LLMs, and provide insight into conditions under which expert personas fail and succeed. Based on our findings, we developed a pipeline to fully leverage the benefits of an expert persona, named PRISM (Persona Routing via Intent-based Self-Modeling), which self-distills an intent-conditioned expert persona into a gated LoRA adapter through a bootstrapping process that requires no external data, models, or knowledge. PRISM enhances human preference and safety alignment on generative tasks while maintaining accuracy on discriminative tasks across all models, with minimal memory and computing overhead.

AI.tldr: PRISM框架通过自蒸馏专家角色到门控LoRA适配器，提升LLM在生成任务中的人类偏好和安全对齐，同时保持判别任务准确性
AI.motivation: 角色提示可以引导LLM生成特定领域的语调和模式，但在多智能体系统和以人为中心的任务中，现有研究对角色提示的效用存在分歧，需要更全面的机制研究来充分利用其优势并避免负面影响
AI.method: 研究模型优化、任务类型、提示长度和位置对专家角色有效性的影响，开发PRISM框架（基于意图自建模的角色路由），通过自蒸馏将意图条件化的专家角色注入门控LoRA适配器，无需外部数据、模型或知识
AI.result: PRISM在生成任务中增强了人类偏好和安全对齐，同时在所有模型的判别任务中保持准确性，内存和计算开销最小
AI.conclusion: 通过系统研究角色提示机制并开发PRISM框架，成功实现了在保持判别任务准确性的同时，提升LLM在生成任务中的人类偏好和安全对齐能力

title: The Truncation Blind Spot: How Decoding Strategies Systematically Exclude Human-Like Token Choices
summary: Standard decoding strategies for text generation, including top-k, nucleus sampling, and contrastive search, select tokens based on likelihood, restricting selection to high-probability regions. Human language production operates differently: tokens are chosen for communicative appropriateness rather than statistical frequency. This mismatch creates a truncation blind spot: contextually appropriate but statistically rare tokens remain accessible to humans yet unreachable by likelihood-based decoding. We hypothesize this contributes to the detectability of machine-generated text. Analyzing over 1.8 million texts across eight language models, five decoding strategies, and 53 hyperparameter configurations, we find that 8-18% of human-selected tokens fall outside typical truncation boundaries. Simple classifiers trained on predictability and lexical diversity achieve remarkable detection rates. Crucially, neither model scale nor architecture correlates strongly with detectability; truncation parameters account for most variance. Configurations achieving low detectability often produce incoherent text, indicating that evading detection and producing natural text are distinct objectives. These findings suggest detectability is enhanced by likelihood-based token selection, not merely a matter of model capability.

AI.tldr: 研究发现基于似然性的解码策略（如top-k、核采样）与人类语言生成存在根本差异，导致机器生成文本容易被检测，这种可检测性主要源于解码策略而非模型能力本身。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索为什么机器生成的文本容易被检测到。现有解码策略基于统计概率选择token，而人类语言生成基于交际适宜性，这种不匹配可能导致机器文本的"截断盲点"。
AI.method: 方法包括：1）分析180万篇文本，涵盖8个语言模型、5种解码策略和53种超参数配置；2）比较人类选择的token与解码策略选择的token；3）训练基于可预测性和词汇多样性的简单分类器进行检测。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）8-18%的人类选择token落在典型截断边界之外；2）简单分类器能实现显著的检测率；3）模型规模和架构与可检测性相关性不强，截断参数解释了大部分方差；4）低可检测性配置往往产生不连贯文本。
AI.conclusion: 结论是文本可检测性主要源于基于似然性的token选择策略，而非模型能力本身。逃避检测和生成自然文本是不同的目标，当前解码策略在追求自然性时难以避免可检测性。

title: Correlation-Weighted Multi-Reward Optimization for Compositional Generation
summary: Text-to-image models produce images that align well with natural language prompts, but compositional generation has long been a central challenge. Models often struggle to satisfy multiple concepts within a single prompt, frequently omitting some concepts and resulting in partial success. Such failures highlight the difficulty of jointly optimizing multiple concepts during reward optimization, where competing concepts can interfere with one another. To address this limitation, we propose Correlation-Weighted Multi-Reward Optimization (\ours), a framework that leverages the correlation structure among concept rewards to adaptively weight each attribute concept in optimization. By accounting for interactions among concepts, \ours balances competing reward signals and emphasizes concepts that are partially satisfied yet inconsistently generated across samples, improving compositional generation. Specifically, we decompose multi-concept prompts into pre-defined concept groups (\eg, objects, attributes, and relations) and obtain reward signals from dedicated reward models for each concept. We then adaptively reweight these rewards, assigning higher weights to conflicting or hard-to-satisfy concepts using correlation-based difficulty estimation. By focusing optimization on the most challenging concepts within each group, \ours encourages the model to consistently satisfy all requested attributes simultaneously. We apply our approach to train state-of-the-art diffusion models, SD3.5 and FLUX.1-dev, and demonstrate consistent improvements on challenging multi-concept benchmarks, including ConceptMix, GenEval 2, and T2I-CompBench.

AI.tldr: 提出Correlation-Weighted Multi-Reward Optimization框架，通过相关性加权解决文本到图像生成中多概念组合的优化冲突问题
AI.motivation: 文本到图像模型在处理包含多个概念的提示时，经常出现概念遗漏或部分成功的问题，主要原因是多个概念在奖励优化过程中相互干扰
AI.method: 将多概念提示分解为预定义的概念组（如对象、属性、关系），为每个概念获取专用奖励模型的信号，然后基于相关性估计自适应地重新加权这些奖励，为冲突或难以满足的概念分配更高权重
AI.result: 在SD3.5和FLUX.1-dev等最先进的扩散模型上应用该方法，在ConceptMix、GenEval 2和T2I-CompBench等具有挑战性的多概念基准测试中取得了一致的改进
AI.conclusion: 通过考虑概念间的相关性结构并自适应加权，能够平衡竞争性奖励信号，强调部分满足但跨样本不一致生成的概念，从而改善组合生成能力

title: T-QPM: Enabling Temporal Out-Of-Distribution Detection and Domain Generalization for Vision-Language Models in Open-World
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains a critical challenge in open-world learning, where models must adapt to evolving data distributions. While recent vision-language models (VLMS) like CLIP enable multimodal OOD detection through Dual-Pattern Matching (DPM), existing methods typically suffer from two major shortcomings: (1) They rely on fixed fusion rules and assume static environments, failing under temporal drift; and (2) they lack robustness against covariate shifted inputs. In this paper, we propose a novel two-step framework to enhance OOD detection and covariate distribution shift robustness in dynamic settings. We extend the dual-pattern regime into Temporal Quadruple-Pattern Matching (T-QPM). First, by pairing OOD images with text descriptions, we introduce cross-modal consistency patterns between ID and OOD signals, refining the decision boundary through joint image-text reasoning. Second, we address temporal distribution shifts by learning lightweight fusion weights to optimally combine semantic matching and visual typicality. To ensure stability, we enforce explicit regularization based on Average Thresholded Confidence (ATC), preventing performance degradation as distributions evolve. Experiments on temporally partitioned benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms static baselines, offering a robust, temporally-consistent framework for multimodal OOD detection in non-stationary environments.

AI.tldr: 提出T-QPM框架，通过跨模态一致性模式和轻量级融合权重增强动态环境下的OOD检测和协变量分布偏移鲁棒性
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在OOD检测中存在两个主要问题：1）依赖固定融合规则，假设静态环境，无法应对时间漂移；2）缺乏对协变量偏移输入的鲁棒性
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：1）将OOD图像与文本描述配对，引入ID和OOD信号间的跨模态一致性模式，通过联合图像-文本推理细化决策边界；2）通过学习轻量级融合权重优化组合语义匹配和视觉典型性，并基于平均阈值置信度进行显式正则化确保稳定性
AI.result: 在时间划分基准测试中，该方法显著优于静态基线方法，为动态环境中的多模态OOD检测提供了鲁棒且时间一致的框架
AI.conclusion: 提出的T-QPM框架有效解决了动态环境中多模态OOD检测的挑战，通过跨模态一致性模式和自适应融合机制实现了更好的时间一致性和鲁棒性

title: EntropyCache: Decoded Token Entropy Guided KV Caching for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) rely on bidirectional attention, which prevents lossless KV caching and requires a full forward pass at every denoising step. Existing approximate KV caching methods reduce this cost by selectively updating cached states, but their decision overhead scales with context length or model depth. We propose EntropyCache, a training-free KV caching method that uses the maximum entropy of newly decoded token distributions as a constant-cost signal for deciding when to recompute. Our design is grounded in two empirical observations: (1) decoded token entropy correlates with KV cache drift, providing a cheap proxy for cache staleness, and (2) feature volatility of decoded tokens persists for multiple steps after unmasking, motivating recomputation of the $k$ most recently decoded tokens. The skip-or-recompute decision requires only $O(V)$ computation per step, independent of context length and model scale. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct show that EntropyCache achieves $15.2\times$-$26.4\times$ speedup on standard benchmarks and $22.4\times$-$24.1\times$ on chain-of-thought benchmarks, with competitive accuracy and decision overhead accounting for only $0.5\%$ of inference time. Code is available at https://github.com/mscheong01/EntropyCache.

AI.tldr: EntropyCache是一种无需训练的KV缓存方法，通过解码token的最大熵作为常数成本信号来决定何时重新计算，实现15.2-26.4倍加速，决策开销仅占推理时间的0.5%。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的大语言模型使用双向注意力机制，这阻碍了无损KV缓存，需要在每个去噪步骤进行完整前向传播。现有的近似KV缓存方法虽然通过选择性更新缓存状态来降低成本，但其决策开销会随上下文长度或模型深度而增加。
AI.method: 提出EntropyCache方法，使用新解码token分布的最大熵作为常数成本信号来决定何时重新计算KV缓存。该方法基于两个经验观察：1)解码token熵与KV缓存漂移相关，可作为缓存过时的廉价代理；2)解码token的特征波动在解掩码后持续多个步骤，因此需要重新计算最近解码的k个token。决策过程每步仅需O(V)计算，与上下文长度和模型规模无关。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上的实验表明，EntropyCache在标准基准测试上实现15.2-26.4倍加速，在思维链基准测试上实现22.4-24.1倍加速，同时保持有竞争力的准确性，决策开销仅占推理时间的0.5%。
AI.conclusion: EntropyCache是一种高效的训练免费KV缓存方法，通过使用解码token熵作为缓存更新决策信号，实现了显著的推理加速，同时保持低决策开销和良好的准确性。

title: Reasonably reasoning AI agents can avoid game-theoretic failures in zero-shot, provably
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed in interactive economic environments characterized by repeated AI-AI interactions. Despite AI agents' advanced capabilities, empirical studies reveal that such interactions often fail to stably induce a strategic equilibrium, such as a Nash equilibrium. Post-training methods have been proposed to induce a strategic equilibrium; however, it remains impractical to uniformly apply an alignment method across diverse, independently developed AI models in strategic settings. In this paper, we provide theoretical and empirical evidence that off-the-shelf reasoning AI agents can achieve Nash-like play zero-shot, without explicit post-training. Specifically, we prove that `reasonably reasoning' agents, i.e., agents capable of forming beliefs about others' strategies from previous observation and learning to best respond to these beliefs, eventually behave along almost every realized play path in a way that is weakly close to a Nash equilibrium of the continuation game. In addition, we relax the common-knowledge payoff assumption by allowing stage payoffs to be unknown and by having each agent observe only its own privately realized stochastic payoffs, and we show that we can still achieve the same on-path Nash convergence guarantee. We then empirically validate the proposed theories by simulating five game scenarios, ranging from a repeated prisoner's dilemma game to stylized repeated marketing promotion games. Our findings suggest that AI agents naturally exhibit such reasoning patterns and therefore attain stable equilibrium behaviors intrinsically, obviating the need for universal alignment procedures in many real-world strategic interactions.

AI.tldr: AI智能体在重复战略互动中无需额外训练即可零样本实现纳什均衡式行为，通过形成对他人策略的信念并最佳响应这些信念，最终在几乎所有实际博弈路径上接近纳什均衡。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI智能体在交互经济环境中部署日益增多，但实证研究表明AI-AI互动往往无法稳定达到战略均衡（如纳什均衡）。现有后训练方法需要统一应用于不同AI模型，这在战略环境中不切实际。本文旨在证明现成的推理AI智能体无需显式后训练即可零样本实现纳什均衡式行为。
AI.method: 提出理论证明：具备"合理推理"能力的智能体（能够从先前观察中形成对他人策略的信念，并学习最佳响应这些信念）最终在几乎所有实际博弈路径上的行为弱接近后续博弈的纳什均衡。同时放宽共同知识收益假设，允许阶段收益未知，每个智能体仅观察自己私有的随机收益，仍能保证相同的路径纳什收敛性。通过五个博弈场景（从重复囚徒困境到风格化重复营销推广游戏）进行实证验证。
AI.result: 理论证明和实证模拟均表明，AI智能体自然表现出这种推理模式，因此在许多现实世界战略互动中内在实现稳定均衡行为，无需通用对齐程序。即使在收益信息不完全的情况下，仍能保证路径纳什收敛。
AI.conclusion: 现成的推理AI智能体在重复战略互动中能够零样本实现纳什均衡式行为，无需显式后训练或统一对齐。这一发现挑战了当前需要普遍对齐程序的假设，表明AI智能体在战略环境中具有内在的均衡实现能力。

title: TexEditor: Structure-Preserving Text-Driven Texture Editing
summary: Text-guided texture editing aims to modify object appearance while preserving the underlying geometric structure. However, our empirical analysis reveals that even SOTA editing models frequently struggle to maintain structural consistency during texture editing, despite the intended changes being purely appearance-related. Motivated by this observation, we jointly enhance structure preservation from both data and training perspectives, and build TexEditor, a dedicated texture editing model based on Qwen-Image-Edit-2509. Firstly, we construct TexBlender, a high-quality SFT dataset generated with Blender, which provides strong structural priors for a cold start. Sec- ondly, we introduce StructureNFT, a RL-based approach that integrates structure-preserving losses to transfer the structural priors learned during SFT to real-world scenes. Moreover, due to the limited realism and evaluation coverage of existing benchmarks, we introduce TexBench, a general-purpose real-world benchmark for text-guided texture editing. Extensive experiments on existing Blender-based texture benchmarks and our TexBench show that TexEditor consistently outperforms strong baselines such as Nano Banana Pro. In addition, we assess TexEditor on the general purpose benchmark ImgEdit to validate its generalization. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/KlingAIResearch/TexEditor.

AI.tldr: TexEditor是一个专注于文本引导纹理编辑的模型，通过TexBlender数据集和StructureNFT训练方法，在保持几何结构一致性的同时修改物体外观，在多个基准测试中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的编辑模型在纹理编辑时经常难以保持结构一致性，尽管预期的变化纯粹是外观相关的。这促使研究者从数据和训练两个角度共同增强结构保持能力。
AI.method: 1. 构建TexBlender：使用Blender生成的高质量SFT数据集，提供强大的结构先验；2. 提出StructureNFT：基于强化学习的方法，集成结构保持损失，将SFT阶段学到的结构先验迁移到真实场景；3. 建立TexBench：通用真实世界纹理编辑基准测试。
AI.result: 在现有的Blender纹理基准测试和TexBench上，TexEditor始终优于Nano Banana Pro等强基线。在通用基准测试ImgEdit上的评估也验证了其泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TexEditor通过结合高质量数据集和结构保持训练方法，有效解决了文本引导纹理编辑中的结构一致性问题，在多个基准测试中表现出色，具有很好的泛化能力。

title: When Names Change Verdicts: Intervention Consistency Reveals Systematic Bias in LLM Decision-Making
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for high-stakes decisions, yet their susceptibility to spurious features remains poorly characterized. We introduce ICE-Guard, a framework applying intervention consistency testing to detect three types of spurious feature reliance: demographic (name/race swaps), authority (credential/prestige swaps), and framing (positive/negative restatements). Across 3,000 vignettes spanning 10 high-stakes domains, we evaluate 11 LLMs from 8 families and find that (1) authority bias (mean 5.8%) and framing bias (5.0%) substantially exceed demographic bias (2.2%), challenging the field's narrow focus on demographics; (2) bias concentrates in specific domains -- finance shows 22.6% authority bias while criminal justice shows only 2.8%; (3) structured decomposition, where the LLM extracts features and a deterministic rubric decides, reduces flip rates by up to 100% (median 49% across 9 models). We demonstrate an ICE-guided detect-diagnose-mitigate-verify loop achieving cumulative 78% bias reduction via iterative prompt patching. Validation against real COMPAS recidivism data shows COMPAS-derived flip rates exceed pooled synthetic rates, suggesting our benchmark provides a conservative estimate of real-world bias. Code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: ICE-Guard框架通过干预一致性测试检测LLM对虚假特征的依赖，发现权威偏见和框架偏见远超人口偏见，结构化分解可显著降低偏见
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于高风险决策，但其对虚假特征的敏感性尚未得到充分研究。需要系统性地检测和缓解LLM在决策中的偏见问题
AI.method: 引入ICE-Guard框架，应用干预一致性测试检测三类虚假特征依赖：人口统计特征（姓名/种族替换）、权威特征（资历/声望替换）和框架特征（正面/负面重述）。在10个高风险领域的3000个案例中评估11个LLM，采用结构化分解方法提取特征并使用确定性规则决策
AI.result: 权威偏见（平均5.8%）和框架偏见（5.0%）显著超过人口偏见（2.2%）；偏见集中在特定领域（金融领域权威偏见达22.6%，刑事司法仅2.8%）；结构化分解可将翻转率降低高达100%（9个模型的中位数降低49%）；ICE引导的检测-诊断-缓解-验证循环实现累计78%的偏见减少
AI.conclusion: 研究挑战了领域对人口统计偏见的狭隘关注，揭示了权威和框架偏见的重要性；结构化分解是有效的偏见缓解策略；ICE-Guard框架为LLM偏见检测和缓解提供了系统方法，其基准对现实世界偏见提供了保守估计

title: CAPSUL: A Comprehensive Human Protein Benchmark for Subcellular Localization
summary: Subcellular localization is a crucial biological task for drug target identification and function annotation. Although it has been biologically realized that subcellular localization is closely associated with protein structure, no existing dataset offers comprehensive 3D structural information with detailed subcellular localization annotations, thus severely hindering the application of promising structure-based models on this task. To address this gap, we introduce a new benchmark called $\mathbf{CAPSUL}$, a $\mathbf{C}$omprehensive hum$\mathbf{A}$n $\mathbf{P}$rotein benchmark for $\mathbf{SU}$bcellular $\mathbf{L}$ocalization. It features a dataset that integrates diverse 3D structural representations with fine-grained subcellular localization annotations carefully curated by domain experts. We evaluate this benchmark using a variety of state-of-the-art sequence-based and structure-based models, showcasing the importance of involving structural features in this task. Furthermore, we explore reweighting and single-label classification strategies to facilitate future investigation on structure-based methods for this task. Lastly, we showcase the powerful interpretability of structure-based methods through a case study on the Golgi apparatus, where we discover a decisive localization pattern $α$-helix from attention mechanisms, demonstrating the potential for bridging the gap with intuitive biological interpretability and paving the way for data-driven discoveries in cell biology.

AI.tldr: CAPSUL是一个综合的人类蛋白质亚细胞定位基准数据集，整合了3D结构信息和精细的亚细胞定位注释，展示了结构特征在该任务中的重要性。
AI.motivation: 亚细胞定位是药物靶点识别和功能注释的关键任务，虽然已知与蛋白质结构密切相关，但现有数据集缺乏全面的3D结构信息和详细的亚细胞定位注释，限制了基于结构模型的应用。
AI.method: 创建CAPSUL基准数据集，整合多样化的3D结构表示和专家精心策划的细粒度亚细胞定位注释。使用最先进的序列基和结构基模型进行评估，探索重加权和单标签分类策略。
AI.result: 展示了结构特征在该任务中的重要性，通过高尔基体的案例研究发现了决定性的定位模式α-螺旋，证明了结构基方法强大的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: CAPSUL基准为基于结构的方法研究提供了基础，通过数据驱动发现展示了连接直观生物可解释性的潜力，为细胞生物学研究开辟了新途径。

title: FILT3R: Latent State Adaptive Kalman Filter for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction maintains a persistent latent state that is updated online from incoming frames, enabling constant-memory inference. A key failure mode is the state update rule: aggressive overwrites forget useful history, while conservative updates fail to track new evidence, and both behaviors become unstable beyond the training horizon. To address this challenge, we propose FILT3R, a training-free latent filtering layer that casts recurrent state updates as stochastic state estimation in token space. FILT3R maintains a per-token variance and computes a Kalman-style gain that adaptively balances memory retention against new observations. Process noise -- governing how much the latent state is expected to change between frames -- is estimated online from EMA-normalized temporal drift of candidate tokens. Using extensive experiments, we demonstrate that FILT3R yields an interpretable, plug-in update rule that generalizes common overwrite and gating policies as special cases. Specifically, we show that gains shrink in stable regimes as uncertainty contracts with accumulated evidence, and rise when genuine scene change increases process uncertainty, improving long-horizon stability for depth, pose, and 3D reconstruction, compared to the existing methods. Code will be released at https://github.com/jinotter3/FILT3R.

AI.tldr: FILT3R提出了一种无需训练、基于卡尔曼滤波思想的潜在状态更新方法，用于提升流式3D重建的长期稳定性，通过自适应平衡历史记忆与新观测来解决状态更新中的过拟合与欠拟合问题。
AI.motivation: 流式3D重建需要在线更新潜在状态，但现有状态更新规则存在两难：激进覆盖会丢失有用历史信息，保守更新则无法有效跟踪新证据，这两种行为在超出训练时间范围后都会变得不稳定。
AI.method: 提出FILT3R训练免费潜在过滤层，将循环状态更新建模为token空间中的随机状态估计。该方法维护每个token的方差，计算卡尔曼式增益来自适应平衡记忆保留与新观测。过程噪声通过候选token的EMA归一化时间漂移在线估计。
AI.result: FILT3R产生可解释的即插即用更新规则，将常见的覆盖和门控策略作为特例。实验表明，在稳定区域增益随证据积累而收缩，在真实场景变化时增益随过程不确定性增加而上升，相比现有方法在深度、姿态和3D重建的长期稳定性方面有改进。
AI.conclusion: FILT3R通过将状态更新重新构建为随机估计问题，提供了一种自适应、可解释的解决方案，能够改善流式3D重建系统的长期稳定性和泛化能力。

title: Cross-Lingual LLM-Judge Transfer via Evaluation Decomposition
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed across diverse real-world applications, extending automated evaluation beyond English has become a critical challenge. Existing evaluation approaches are predominantly English-focused, and adapting them to other languages is hindered by the scarcity and cost of human-annotated judgments in most languages. We introduce a decomposition-based evaluation framework built around a Universal Criteria Set (UCS). UCS consists of a shared, language-agnostic set of evaluation dimensions, producing an interpretable intermediate representation that supports cross-lingual transfer with minimal supervision. Experiments on multiple faithfulness tasks across languages and model backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines without requiring target-language annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于通用标准集(UCS)的分解式评估框架，支持跨语言自动评估，无需目标语言标注
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在多语言场景部署日益广泛，但现有评估方法主要针对英语，其他语言缺乏高质量人工标注数据，跨语言评估面临挑战
AI.method: 引入基于通用标准集(UCS)的分解式评估框架，UCS包含语言无关的共享评估维度，生成可解释的中间表示，支持最小监督下的跨语言迁移
AI.result: 在多种语言和模型架构的忠实性任务实验中，相比强基线方法取得一致改进，且无需目标语言标注
AI.conclusion: UCS框架有效解决了跨语言评估的数据稀缺问题，为多语言场景下的自动评估提供了实用解决方案

title: Interplay: Training Independent Simulators for Reference-Free Conversational Recommendation
summary: Training conversational recommender systems (CRS) requires extensive dialogue data, which is challenging to collect at scale. To address this, researchers have used simulated user-recommender conversations. Traditional simulation approaches often utilize a single large language model (LLM) that generates entire conversations with prior knowledge of the target items, leading to scripted and artificial dialogues. We propose a reference-free simulation framework that trains two independent LLMs, one as the user and one as the conversational recommender. These models interact in real-time without access to predetermined target items, but preference summaries and target attributes, enabling the recommender to genuinely infer user preferences through dialogue. This approach produces more realistic and diverse conversations that closely mirror authentic human-AI interactions. Our reference-free simulators match or exceed existing methods in quality, while offering a scalable solution for generating high-quality conversational recommendation data without constraining conversations to pre-defined target items. We conduct both quantitative and human evaluations to confirm the effectiveness of our reference-free approach.

AI.tldr: 提出无参考模拟框架，训练两个独立的LLM分别作为用户和对话推荐系统，实时交互生成更真实、多样化的对话数据，无需预定义目标物品。
AI.motivation: 训练对话推荐系统需要大量对话数据，但收集困难。传统模拟方法使用单一LLM生成整个对话，预先知道目标物品，导致对话脚本化、人工化。
AI.method: 提出无参考模拟框架，训练两个独立的LLM：一个作为用户，一个作为对话推荐系统。这两个模型实时交互，不访问预定的目标物品，但使用偏好摘要和目标属性，使推荐系统能够通过对话真正推断用户偏好。
AI.result: 该方法生成更真实、多样化的对话，更接近真实的人机交互。无参考模拟器在质量上匹配或超过现有方法，同时提供可扩展的解决方案，用于生成高质量的对话推荐数据，而不将对话限制在预定义的目标物品上。
AI.conclusion: 通过定量和人工评估证实了无参考方法的有效性，为对话推荐系统训练提供了更真实、可扩展的数据生成方案。

title: ICE: Intervention-Consistent Explanation Evaluation with Statistical Grounding for LLMs
summary: Evaluating whether explanations faithfully reflect a model's reasoning remains an open problem. Existing benchmarks use single interventions without statistical testing, making it impossible to distinguish genuine faithfulness from chance-level performance. We introduce ICE (Intervention-Consistent Explanation), a framework that compares explanations against matched random baselines via randomization tests under multiple intervention operators, yielding win rates with confidence intervals. Evaluating 7 LLMs across 4 English tasks, 6 non-English languages, and 2 attribution methods, we find that faithfulness is operator-dependent: operator gaps reach up to 44 percentage points, with deletion typically inflating estimates on short text but the pattern reversing on long text, suggesting that faithfulness should be interpreted comparatively across intervention operators rather than as a single score. Randomized baselines reveal anti-faithfulness in one-third of configurations, and faithfulness shows zero correlation with human plausibility (|r| < 0.04). Multilingual evaluation reveals dramatic model-language interactions not explained by tokenization alone. We release the ICE framework and ICEBench benchmark.

AI.tldr: ICE框架通过随机化测试和多种干预操作符评估解释的忠实性，发现忠实性依赖于操作符且与人类可解释性无关，多语言评估揭示了模型与语言的交互作用。
AI.motivation: 现有评估解释忠实性的基准使用单一干预且缺乏统计检验，无法区分真正的忠实性与偶然表现，需要更严谨的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出ICE框架，通过随机化测试将解释与匹配的随机基线进行比较，使用多种干预操作符，计算置信区间内的胜率。
AI.result: 评估7个LLM在4个英文任务、6种非英语语言和2种归因方法上，发现忠实性依赖于操作符（差距达44个百分点），删除操作在短文本中高估但在长文本中相反，三分之一配置显示反忠实性，忠实性与人类可解释性无关（|r|<0.04），多语言评估揭示了模型与语言的复杂交互。
AI.conclusion: 忠实性应被视为跨干预操作符的相对比较而非单一分数，ICE框架提供了更严谨的评估方法，并发布了ICEBench基准。

title: Efficient Video Diffusion with Sparse Information Transmission for Video Compression
summary: Video compression aims to maximize reconstruction quality with minimal bitrates. Beyond standard distortion metrics, perceptual quality and temporal consistency are also critical. However, at ultra-low bitrates, traditional end-to-end compression models tend to produce blurry images of poor perceptual quality. Besides, existing generative compression methods often treat video frames independently and show limitations in time coherence and efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose the Efficient Video Diffusion with Sparse Information Transmission (Diff-SIT), which comprises the Sparse Temporal Encoding Module (STEM) and the One-Step Video Diffusion with Frame Type Embedder (ODFTE). The STEM sparsely encodes the original frame sequence into an information-rich intermediate sequence, achieving significant bitrate savings. Subsequently, the ODFTE processes this intermediate sequence as a whole, which exploits the temporal correlation. During this process, our proposed Frame Type Embedder (FTE) guides the diffusion model to perform adaptive reconstruction according to different frame types to optimize the overall quality. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that Diff-SIT establishes a new state-of-the-art in perceptual quality and temporal consistency, particularly in the challenging ultra-low-bitrate regime. Code is released at https://github.com/MingdeZhou/Diff-SIT.

AI.tldr: Diff-SIT：一种高效视频扩散压缩方法，通过稀疏信息传输在超低码率下实现优越的感知质量和时间一致性
AI.motivation: 传统端到端压缩模型在超低码率下产生模糊图像且感知质量差；现有生成式压缩方法常独立处理视频帧，存在时间一致性和效率问题
AI.method: 提出Diff-SIT框架，包含稀疏时间编码模块（STEM）和一步视频扩散模块（ODFTE）。STEM稀疏编码原始帧序列为信息丰富的中间序列以节省码率，ODFTE整体处理中间序列利用时间相关性，帧类型嵌入器（FTE）指导扩散模型根据不同类型帧进行自适应重建
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，Diff-SIT在感知质量和时间一致性方面达到新的最优水平，特别是在具有挑战性的超低码率场景下
AI.conclusion: Diff-SIT通过稀疏信息传输和自适应帧类型重建，有效解决了超低码率视频压缩中的感知质量和时间一致性问题，为视频压缩提供了新的解决方案

title: Language Model Maps for Prompt-Response Distributions via Log-Likelihood Vectors
summary: We propose a method that represents language models by log-likelihood vectors over prompt-response pairs and constructs model maps for comparing their conditional distributions. In this space, distances between models approximate the KL divergence between the corresponding conditional distributions. Experiments on a large collection of publicly available language models show that the maps capture meaningful global structure, including relationships to model attributes and task performance. The method also captures systematic shifts induced by prompt modifications and their approximate additive compositionality, suggesting a way to analyze and predict the effects of composite prompt operations. We further introduce pointwise mutual information (PMI) vectors to reduce the influence of unconditional distributions; in some cases, PMI-based model maps better reflect training-data-related differences. Overall, the framework supports the analysis of input-dependent model behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过log-likelihood向量表示语言模型的方法，构建模型地图来比较条件分布，距离近似KL散度，能捕捉模型属性和任务性能关系
AI.motivation: 需要一种系统方法来分析和比较不同语言模型的条件分布，理解模型间的结构关系以及提示修改对模型行为的影响
AI.method: 使用log-likelihood向量表示语言模型，基于提示-响应对构建模型地图；引入点互信息（PMI）向量减少无条件分布影响；通过KL散度近似模型间距离
AI.result: 模型地图能捕捉有意义的全局结构，包括与模型属性和任务性能的关系；能捕捉提示修改引起的系统性偏移及其近似可加组合性；PMI-based地图在某些情况下能更好反映训练数据相关差异
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持分析输入依赖的模型行为，为理解和预测复合提示操作效果提供了一种方法

title: ZEBRAARENA: A Diagnostic Simulation Environment for Studying Reasoning-Action Coupling in Tool-Augmented LLMs
summary: Tool-augmented large language models (LLMs) must tightly couple multi-step reasoning with external actions, yet existing benchmarks often confound this interplay with complex environment dynamics, memorized knowledge or dataset contamination. In this paper, we introduce ZebraArena, a procedurally generated diagnostic environment for studying reasoning-action coupling in tool-augmented LLMs, with controllable difficulty and a knowledge-minimal design, which limits gains from memorization or dataset contamination. Each task in ZebraArena requires a set of critical information which is available only through targeted tool use, yielding an interpretable interface between external information acquisition and deductive reasoning. This design provides deterministic evaluation via unique solutions, and a theoretical optimal query count for measuring efficient tool use. We show that ZebraArena requires a combination of in-depth reasoning and accurate external tool calling, which remains a challenge as frontier reasoning models such as GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro only achieves 60% accuracy on the hard instances. We also observe a persistent gaps between theoretical optimality and practical tool usage. For example, GPT-5 uses 70-270% more tool calls than the theoretical optimum. We highlight the key findings in our evaluation, and hope ZebraArena stimulates further research on the interplay between internal reasoning and external action.

AI.tldr: ZebraArena是一个程序生成的诊断环境，用于研究工具增强大语言模型中推理与行动的耦合，具有可控难度和知识最小化设计，限制记忆或数据污染带来的收益。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试往往将多步推理与外部行动的耦合与环境动态复杂性、记忆知识或数据污染混淆，需要更清晰的评估框架来研究工具增强LLM中推理与行动的相互作用。
AI.method: 设计ZebraArena环境，每个任务需要只能通过针对性工具使用获取的关键信息，提供可解释的外部信息获取与演绎推理接口，具有确定性评估和理论最优查询计数。
AI.result: 前沿推理模型如GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro在困难实例上仅达到60%准确率，且实际工具使用与理论最优存在显著差距（GPT-5使用比理论最优多70-270%的工具调用）。
AI.conclusion: ZebraArena揭示了工具增强LLM在深度推理与准确外部工具调用结合方面的挑战，强调了内部推理与外部行动相互作用研究的重要性，为未来研究提供了诊断环境。

title: HOMEY: Heuristic Object Masking with Enhanced YOLO for Property Insurance Risk Detection
summary: Automated property risk detection is a high-impact yet underexplored frontier in computer vision with direct implications for real estate, underwriting, and insurance operations. We introduce HOMEY (Heuristic Object Masking with Enhanced YOLO), a novel detection framework that combines YOLO with a domain-specific masking mechanism and a custom-designed loss function. HOMEY is trained to detect 17 risk-related property classes, including structural damages (e.g., cracked foundations, roof issues), maintenance neglect (e.g., dead yards, overgrown bushes), and liability hazards (e.g., falling gutters, garbage, hazard signs). Our approach introduces heuristic object masking to amplify weak signals in cluttered backgrounds and risk-aware loss calibration to balance class skew and severity weighting. Experiments on real-world property imagery demonstrate that HOMEY achieves superior detection accuracy and reliability compared to baseline YOLO models, while retaining fast inference. Beyond detection, HOMEY enables interpretable and cost-efficient risk analysis, laying the foundation for scalable AI-driven property insurance workflows.

AI.tldr: HOMEY是一个结合YOLO与领域特定掩码机制的新型房产风险检测框架，能识别17种风险类别，通过启发式对象掩码增强弱信号，使用风险感知损失校准平衡类别偏斜，在真实房产图像上表现优于基线YOLO模型。
AI.motivation: 房产风险自动检测在计算机视觉中是一个高影响但未被充分探索的领域，对房地产、承保和保险运营有直接影响。当前缺乏专门针对房产风险检测的有效解决方案。
AI.method: 提出HOMEY框架，结合YOLO检测器与领域特定掩码机制和自定义损失函数。采用启发式对象掩码来增强杂乱背景中的弱信号，使用风险感知损失校准来平衡类别偏斜和严重性权重。训练检测17种风险相关房产类别。
AI.result: 在真实世界房产图像上的实验表明，HOMEY相比基线YOLO模型实现了更优越的检测准确性和可靠性，同时保持快速推理速度。
AI.conclusion: HOMEY不仅提供检测能力，还支持可解释和成本效益的风险分析，为可扩展的AI驱动房产保险工作流程奠定了基础。

title: Cross-Modal Rationale Transfer for Explainable Humanitarian Classification on Social Media
summary: Advances in social media data dissemination enable the provision of real-time information during a crisis. The information comes from different classes, such as infrastructure damages, persons missing or stranded in the affected zone, etc. Existing methods attempted to classify text and images into various humanitarian categories, but their decision-making process remains largely opaque, which affects their deployment in real-life applications. Recent work has sought to improve transparency by extracting textual rationales from tweets to explain predicted classes. However, such explainable classification methods have mostly focused on text, rather than crisis-related images. In this paper, we propose an interpretable-by-design multimodal classification framework. Our method first learns the joint representation of text and image using a visual language transformer model and extracts text rationales. Next, it extracts the image rationales via the mapping with text rationales. Our approach demonstrates how to learn rationales in one modality from another through cross-modal rationale transfer, which saves annotation effort. Finally, tweets are classified based on extracted rationales. Experiments are conducted over CrisisMMD benchmark dataset, and results show that our proposed method boosts the classification Macro-F1 by 2-35% while extracting accurate text tokens and image patches as rationales. Human evaluation also supports the claim that our proposed method is able to retrieve better image rationale patches (12%) that help to identify humanitarian classes. Our method adapts well to new, unseen datasets in zero-shot mode, achieving an accuracy of 80%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释的多模态分类框架，通过跨模态理性转移从文本中学习图像理性，提升危机社交媒体数据的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有危机社交媒体分类方法缺乏透明度，影响实际部署。虽然已有工作通过提取文本理性来提高可解释性，但主要关注文本而忽略了危机相关图像的解释。
AI.method: 首先使用视觉语言Transformer模型学习文本和图像的联合表示并提取文本理性；然后通过文本理性映射提取图像理性；最后基于提取的理性进行分类，实现跨模态理性转移。
AI.result: 在CrisisMMD基准数据集上，该方法将分类Macro-F1提高了2-35%，同时提取了准确的文本标记和图像块作为理性。人类评估显示能检索到更好的图像理性块（提升12%），在零样本模式下对新数据集的准确率达到80%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的可解释多模态分类框架通过跨模态理性转移有效提升了危机社交媒体数据的分类性能，同时提供了更好的可解释性，减少了标注工作量。

title: Agentic Flow Steering and Parallel Rollout Search for Spatially Grounded Text-to-Image Generation
