summary: Precise Text-to-Image (T2I) generation has achieved great success but is hindered by the limited relational reasoning of static text encoders and the error accumulation in open-loop sampling. Without real-time feedback, initial semantic ambiguities during the Ordinary Differential Equation trajectory inevitably escalate into stochastic deviations from spatial constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce AFS-Search (Agentic Flow Steering and Parallel Rollout Search), a training-free closed-loop framework built upon FLUX.1-dev. AFS-Search incorporates a training-free closed-loop parallel rollout search and flow steering mechanism, which leverages a Vision-Language Model (VLM) as a semantic critic to diagnose intermediate latents and dynamically steer the velocity field via precise spatial grounding. Complementarily, we formulate T2I generation as a sequential decision-making process, exploring multiple trajectories through lookahead simulations and selecting the optimal path based on VLM-guided rewards. Further, we provide AFS-Search-Pro for higher performance and AFS-Search-Fast for quicker generation. Experimental results show that our AFS-Search-Pro greatly boosts the performance of the original FLUX.1-dev, achieving state-of-the-art results across three different benchmarks. Meanwhile, AFS-Search-Fast also significantly enhances performance while maintaining fast generation speed.

AI.tldr: AFS-Search是一个无需训练的闭环框架，通过视觉语言模型作为语义批评器来诊断中间潜在表示并动态引导速度场，同时将文本到图像生成建模为序列决策过程，通过前瞻模拟探索多条轨迹并基于VLM奖励选择最优路径。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成方法受限于静态文本编码器的关系推理能力和开环采样中的误差累积问题。由于缺乏实时反馈，初始语义模糊性在ODE轨迹中不可避免地演变为空间约束的随机偏差。
AI.method: 提出了AFS-Search框架，包含无需训练的闭环并行展开搜索和流引导机制，利用视觉语言模型作为语义批评器诊断中间潜在表示并动态引导速度场。将T2I生成建模为序列决策过程，通过前瞻模拟探索多条轨迹，基于VLM指导的奖励选择最优路径。还提供了高性能的AFS-Search-Pro和快速生成的AFS-Search-Fast版本。
AI.result: AFS-Search-Pro显著提升了原始FLUX.1-dev的性能，在三个不同基准测试中达到了最先进的结果。AFS-Search-Fast在保持快速生成速度的同时也显著提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: AFS-Search通过引入闭环反馈机制和序列决策建模，有效解决了文本到图像生成中的语义模糊和误差累积问题，在精度和速度方面都取得了显著改进。

title: From Snapshots to Symphonies: The Evolution of Protein Prediction from Static Structures to Generative Dynamics and Multimodal Interactions
summary: The protein folding problem has been fundamentally transformed by artificial intelligence, evolving from static structure prediction toward the modeling of dynamic conformational ensembles and complex biomolecular interactions. This review systematically examines the paradigm shift in AI driven protein science across five interconnected dimensions: unified multimodal representations that integrate sequences, geometries, and textual knowledge; refinement of static prediction through MSA free architectures and all atom complex modeling; generative frameworks, including diffusion models and flow matching, that capture conformational distributions consistent with thermodynamic ensembles; prediction of heterogeneous interactions spanning protein ligand, protein nucleic acid, and protein protein complexes; and functional inference of fitness landscapes, mutational effects, and text guided property prediction. We critically analyze current bottlenecks, including data distribution biases, limited mechanistic interpretability, and the disconnect between geometric metrics and biophysical reality, while identifying future directions toward physically consistent generative models, multimodal foundation architectures, and experimental closed loop systems. This methodological transformation marks artificial intelligence's transition from a structural analysis tool into a universal simulator capable of understanding and ultimately rewriting the dynamic language of life.

AI.tldr: AI已从根本上改变了蛋白质折叠问题，从静态结构预测转向动态构象集合和复杂生物分子相互作用的建模，标志着AI从结构分析工具向能够理解和重写生命动态语言的通用模拟器的转变。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质折叠问题经历了根本性转变，从静态结构预测演变为对动态构象集合和复杂生物分子相互作用的建模。需要系统审视AI驱动蛋白质科学的范式转变，分析当前瓶颈并确定未来方向。
AI.method: 从五个相互关联的维度系统审视范式转变：统一多模态表示（整合序列、几何和文本知识）；通过无MSA架构和全原子复合物建模改进静态预测；生成框架（包括扩散模型和流匹配）捕获与热力学集合一致的构象分布；预测异质相互作用（蛋白质-配体、蛋白质-核酸、蛋白质-蛋白质复合物）；以及功能推断（适应度景观、突变效应和文本引导的属性预测）。
AI.result: AI驱动的蛋白质科学已实现从静态结构预测到动态构象集合建模的转变，能够预测复杂生物分子相互作用并进行功能推断，但面临数据分布偏差、机制可解释性有限以及几何指标与生物物理现实脱节等瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 这一方法论转变标志着人工智能从结构分析工具转变为能够理解和最终重写生命动态语言的通用模拟器。未来方向包括物理一致的生成模型、多模态基础架构和实验闭环系统。

title: D-Mem: A Dual-Process Memory System for LLM Agents
summary: Driven by the development of persistent, self-adapting autonomous agents, equipping these systems with high-fidelity memory access for long-horizon reasoning has emerged as a critical requirement. However, prevalent retrieval-based memory frameworks often follow an incremental processing paradigm that continuously extracts and updates conversational memories into vector databases, relying on semantic retrieval when queried. While this approach is fast, it inherently relies on lossy abstraction, frequently missing contextually critical information and struggling to resolve queries that rely on fine-grained contextual understanding. To address this, we introduce D-Mem, a dual-process memory system. It retains lightweight vector retrieval for routine queries while establishing an exhaustive Full Deliberation module as a high-fidelity fallback. To achieve cognitive economy without sacrificing accuracy, D-Mem employs a Multi-dimensional Quality Gating policy to dynamically bridge these two processes. Experiments on the LoCoMo and RealTalk benchmarks using GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3-235B-Instruct demonstrate the efficacy of our approach. Notably, our Multi-dimensional Quality Gating policy achieves an F1 score of 53.5 on LoCoMo with GPT-4o-mini. This outperforms our static retrieval baseline, Mem0$^\ast$ (51.2), and recovers 96.7\% of the Full Deliberation's performance (55.3), while incurring significantly lower computational costs.

AI.tldr: D-Mem：一种双过程记忆系统，结合轻量级向量检索和完整审议模块，通过多维质量门控策略实现高效高保真记忆访问
AI.motivation: 现有基于检索的记忆框架采用增量处理范式，依赖语义检索，虽然快速但存在信息丢失问题，难以处理需要细粒度上下文理解的查询
AI.method: 引入D-Mem双过程记忆系统：1) 保留轻量级向量检索处理常规查询；2) 建立完整的Full Deliberation模块作为高保真后备；3) 采用多维质量门控策略动态桥接两个过程
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和RealTalk基准测试中，使用GPT-4o-mini和Qwen3-235B-Instruct验证了方法的有效性。多维质量门控策略在LoCoMo上获得53.5的F1分数，优于静态检索基线Mem0*（51.2），恢复了Full Deliberation性能的96.7%（55.3），同时显著降低计算成本
AI.conclusion: D-Mem系统通过双过程架构和多维质量门控策略，在保持计算效率的同时实现了高保真记忆访问，为自主智能体的长期推理提供了有效的记忆解决方案

title: Foundations and Architectures of Artificial Intelligence for Motor Insurance
summary: This handbook presents a systematic treatment of the foundations and architectures of artificial intelligence for motor insurance, grounded in large-scale real-world deployment. It formalizes a vertically integrated AI paradigm that unifies perception, multimodal reasoning, and production infrastructure into a cohesive intelligence stack for automotive risk assessment and claims processing. At its core, the handbook develops domain-adapted transformer architectures for structured visual understanding, relational vehicle representation learning, and multimodal document intelligence, enabling end-to-end automation of vehicle damage analysis, claims evaluation, and underwriting workflows. These components are composed into a scalable pipeline operating under practical constraints observed in nationwide motor insurance systems in Thailand. Beyond model design, the handbook emphasizes the co-evolution of learning algorithms and MLOps practices, establishing a principled framework for translating modern artificial intelligence into reliable, production-grade systems in high-stakes industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 该手册系统性地提出了面向车险领域的垂直整合AI范式，统一感知、多模态推理和生产基础设施，构建了用于汽车风险评估和理赔处理的智能栈。
AI.motivation: 针对车险行业需要大规模真实部署的需求，建立将现代人工智能转化为可靠、生产级系统的原则性框架，解决高风险工业环境中的实际应用挑战。
AI.method: 开发领域适应的Transformer架构，包括结构化视觉理解、关系型车辆表示学习和多模态文档智能，将这些组件组合成可扩展的流水线，并在泰国全国车险系统的实际约束下运行。
AI.result: 实现了车辆损伤分析、理赔评估和核保工作流程的端到端自动化，建立了学习算法与MLOps实践共同演化的原则框架。
AI.conclusion: 该手册为将现代人工智能技术转化为高可靠性、生产级系统提供了系统性的方法论，特别适用于高风险工业环境中的车险应用。

title: Learning to Self-Evolve
summary: We introduce Learning to Self-Evolve (LSE), a reinforcement learning framework that trains large language models (LLMs) to improve their own contexts at test time. We situate LSE in the setting of test-time self-evolution, where a model iteratively refines its context from feedback on seen problems to perform better on new ones. Existing approaches rely entirely on the inherent reasoning ability of the model and never explicitly train it for this task. LSE reduces the multi-step evolution problem to a single-step RL objective, where each context edit is rewarded by the improvement in downstream performance. We pair this objective with a tree-guided evolution loop. On Text-to-SQL generation (BIRD) and general question answering (MMLU-Redux), a 4B-parameter model trained with LSE outperforms self-evolving policies powered by GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5, as well as prompt optimization methods including GEPA and TextGrad, and transfers to guide other models without additional training. Our results highlight the effectiveness of treating self-evolution as a learnable skill.

AI.tldr: LSE是一个强化学习框架，训练大语言模型在测试时自我改进上下文，通过单步RL目标和树引导进化循环，在Text-to-SQL和QA任务上超越GPT-5等模型。
AI.motivation: 现有方法完全依赖模型的固有推理能力，从未明确训练模型进行自我进化任务。LSE旨在将自我进化作为可学习的技能，让模型在测试时通过反馈迭代改进上下文。
AI.method: LSE将多步进化问题简化为单步强化学习目标，每个上下文编辑的奖励基于下游性能的改进。结合树引导进化循环，训练模型在测试时自我改进上下文。
AI.result: 在Text-to-SQL生成（BIRD）和通用问答（MMLU-Redux）任务上，使用LSE训练的4B参数模型超越了GPT-5和Claude Sonnet 4.5驱动的自我进化策略，以及GEPA和TextGrad等提示优化方法。
AI.conclusion: LSE框架证明了将自我进化视为可学习技能的有效性，训练后的模型能够指导其他模型而无需额外训练，展示了自我进化作为可学习技能的潜力。

title: An Onto-Relational-Sophic Framework for Governing Synthetic Minds
summary: The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence, from task-specific systems to foundation models exhibiting broad, flexible competence across reasoning, creative synthesis, and social interaction, has outpaced the conceptual and governance frameworks designed to manage it. Current regulatory paradigms, anchored in a tool-centric worldview, address algorithmic bias and transparency but leave unanswered foundational questions about what increasingly capable synthetic minds are, how societies should relate to them, and the normative principles that should guide their development. Here we introduce the Onto-Relational-Sophic (ORS) framework, grounded in Cyberism philosophy, which offers integrated answers to these challenges through three pillars: (1) a Cyber-Physical-Social-Thinking (CPST) ontology that defines the mode of being for synthetic minds as irreducibly multi-dimensional rather than purely computational; (2) a graded spectrum of digital personhood providing a pragmatic relational taxonomy beyond binary person-or-tool classifications; and (3) Cybersophy, a wisdom-oriented axiology synthesizing virtue ethics, consequentialism, and relational approaches to guide governance. We apply the framework to emergent scenarios including autonomous research agents, AI-mediated healthcare, and agentic AI ecosystems, demonstrating its capacity to generate proportionate, adaptive governance recommendations. The ORS framework charts a path from narrow technical alignment toward comprehensive philosophical foundations for the synthetic minds already among us.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ORS框架，为日益强大的合成智能体建立哲学基础，超越传统工具视角，解决其本体论、关系伦理和治理原则问题。
AI.motivation: 人工智能从任务特定系统发展到具有广泛能力的基座模型，其发展速度已超越现有的概念和治理框架。当前基于工具视角的监管范式无法回答关于合成智能体本质、社会关系以及发展原则等根本问题。
AI.method: 提出基于赛博主义哲学的Onto-Relational-Sophic（ORS）框架，包含三个支柱：1）CPST本体论，将合成智能体定义为不可简化的多维存在而非纯计算实体；2）分级数字人格谱系，提供超越二元分类的实用关系分类法；3）赛博智慧学，融合美德伦理、后果主义和关系伦理的智慧导向价值体系。
AI.result: 将ORS框架应用于自主研究代理、AI医疗中介和智能体生态系统等新兴场景，展示了其生成相称、适应性治理建议的能力。该框架为合成智能体提供了从狭隘技术对齐转向全面哲学基础的发展路径。
AI.conclusion: ORS框架为理解和管理日益强大的合成智能体提供了综合哲学基础，超越了传统的工具视角，通过本体论、关系分类和价值体系三个维度，为合成智能体的治理和发展提供了更全面的指导原则。

title: OnlinePG: Online Open-Vocabulary Panoptic Mapping with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Open-vocabulary scene understanding with online panoptic mapping is essential for embodied applications to perceive and interact with environments. However, existing methods are predominantly offline or lack instance-level understanding, limiting their applicability to real-world robotic tasks. In this paper, we propose OnlinePG, a novel and effective system that integrates geometric reconstruction and open-vocabulary perception using 3D Gaussian Splatting in an online setting. Technically, to achieve online panoptic mapping, we employ an efficient local-to-global paradigm with a sliding window. To build local consistency map, we construct a 3D segment clustering graph that jointly leverages geometric and semantic cues, fusing inconsistent segments within sliding window into complete instances. Subsequently, to update the global map, we construct explicit grids with spatial attributes for the local 3D Gaussian map and fuse them into the global map via robust bidirectional bipartite 3D Gaussian instance matching. Finally, we utilize the fused VLM features inside the 3D spatial attribute grids to achieve open-vocabulary scene understanding. Extensive experiments on widely used datasets demonstrate that our method achieves better performance among online approaches, while maintaining real-time efficiency.

AI.tldr: OnlinePG：首个在线开放词汇全景映射系统，结合3D高斯泼溅实现实时几何重建与实例级场景理解
AI.motivation: 现有方法多为离线或缺乏实例级理解，限制了在真实机器人任务中的应用，需要实时的开放词汇全景场景理解系统
AI.method: 采用滑动窗口的局部到全局范式：1)构建局部一致性图，通过几何和语义线索融合不一致片段；2)将局部3D高斯图转换为显式网格，通过双向二分3D高斯实例匹配更新全局地图；3)利用VLM特征实现开放词汇理解
AI.result: 在广泛使用的数据集上实验表明，该方法在在线方法中达到最佳性能，同时保持实时效率
AI.conclusion: OnlinePG是首个有效的在线开放词汇全景映射系统，为具身应用提供了实时感知和交互能力

title: A Comparative Empirical Study of Catastrophic Forgetting Mitigation in Sequential Task Adaptation for Continual Natural Language Processing Systems
summary: Neural language models deployed in real-world applications must continually adapt to new tasks and domains without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. This work presents a comparative empirical study of catastrophic forgetting mitigation in continual intent classification. Using the CLINC150 dataset, we construct a 10-task label-disjoint scenario and evaluate three backbone architectures: a feed-forward Artificial Neural Network (ANN), a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and a Transformer encoder, under a range of continual learning (CL) strategies. We consider one representative method from each major CL family: replay-based Maximally Interfered Retrieval (MIR), regularization-based Learning without Forgetting (LwF), and parameter-isolation via Hard Attention to Task (HAT), both individually and in all pairwise and triple combinations. Performance is assessed with average accuracy, macro F1, and backward transfer, capturing the stability-plasticity trade-off across the task sequence. Our results show that naive sequential fine-tuning suffers from severe forgetting for all architectures and that no single CL method fully prevents it. Replay emerges as a key ingredient: MIR is the most reliable individual strategy, and combinations that include replay (MIR+HAT, MIR+LwF, MIR+LwF+HAT) consistently achieve high final performance with near-zero or mildly positive backward transfer. The optimal configuration is architecture-dependent. MIR+HAT yields the best result for ANN and Transformer, MIR+LwF+HAT, on the other hand, works the best for GRU, and in several cases CL methods even surpass joint training, indicating a regularization effect. These findings highlight the importance of jointly selecting backbone architecture and CL mechanism when designing continual intent-classification systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了持续学习策略在意图分类任务中的表现，发现回放方法是缓解灾难性遗忘的关键，最优配置因神经网络架构而异。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的神经语言模型需要持续适应新任务而不遗忘旧知识，本研究旨在比较不同持续学习策略在意图分类任务中缓解灾难性遗忘的效果。
AI.method: 使用CLINC150数据集构建10个任务场景，评估三种神经网络架构（ANN、GRU、Transformer）在多种持续学习策略下的表现，包括回放方法MIR、正则化方法LwF和参数隔离方法HAT，以及它们的组合。
AI.result: 简单顺序微调会导致严重遗忘，没有单一持续学习方法能完全防止遗忘。回放是关键因素：MIR是最可靠的单一策略，包含回放的组合（MIR+HAT、MIR+LwF、MIR+LwF+HAT）表现最佳。最优配置取决于架构：ANN和Transformer适合MIR+HAT，GRU适合MIR+LwF+HAT。
AI.conclusion: 设计持续意图分类系统时需要联合选择骨干架构和持续学习机制，回放方法是缓解灾难性遗忘的关键组成部分。

title: Balanced Thinking: Improving Chain of Thought Training in Vision Language Models
summary: Multimodal reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on a two-stage process: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). In standard SFT, all tokens contribute equally to the loss, even though reasoning data are inherently token-imbalanced. Long <think> traces overshadow short but task-critical <answer> segments, leading to verbose reasoning and inaccurate answers. We propose SCALe (Scheduled Curriculum Adaptive Loss), which explicitly separates supervision over reasoning and answer segments using dynamic, length-independent weighting. Unlike vanilla SFT, which overweights the <think> segment, SCALe-SFT gradually shifts the focus from <think> to <answer> throughout training via a cosine scheduling policy, encouraging concise and well-grounded reasoning. We evaluate SCALe across diverse benchmarks and architectures. Results show that SCALe consistently improves accuracy over vanilla SFT and matches the performance of the full two-phase SFT + GRPO pipeline while requiring only about one-seventh of the training time, making it a lightweight yet effective alternative. When combined with GRPO, SCALe achieves the best overall performance, highlighting its value both as a standalone method and as a strong foundation for reinforcement refinement.

AI.tldr: SCALe提出了一种新的监督微调方法，通过动态调整推理段和答案段的权重，解决了多模态推理中token不平衡问题，显著提升了准确性和训练效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的监督微调中，所有token对损失的贡献相同，但推理数据本质上是token不平衡的。长的<think>推理段会掩盖短的但任务关键的<answer>答案段，导致冗长的推理和不准确的答案。
AI.method: 提出了SCALe（Scheduled Curriculum Adaptive Loss）方法，通过动态、长度独立的权重明确分离对推理段和答案段的监督。使用余弦调度策略在训练过程中逐渐将焦点从<think>段转移到<answer>段，鼓励简洁且基于事实的推理。
AI.result: SCALe在不同基准测试和架构上一致优于传统的监督微调，性能与完整的SFT+GRPO两阶段流程相当，但训练时间仅需约七分之一。当与GRPO结合时，SCALe实现了最佳整体性能。
AI.conclusion: SCALe是一种轻量级但有效的替代方案，既可以作为独立方法使用，也可以作为强化学习优化的强大基础，在多模态推理中实现了更好的准确性和效率平衡。

title: Automatic detection of Gen-AI texts: A comparative framework of neural models
summary: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Models has significantly increased the difficulty of distinguishing between human-written and AI generated texts, raising critical issues across academic, editorial, and social domains. This paper investigates the problem of AI generated text detection through the design, implementation, and comparative evaluation of multiple machine learning based detectors. Four neural architectures are developed and analyzed: a Multilayer Perceptron, a one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network, a MobileNet-based CNN, and a Transformer model. The proposed models are benchmarked against widely used online detectors, including ZeroGPT, GPTZero, QuillBot, Originality.AI, Sapling, IsGen, Rephrase, and Writer. Experiments are conducted on the COLING Multilingual Dataset, considering both English and Italian configurations, as well as on an original thematic dataset focused on Art and Mental Health. Results show that supervised detectors achieve more stable and robust performance than commercial tools across different languages and domains, highlighting key strengths and limitations of current detection strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过设计和评估多种机器学习检测器来解决AI生成文本检测问题，发现监督学习检测器在不同语言和领域上比商业工具表现更稳定和鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的快速扩散显著增加了区分人类写作和AI生成文本的难度，这在学术、编辑和社会领域引发了关键问题。需要开发有效的检测方法来应对这一挑战。
AI.method: 研究设计、实现并比较评估了多种基于机器学习的检测器，包括四种神经网络架构：多层感知机、一维卷积神经网络、基于MobileNet的CNN和Transformer模型。这些模型与广泛使用的在线检测器进行了基准测试。
AI.result: 实验在COLING多语言数据集（英语和意大利语配置）以及原创的艺术与心理健康主题数据集上进行。结果显示，监督检测器在不同语言和领域中比商业工具实现了更稳定和鲁棒的性能。
AI.conclusion: 监督学习检测器在AI生成文本检测方面表现出比现有商业工具更好的性能，突显了当前检测策略的关键优势和局限性，为未来检测技术的发展提供了重要参考。

title: Thinking with Constructions: A Benchmark and Policy Optimization for Visual-Text Interleaved Geometric Reasoning
summary: Geometric reasoning inherently requires "thinking with constructions" -- the dynamic manipulation of visual aids to bridge the gap between problem conditions and solutions. However, existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are largely confined to passive inference with static diagrams, lacking the strategic knowledge of when and how to construct effective visual aids. To address this, we present a framework for Visual-Text Interleaved Chain-of-Thought. We first introduce GeoAux-Bench, the first benchmark comprising 4,334 geometry problems that aligns textual construction steps with ground-truth visual updates. Our pilot study reveals two critical insights: (1) interleaved visual-textual aids outperform single-modality counterparts, which cannot losslessly capture geometric synergy; and (2) valid constructions act as entropy reducers, strongly correlating with reduced reasoning perplexity. Building on these findings, we propose Action Applicability Policy Optimization (A2PO), a reinforcement learning paradigm for mastering strategic construction. A2PO employs Adaptive Reward Shaping to regulate the timing and quality of visual aids via counterfactual sampling to distinguish necessary from redundant constructions. Experiments demonstrate our approach enables MLLMs to leverage selective auxiliary constructions, yielding a 3.51% gain over strong baselines. Code and data are available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了视觉-文本交织思维链框架，通过GeoAux-Bench基准测试和A2PO强化学习方法，使多模态大语言模型能够主动进行几何构造，提升几何推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在几何推理中仅限于对静态图表的被动推理，缺乏何时以及如何构造有效视觉辅助的战略知识。几何推理本质上需要"通过构造思考"——动态操作视觉辅助来弥合问题条件与解决方案之间的差距。
AI.method: 1. 引入GeoAux-Bench基准测试，包含4,334个几何问题，将文本构造步骤与真实视觉更新对齐；2. 提出Action Applicability Policy Optimization (A2PO)强化学习范式，通过自适应奖励塑造来调节视觉辅助的时机和质量；3. 使用反事实采样区分必要和冗余构造。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法使MLLMs能够利用选择性辅助构造，相比强基线获得3.51%的性能提升。研究发现：(1) 交织的视觉-文本辅助优于单模态方法；(2) 有效构造作为熵减器，与降低的推理困惑度强相关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过视觉-文本交织思维链框架和A2PO强化学习方法，成功使多模态大语言模型掌握了战略构造能力，显著提升了几何推理性能，为动态视觉辅助在AI推理中的应用提供了新思路。

title: Counting Circuits: Mechanistic Interpretability of Visual Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Counting serves as a simple but powerful test of a Large Vision-Language Model's (LVLM's) reasoning; it forces the model to identify each individual object and then add them all up. In this study, we investigate how LVLMs implement counting using controlled synthetic and real-world benchmarks, combined with mechanistic analyses. Our results show that LVLMs display a human-like counting behavior, with precise performance on small numerosities and noisy estimation for larger quantities. We introduce two novel interpretability methods, Visual Activation Patching and HeadLens, and use them to uncover a structured "counting circuit" that is largely shared across a variety of visual reasoning tasks. Building on these insights, we propose a lightweight intervention strategy that exploits simple and abundantly available synthetic images to fine-tune arbitrary pretrained LVLMs exclusively on counting. Despite the narrow scope of this fine-tuning, the intervention not only enhances counting accuracy on in-distribution synthetic data, but also yields an average improvement of +8.36% on out-of-distribution counting benchmarks and an average gain of +1.54% on complex, general visual reasoning tasks for Qwen2.5-VL. These findings highlight the central, influential role of counting in visual reasoning and suggest a potential pathway for improving overall visual reasoning capabilities through targeted enhancement of counting mechanisms.

AI.tldr: LVLMs展现类似人类的计数行为，研究者通过可解释性方法发现了共享的"计数电路"，并提出仅用合成图像微调计数能力即可提升整体视觉推理性能
AI.motivation: 计数作为简单但强大的测试，能够检验大型视觉语言模型的推理能力，研究者希望理解LVLMs如何实现计数，并探索通过增强计数机制来提升整体视觉推理性能的途径
AI.method: 使用受控的合成和真实世界基准测试，结合机械分析；引入两种新的可解释性方法（Visual Activation Patching和HeadLens）来揭示计数机制；提出轻量级干预策略，仅使用简单合成图像对预训练LVLMs进行计数微调
AI.result: LVLMs表现出类似人类的计数行为：小数量精确，大数量噪声估计；发现了跨多种视觉推理任务共享的结构化"计数电路"；仅计数微调不仅提升了分布内合成数据的计数准确率，还在分布外计数基准上平均提升+8.36%，在复杂通用视觉推理任务上为Qwen2.5-VL带来平均+1.54%的提升
AI.conclusion: 计数在视觉推理中扮演核心且有影响力的角色，通过针对性增强计数机制可能成为提升整体视觉推理能力的潜在途径

title: Accurate and Efficient Multi-Channel Time Series Forecasting via Sparse Attention Mechanism
summary:
The task of multi-channel time series forecasting is ubiquitous in numerous fields such as finance, supply chain management, and energy planning. It is critical to effectively capture complex dynamic dependencies within and between channels for accurate predictions. However, traditional method paid few attentions on learning the interaction among channels. This paper proposes Linear-Network (Li-Net), a novel architecture designed for multi-channel time series forecasting that captures the linear and non-linear dependencies among channels. Li-Net dynamically compresses representations across sequence and channel dimensions, processes the information through a configurable non-linear module and subsequently reconstructs the forecasts. Moreover, Li-Net integrates a sparse Top-K Softmax attention mechanism within a multi-scale projection framework to address these challenges. A core innovation is its ability to seamlessly incorporate and fuse multi-modal embeddings, guiding the sparse attention process to focus on the most informative time steps and feature channels. Through the experiment results on multiple real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that Li-Net achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baseline methods. Furthermore, Li-Net provides a superior balance between prediction accuracy and computational burden, exhibiting significantly lower memory usage and faster inference times. Detailed ablation studies and parameter sensitivity analyses validate the effectiveness of each key component in our proposed architecture.
  Keywords: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting, Sparse Attention Mechanism, Multimodal Information Fusion, Non-linear relationship

AI.tldr: Li-Net是一种用于多通道时间序列预测的新型架构，通过动态压缩序列和通道维度的表示，结合可配置的非线性模块和稀疏Top-K Softmax注意力机制，有效捕捉通道间的线性和非线性依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 多通道时间序列预测在金融、供应链管理、能源规划等领域普遍存在，传统方法很少关注通道间的交互作用，而有效捕捉通道内和通道间的复杂动态依赖对于准确预测至关重要。
AI.method: 提出Linear-Network (Li-Net)架构，动态压缩序列和通道维度的表示，通过可配置非线性模块处理信息并重建预测；集成稀疏Top-K Softmax注意力机制于多尺度投影框架；创新性地融合多模态嵌入，引导稀疏注意力关注最具信息量的时间步和特征通道。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界基准数据集上的实验结果表明，Li-Net相比最先进的基线方法具有竞争力；在预测精度和计算负担之间提供优越平衡，内存使用显著降低，推理时间更快；消融研究和参数敏感性分析验证了各关键组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Li-Net通过创新的架构设计有效解决了多通道时间序列预测中通道间依赖关系建模的挑战，在保持高预测精度的同时显著降低了计算成本，为实际应用提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Detecting Basic Values in A Noisy Russian Social Media Text Data: A Multi-Stage Classification Framework
summary: This study presents a multi-stage classification framework for detecting human values in noisy Russian language social media, validated on a random sample of 7.5 million public text posts. Drawing on Schwartz's theory of basic human values, we design a multi-stage pipeline that includes spam and nonpersonal content filtering, targeted selection of value relevant and politically relevant posts, LLM based annotation, and multi-label classification. Particular attention is given to verifying the quality of LLM annotations and model predictions against human experts. We treat human expert annotations not as ground truth but as an interpretative benchmark with its own uncertainty. To account for annotation subjectivity, we aggregate multiple LLM generated judgments into soft labels that reflect varying levels of agreement. These labels are then used to train transformer based models capable of predicting the probability of each of the ten basic values. The best performing model, XLM RoBERTa large, achieves an F1 macro of 0.83 and an F1 of 0.71 on held out test data. By treating value detection as a multi perspective interpretive task, where expert labels, GPT annotations, and model predictions represent coherent but not identical readings of the same texts, we show that the model generally aligns with human judgments but systematically overestimates the Openness to Change value domain. Empirically, the study reveals distinct patterns of value expression and their co-occurrence in Russian social networks, contributing to a broader research agenda on cultural variation, communicative framing, and value based interpretation in digital environments. All models are released publicly.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个多阶段分类框架，用于检测俄语社交媒体中的人类价值观，基于施瓦茨基本价值观理论，通过LLM标注和transformer模型预测，在750万帖子上验证，最佳模型F1宏平均达0.83。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是开发一个能够从嘈杂的俄语社交媒体文本中检测人类价值观的系统，解决传统方法在处理大规模社交媒体数据时的局限性，同时考虑标注主观性和不确定性。
AI.method: 采用多阶段流水线：1) 垃圾和非个人内容过滤；2) 针对性选择与价值观和政治相关的帖子；3) 基于LLM的标注；4) 多标签分类。特别关注LLM标注质量验证，将人类专家标注视为解释性基准而非绝对真值，通过聚合多个LLM判断生成软标签来应对标注主观性。
AI.result: 最佳模型XLM RoBERTa large在测试集上达到F1宏平均0.83和F1 0.71。模型总体上与人类判断一致，但系统性地高估"开放变化"价值观领域。研究揭示了俄语社交网络中价值观表达的独特模式和共现规律。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过将价值观检测视为多视角解释任务，展示了模型与人类判断的一致性，同时识别了系统偏差。研究为文化变异、传播框架和数字环境中的价值观解释研究提供了新方法，所有模型已公开发布。

title: MemMA: Coordinating the Memory Cycle through Multi-Agent Reasoning and In-Situ Self-Evolution
summary: Memory-augmented LLM agents maintain external memory banks to support long-horizon interaction, yet most existing systems treat construction, retrieval, and utilization as isolated subroutines. This creates two coupled challenges: strategic blindness on the forward path of the memory cycle, where construction and retrieval are driven by local heuristics rather than explicit strategic reasoning, and sparse, delayed supervision on the backward path, where downstream failures rarely translate into direct repairs of the memory bank. To address these challenges, we propose MemMA, a plug-and-play multi-agent framework that coordinates the memory cycle along both the forward and backward paths. On the forward path, a Meta-Thinker produces structured guidance that steers a Memory Manager during construction and directs a Query Reasoner during iterative retrieval. On the backward path, MemMA introduces in-situ self-evolving memory construction, which synthesizes probe QA pairs, verifies the current memory, and converts failures into repair actions before the memory is finalized. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo show that MemMA consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple LLM backbones and improves three different storage backends in a plug-and-play manner. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ventr1c/memma.

title: Why Better Cross-Lingual Alignment Fails for Better Cross-Lingual Transfer: Case of Encoders
summary: Better cross-lingual alignment is often assumed to yield better cross-lingual transfer. However, explicit alignment techniques -- despite increasing embedding similarity -- frequently fail to improve token-level downstream performance. In this work, we show that this mismatch arises because alignment and downstream task objectives are largely orthogonal, and because the downstream benefits from alignment vary substantially across languages and task types. We analyze four XLM-R encoder models aligned on different language pairs and fine-tuned for either POS Tagging or Sentence Classification. Using representational analyses, including embedding distances, gradient similarities, and gradient magnitudes for both task and alignment losses, we find that: (1) embedding distances alone are unreliable predictors of improvements (or degradations) in task performance and (2) alignment and task gradients are often close to orthogonal, indicating that optimizing one objective may contribute little to optimizing the other. Taken together, our findings explain why ``better'' alignment often fails to translate into ``better'' cross-lingual transfer. Based on these insights, we provide practical guidelines for combining cross-lingual alignment with task-specific fine-tuning, highlighting the importance of careful loss selection.

AI.tldr: 跨语言对齐与下游任务性能之间存在不匹配：更好的对齐并不总是带来更好的跨语言迁移，因为对齐目标和任务目标基本正交，且不同语言和任务类型的收益差异很大。
AI.motivation: 研究跨语言对齐与下游任务性能之间的关系，解释为什么显式对齐技术虽然增加了嵌入相似性，却经常无法改善标记级下游性能。
AI.method: 分析四个在不同语言对上对齐的XLM-R编码器模型，这些模型针对词性标注或句子分类进行微调。使用表示分析，包括嵌入距离、梯度相似性和对齐损失与任务损失的梯度大小。
AI.result: 发现：(1) 嵌入距离本身是任务性能改善（或退化）的不可靠预测指标；(2) 对齐梯度和任务梯度通常接近正交，表明优化一个目标可能对优化另一个目标贡献很小。
AI.conclusion: 更好的对齐并不总是转化为更好的跨语言迁移，因为对齐和下游任务目标基本正交。基于这些见解，提供了结合跨语言对齐与任务特定微调的实用指南，强调仔细选择损失函数的重要性。

title: Analysis Of Linguistic Stereotypes in Single and Multi-Agent Generative AI Architectures
summary: Many works in the literature show that LLM outputs exhibit discriminatory behaviour, triggering stereotype-based inferences based on the dialect in which the inputs are written. This bias has been shown to be particularly pronounced when the same inputs are provided to LLMs in Standard American English (SAE) and African-American English (AAE). In this paper, we replicate existing analyses of dialect-sensitive stereotype generation in LLM outputs and investigate the effects of mitigation strategies, including prompt engineering (role-based and Chain-Of-Thought prompting) and multi-agent architectures composed of generate-critique-revise models. We define eight prompt templates to analyse different ways in which dialect bias can manifest, such as suggested names, jobs, and adjectives for SAE or AAE speakers. We use an LLM-as-judge approach to evaluate the bias in the results. Our results show that stereotype-bearing differences emerge between SAE- and AAE-related outputs across all template categories, with the strongest effects observed in adjective and job attribution. Baseline disparities vary substantially by model, with the largest SAE-AAE differential observed in Claude Haiku and the smallest in Phi-4 Mini. Chain-Of-Thought prompting proved to be an effective mitigation strategy for Claude Haiku, whereas the use of a multi-agent architecture ensured consistent mitigation across all the models. These findings suggest that for intersectionality-informed software engineering, fairness evaluation should include model-specific validation of mitigation strategies, and workflow-level controls (e.g., agentic architectures involving critique models) in high-impact LLM deployments. The current results are exploratory in nature and limited in scope, but can lead to extensions and replications by increasing the dataset size and applying the procedure to different languages or dialects.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM输出存在方言歧视，特别是标准美式英语与非裔美式英语之间的刻板印象差异，通过提示工程和多智能体架构可缓解此偏见
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明LLM输出存在基于方言的歧视性行为，特别是在标准美式英语(SAE)和非裔美式英语(AAE)之间表现出明显的刻板印象偏见，需要研究有效的缓解策略
AI.method: 复制现有方言敏感刻板印象生成分析，研究缓解策略包括提示工程（基于角色和思维链提示）和多智能体架构（生成-批评-修订模型），定义八个提示模板分析方言偏见表现方式，使用LLM作为评判者评估结果偏见
AI.result: SAE和AAE相关输出在所有模板类别中都出现刻板印象差异，形容词和工作归因方面差异最显著；不同模型基线差异显著，Claude Haiku的SAE-AAE差异最大，Phi-4 Mini最小；思维链提示对Claude Haiku是有效缓解策略，多智能体架构确保所有模型的一致性缓解
AI.conclusion: 对于交叉性软件工程，公平性评估应包括缓解策略的模型特定验证，在高影响LLM部署中使用工作流级控制（如涉及批评模型的智能体架构）；当前结果是探索性的，可通过增加数据集规模和应用到不同语言或方言进行扩展

title: HiMu: Hierarchical Multimodal Frame Selection for Long Video Question Answering
summary: Long-form video question answering requires reasoning over extended temporal contexts, making frame selection critical for large vision-language models (LVLMs) bound by finite context windows. Existing methods face a sharp trade-off: similarity-based selectors are fast but collapse compositional queries into a single dense vector, losing sub-event ordering and cross-modal bindings; agent-based methods recover this structure through iterative LVLM inference, but at prohibitive cost. We introduce HiMu, a training-free framework that bridges this gap. A single text-only LLM call decomposes the query into a hierarchical logic tree whose leaves are atomic predicates, each routed to a lightweight expert spanning vision (CLIP, open-vocabulary detection, OCR) and audio (ASR, CLAP). The resulting signals are normalized, temporally smoothed to align different modalities, and composed bottom-up through fuzzy-logic operators that enforce temporal sequencing and adjacency, producing a continuous satisfaction curve. Evaluations on Video-MME, LongVideoBench and HERBench-Lite show that HiMu advances the efficiency-accuracy Pareto front: at 16 frames with Qwen3-VL 8B it outperforms all competing selectors, and with GPT-4o it surpasses agentic systems operating at 32-512 frames while requiring roughly 10x fewer FLOPs.

AI.tldr: HiMu是一个无需训练的视频问答框架，通过单次LLM调用将查询分解为层次逻辑树，使用轻量级专家处理多模态信号，通过模糊逻辑算子组合结果，在效率和准确性上取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答需要在有限上下文窗口内处理长时间上下文，现有方法面临效率与准确性的权衡：基于相似性的选择器快速但丢失子事件顺序和跨模态绑定；基于代理的方法能恢复结构但计算成本过高。
AI.method: 使用单次文本LLM调用将查询分解为层次逻辑树，叶子节点为原子谓词，路由到轻量级专家（视觉：CLIP、开放词汇检测、OCR；音频：ASR、CLAP）。对结果信号进行归一化、时间平滑对齐不同模态，通过模糊逻辑算子自底向上组合，强制执行时间顺序和相邻性约束。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和HERBench-Lite上的评估显示，HiMu提升了效率-准确性的帕累托前沿：使用Qwen3-VL 8B在16帧时优于所有竞争选择器，使用GPT-4o时超越在32-512帧上运行的代理系统，同时所需FLOPs减少约10倍。
AI.conclusion: HiMu框架在长视频问答中有效平衡了效率和准确性，通过层次逻辑分解和轻量级专家路由避免了现有方法的局限性，为有限上下文窗口下的长视频理解提供了实用解决方案。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Lessons from the Language Learning Students' Perspective: A Short Case Study on Duolingo
comment: 5 pages,3 figures,presented at the 3rd HEAL Workshop at CHI 2026
summary: Popular language learning applications such as Duolingo use large language models (LLMs) to generate lessons for its users. Most lessons focus on general real-world scenarios such as greetings, ordering food, or asking directions, with limited support for profession-specific contexts. This gap can hinder learners from achieving professional-level fluency, which we define as the ability to communicate comfortably various work-related and domain-specific information in the target language. We surveyed five employees from a multinational company in the Philippines on their experiences with Duolingo. Results show that respondents encountered general scenarios more frequently than work-related ones, and that the former are relatable and effective in building foundational grammar, vocabulary, and cultural knowledge. The latter helps bridge the gap toward professional fluency as it contains domain-specific vocabulary. Each participant suggested lesson scenarios that diverge in contexts hen analyzed in aggregate. With this understanding, we propose that language learning applications should generate lessons that adapt to an individual's needs through personalized, domain specific lesson scenarios while maintaining foundational support through general, relatable lesson scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了语言学习应用（如Duolingo）在专业场景教学方面的不足，发现现有课程主要关注日常生活场景，缺乏针对职业特定语境的个性化内容，阻碍了学习者达到专业流利度。
AI.motivation: 当前流行的语言学习应用（如Duolingo）主要使用大语言模型生成通用日常生活场景的课程，但缺乏对职业特定语境的支持。这种不足可能阻碍学习者达到专业流利度，即在工作相关和领域特定信息交流方面的舒适沟通能力。
AI.method: 研究调查了菲律宾一家跨国公司的五名员工使用Duolingo的经验。通过调查了解他们在应用中遇到的一般场景与工作相关场景的频率，以及这些场景对语言学习的有效性。
AI.result: 调查结果显示：受访者遇到一般场景的频率高于工作相关场景；一般场景具有相关性和有效性，能帮助建立基础语法、词汇和文化知识；工作相关场景有助于缩小专业流利度的差距，包含领域特定词汇；每位参与者建议的课程场景在汇总分析时显示出不同的语境需求。
AI.conclusion: 语言学习应用应通过个性化的领域特定课程场景来适应个体需求，同时通过通用、相关的课程场景保持基础支持，以帮助学习者达到专业流利度。

title: Memento-Skills: Let Agents Design Agents
summary:
We introduce \emph{Memento-Skills}, a generalist, continually-learnable LLM agent system that functions as an \emph{agent-designing agent}: it autonomously constructs, adapts, and improves task-specific agents through experience. The system is built on a memory-based reinforcement learning framework with \emph{stateful prompts}, where reusable skills (stored as structured markdown files) serve as persistent, evolving memory. These skills encode both behaviour and context, enabling the agent to carry forward knowledge across interactions.
  Starting from simple elementary skills (like Web search and terminal operations), the agent continually improves via the \emph{Read--Write Reflective Learning} mechanism introduced in \emph{Memento~2}~\cite{wang2025memento2}. In the \emph{read} phase, a behaviour-trainable skill router selects the most relevant skill conditioned on the current stateful prompt; in the \emph{write} phase, the agent updates and expands its skill library based on new experience. This closed-loop design enables \emph{continual learning without updating LLM parameters}, as all adaptation is realised through the evolution of externalised skills and prompts.
  Unlike prior approaches that rely on human-designed agents, Memento-Skills enables a generalist agent to \emph{design agents end-to-end} for new tasks. Through iterative skill generation and refinement, the system progressively improves its own capabilities. Experiments on the \emph{General AI Assistants} benchmark and \emph{Humanity's Last Exam} demonstrate sustained gains, achieving 26.2\% and 116.2\% relative improvements in overall accuracy, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/Memento-Teams/Memento-Skills.

AI.tldr: Memento-Skills是一个基于记忆的强化学习框架，通过状态提示和可重用技能实现持续学习的通用LLM智能体系统，能够自主构建、调整和改进任务特定的智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖人工设计的智能体，缺乏自主学习和适应能力。需要一种能够持续学习、自主设计智能体并提升自身能力的通用系统。
AI.method: 采用基于记忆的强化学习框架，使用状态提示和结构化Markdown文件存储的可重用技能作为持久化记忆。通过"读-写反思学习"机制：读阶段选择最相关技能，写阶段基于新经验更新和扩展技能库。
AI.result: 在General AI Assistants基准测试中实现26.2%的相对准确率提升，在Humanity's Last Exam中实现116.2%的相对准确率提升。系统能够在不更新LLM参数的情况下实现持续学习。
AI.conclusion: Memento-Skills证明了通过外部化技能和提示的演化实现持续学习的可行性，使通用智能体能够为全新任务端到端地设计智能体，通过迭代技能生成和精炼逐步提升能力。

title: CausalVAD: De-confounding End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Causal Intervention
summary: Planning-oriented end-to-end driving models show great promise, yet they fundamentally learn statistical correlations instead of true causal relationships. This vulnerability leads to causal confusion, where models exploit dataset biases as shortcuts, critically harming their reliability and safety in complex scenarios. To address this, we introduce CausalVAD, a de-confounding training framework that leverages causal intervention. At its core, we design the sparse causal intervention scheme (SCIS), a lightweight, plug-and-play module to instantiate the backdoor adjustment theory in neural networks. SCIS constructs a dictionary of prototypes representing latent driving contexts. It then uses this dictionary to intervene on the model's sparse vectorized queries. This step actively eliminates spurious associations induced by confounders, thereby eliminating spurious factors from the representations for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmarks like nuScenes show CausalVAD achieves state-of-the-art planning accuracy and safety. Furthermore, our method demonstrates superior robustness against both data bias and noisy scenarios configured to induce causal confusion.

AI.tldr: CausalVAD：一种基于因果干预的去混淆训练框架，通过稀疏因果干预方案消除自动驾驶规划模型中的虚假关联，提升可靠性和安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端驾驶模型学习的是统计相关性而非真实因果关系，容易受到数据集偏差的影响，导致因果混淆问题，严重影响复杂场景下的可靠性和安全性。
AI.method: 提出CausalVAD框架，核心是稀疏因果干预方案(SCIS)——一个轻量级即插即用模块，通过构建潜在驾驶上下文原型的字典，对模型的稀疏向量化查询进行干预，消除混淆变量引起的虚假关联。
AI.result: 在nuScenes等基准测试中，CausalVAD实现了最先进的规划精度和安全性，并且在针对数据偏差和噪声场景的鲁棒性测试中表现出色。
AI.conclusion: CausalVAD通过因果干预有效解决了自动驾驶规划模型中的因果混淆问题，显著提升了模型的可靠性和安全性，为端到端驾驶系统提供了更稳健的解决方案。

title: A Human-in/on-the-Loop Framework for Accessible Text Generation
comment: Accepted at LREC 2026. To appear in the Proceedings of the 14th International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC 2026)
summary: Plain Language and Easy-to-Read formats in text simplification are essential for cognitive accessibility. Yet current automatic simplification and evaluation pipelines remain largely automated, metric-driven, and fail to reflect user comprehension or normative standards. This paper introduces a hybrid framework that explicitly integrates human participation into LLM-based accessible text generation. Human-in-the-Loop (HiTL) contributions guide adjustments during generation, while Human-on-the-Loop (HoTL) supervision ensures systematic post-generation review. Empirical evidence from user studies and annotated resources is operationalized into (i) checklists aligned with standards, (ii) Event-Condition-Action trigger rules for activating expert oversight, and (iii) accessibility Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). The framework shows how human-centered mechanisms can be encoded for evaluation and reused to provide structured feedback that improves model adaptation. By embedding the human role in both generation and supervision, it establishes a traceable, reproducible, and auditable process for creating and evaluating accessible texts. In doing so, it integrates explainability and ethical accountability as core design principles, contributing to more transparent and inclusive NLP systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合框架，将人类参与明确整合到基于LLM的可访问文本生成中，通过人类在循环（HiTL）和人类在监督（HoTL）机制，建立可追溯、可复现、可审计的可访问文本创建和评估流程。
AI.motivation: 当前自动文本简化和评估流程主要依赖自动化指标驱动，未能反映用户实际理解能力或规范性标准，需要更人性化的方法来确保认知可访问性。
AI.method: 提出混合框架，整合人类在循环（HiTL）参与生成调整和人类在监督（HoTL）进行系统后生成审查，将实证证据转化为：1)标准对齐检查清单；2)事件-条件-动作触发规则激活专家监督；3)可访问性关键绩效指标（KPIs）。
AI.result: 该框架展示了如何将人类中心机制编码用于评估，并提供结构化反馈以改进模型适应，建立了可追溯、可复现、可审计的可访问文本创建和评估流程。
AI.conclusion: 通过将人类角色嵌入生成和监督过程，该框架将可解释性和伦理问责作为核心设计原则，有助于构建更透明、更具包容性的NLP系统。

title: NeuroGame Transformer: Gibbs-Inspired Attention Driven by Game Theory and Statistical Physics
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics for possible publication
summary: Standard attention mechanisms in transformers are limited by their pairwise formulation, which hinders the modeling of higher-order dependencies among tokens. We introduce the NeuroGame Transformer (NGT) to overcome this by reconceptualizing attention through a dual perspective: tokens are treated simultaneously as players in a cooperative game and as interacting spins in a statistical physics system. Token importance is quantified using two complementary game-theoretic concepts -- Shapley values for global, permutation-based attribution and Banzhaf indices for local, coalition-level influence. These are combined via a learnable gating parameter to form an external magnetic field, while pairwise interaction potentials capture synergistic relationships. The system's energy follows an Ising Hamiltonian, with attention weights emerging as marginal probabilities under the Gibbs distribution, efficiently computed via mean-field equations. To ensure scalability despite the exponential coalition space, we develop importance-weighted Monte Carlo estimators with Gibbs-distributed weights. This approach avoids explicit exponential factors, ensuring numerical stability for long sequences. We provide theoretical convergence guarantees and characterize the fairness-sensitivity trade-off governed by the interpolation parameter. Experimental results demonstrate that the NeuroGame Transformer achieves strong performance across SNLI, and MNLI-matched, outperforming some major efficient transformer baselines. On SNLI, it attains a test accuracy of 86.4\% (with a peak validation accuracy of 86.6\%), surpassing ALBERT-Base and remaining highly competitive with RoBERTa-Base. Code is available at https://github.com/dbouchaffra/NeuroGame-Transformer.

AI.tldr: NGT将注意力机制重构为合作博弈和统计物理系统，使用Shapley值和Banzhaf指数量化token重要性，通过Ising模型和Gibbs分布计算注意力权重，在保持数值稳定性的同时实现高阶依赖建模。
AI.motivation: 传统transformer的注意力机制局限于成对token交互，无法建模token间的高阶依赖关系，限制了模型对复杂语言结构的理解能力。
AI.method: 将token视为合作博弈中的玩家和统计物理中的自旋；使用Shapley值和Banzhaf指数量化token重要性，通过可学习门控参数组合形成外部磁场；采用Ising哈密顿量描述系统能量，注意力权重作为Gibbs分布的边际概率，通过平均场方程高效计算；使用重要性加权蒙特卡洛估计器处理指数级联盟空间。
AI.result: 在SNLI和MNLI-matched数据集上表现优异，SNLI测试准确率达到86.4%（验证峰值86.6%），超过ALBERT-Base，与RoBERTa-Base竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: NeuroGame Transformer通过博弈论和统计物理的融合，成功建模了token间的高阶依赖关系，在保持数值稳定性的同时提升了自然语言理解任务的性能。

title: HAViT: Historical Attention Vision Transformer
summary: Vision Transformers have excelled in computer vision but their attention mechanisms operate independently across layers, limiting information flow and feature learning. We propose an effective cross-layer attention propagation method that preserves and integrates historical attention matrices across encoder layers, offering a principled refinement of inter-layer information flow in Vision Transformers. This approach enables progressive refinement of attention patterns throughout the transformer hierarchy, enhancing feature acquisition and optimization dynamics. The method requires minimal architectural changes, adding only attention matrix storage and blending operations. Comprehensive experiments on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet demonstrate consistent accuracy improvements, with ViT performance increasing from 75.74% to 77.07% on CIFAR-100 (+1.33%) and from 57.82% to 59.07% on TinyImageNet (+1.25%). Cross-architecture validation shows similar gains across transformer variants, with CaiT showing 1.01% enhancement. Systematic analysis identifies the blending hyperparameter of historical attention (alpha = 0.45) as optimal across all configurations, providing the ideal balance between current and historical attention information. Random initialization consistently outperforms zero initialization, indicating that diverse initial attention patterns accelerate convergence and improve final performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/banik-s/HAViT.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种跨层注意力传播方法，通过保存和整合历史注意力矩阵来改进Vision Transformer的层间信息流，在CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet上实现了1.25-1.33%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer的注意力机制在各层独立运行，限制了信息流动和特征学习，需要改进层间信息传递机制。
AI.method: 提出跨层注意力传播方法，保存历史注意力矩阵并在编码器层间进行整合，通过注意力矩阵存储和混合操作实现，仅需最小架构修改。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100上ViT准确率从75.74%提升至77.07%（+1.33%），在TinyImageNet上从57.82%提升至59.07%（+1.25%）。跨架构验证显示CaiT也有1.01%提升。最佳混合超参数α=0.45，随机初始化优于零初始化。
AI.conclusion: 跨层注意力传播方法能有效改进Vision Transformer的信息流和特征学习，通过历史注意力矩阵的整合实现了性能提升，具有广泛适用性。

title: A Concept is More Than a Word: Diversified Unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Concept unlearning has emerged as a promising direction for reducing the risks of harmful content generation in text-to-image diffusion models by selectively erasing undesirable concepts from a model's parameters. Existing approaches typically rely on keywords to identify the target concept to be unlearned. However, we show that this keyword-based formulation is inherently limited: a visual concept is multi-dimensional, can be expressed in diverse textual forms, and often overlap with related concepts in the latent space, making keyword-only unlearning, which imprecisely indicate the target concept is brittle and prone to over-forgetting. This occurs because a single keyword represents only a narrow point estimate of the concept, failing to cover its full semantic distribution and entangled variations in the latent space. To address this limitation, we propose Diversified Unlearning, a distributional framework that represents a concept through a set of contextually diverse prompts rather than a single keyword. This richer representation enables more precise and robust unlearning. Through extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and state-of-the-art baselines, we demonstrate that integrating Diversified Unlearning as an add-on component into existing unlearning pipelines consistently achieves stronger erasure, better retention of unrelated concepts, and improved robustness against adversarial recovery attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diversified Unlearning方法，通过使用多样化提示而非单一关键词来表示概念，解决了现有概念遗忘方法因关键词局限性导致的过遗忘问题，实现了更精确、鲁棒的概念消除。
AI.motivation: 现有基于关键词的概念遗忘方法存在固有局限性：视觉概念是多维的，可以通过多种文本形式表达，且在潜在空间中常与相关概念重叠。单一关键词仅代表概念的窄点估计，无法覆盖其完整的语义分布和潜在空间中的纠缠变化，导致遗忘过程脆弱且容易过遗忘。
AI.method: 提出Diversified Unlearning分布框架，通过一组上下文多样化的提示而非单一关键词来表示概念。这种更丰富的表示方法能够实现更精确和鲁棒的遗忘。该方法可作为附加组件集成到现有的遗忘流程中。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和最先进基线方法上的广泛实验表明，将Diversified Unlearning集成到现有遗忘流程中，能够持续实现更强的概念消除、更好的无关概念保留，以及对对抗恢复攻击的改进鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Diversified Unlearning通过使用多样化提示表示概念，解决了关键词基础遗忘方法的局限性，为文本到图像扩散模型中的概念遗忘提供了更精确、鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Color image restoration based on nonlocal saturation-value similarity
summary: In this paper, we propose and develop a novel nonlocal variational technique based on saturation-value similarity for color image restoration. In traditional nonlocal methods, image patches are extracted from red, green and blue channels of a color image directly, and the color information can not be described finely because the patch similarity is mainly based on the grayscale value of independent channel. The main aim of this paper is to propose and develop a novel nonlocal regularization method by considering the similarity of image patches in saturation-value channel of a color image. In particular, we first establish saturation-value similarity based nonlocal total variation by incorporating saturation-value similarity of color image patches into the proposed nonlocal gradients, which can describe the saturation and value similarity of two adjacent color image patches. The proposed nonlocal variational models are then formulated based on saturation-value similarity based nonlocal total variation. Moreover, we design an effective and efficient algorithm to solve the proposed optimization problem numerically by employing bregmanized operator splitting method, and we also study the convergence of the proposed algorithms. Numerical examples are presented to demonstrate that the performance of the proposed models is better than that of other testing methods in terms of visual quality and some quantitative metrics including peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), quaternion structural similarity index (QSSIM) and S-CIELAB color error.

AI.tldr: 提出基于饱和度-亮度相似度的非局部变分方法用于彩色图像恢复，通过考虑饱和度-亮度通道的相似性改进传统非局部方法，在视觉质量和定量指标上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统非局部方法直接从彩色图像的RGB通道提取图像块，相似性主要基于独立通道的灰度值，无法精细描述颜色信息。需要一种能更好利用颜色信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于饱和度-亮度相似度的非局部总变分方法，将彩色图像块的饱和度-亮度相似性融入非局部梯度中。建立相应的非局部变分模型，并使用Bregmanized算子分裂法设计高效算法求解优化问题。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，所提模型在视觉质量和定量指标（PSNR、SSIM、QSSIM、S-CIELAB颜色误差）上均优于其他测试方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于饱和度-亮度相似度的非局部变分方法能有效提升彩色图像恢复质量，通过更好地利用颜色信息改进了传统非局部方法的性能。

title: Entropy trajectory shape predicts LLM reasoning reliability: A diagnostic study of uncertainty dynamics in chain-of-thought
summary:
Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves LLM accuracy, yet detecting failures cheaply remains elusive. We study whether the shape of uncertainty dynamics across reasoning steps--captured by sampling a few answer completions per step--predicts correctness.
  We introduce entropy-trajectory monotonicity: a chain is monotone if its per-step answer-distribution entropy decreases at every step. On GSM8K (n=300) with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, monotone chains achieve 68.8% accuracy vs. 46.8% for non-monotone chains (+21.9 pp; Fisher's p=0.0005; OR=2.50). Critically, total entropy reduction is not predictive ($ρ$=-0.06, p=0.31), revealing a shape-over-magnitude dissociation: whether entropy decreases at every step matters, not how much. Violation count 0/1/2 gives 68.8%/50.8%/28.6% accuracy.
  Token log-probability confidence worsens in calibration with step depth (ECE: 0.186->0.312), and monotonicity achieves +5.8 pp at 73.7% coverage, outperforming scalar baselines at approx 1,500 tokens/question--1/8 the cost of 40-chain self-consistency. Results replicate on Mistral-7B (n=300): monotone chains reach 72.3% vs. 37.6% (+34.7 pp; OR=4.33). Structural properties of uncertainty trajectories are thus more informative than aggregate measures.

AI.tldr: 通过分析思维链推理过程中不确定性动态的形状（而非总量）来预测答案正确性，发现熵轨迹单调性（每一步熵都减少）是强预测指标
AI.motivation: 思维链推理能提升LLM准确性，但如何低成本检测推理失败仍具挑战。研究者探索不确定性动态的形状特征是否能预测答案正确性
AI.method: 引入熵轨迹单调性概念：如果思维链每一步的答案分布熵都减少，则为单调链。在GSM8K数据集上使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型，通过采样少量答案完成来捕获不确定性动态
AI.result: 单调链准确率达68.8%，非单调链仅46.8%（+21.9pp）。关键发现：总熵减少量不具预测性（ρ=-0.06），表明形状比幅度更重要。违反次数0/1/2对应准确率68.8%/50.8%/28.6%。单调性方法在73.7%覆盖率下提升5.8pp，成本仅为40链自一致性方法的1/8
AI.conclusion: 不确定性轨迹的结构特性比聚合度量更具信息量，熵轨迹单调性是预测思维链推理正确性的有效且低成本指标

title: Proceedings of the 2nd Workshop on Advancing Artificial Intelligence through Theory of Mind
summary: This volume includes a selection of papers presented at the 2nd Workshop on Advancing Artificial Intelligence through Theory of Mind held at AAAI 2026 in Singapore on 26th January 2026. The purpose of this volume is to provide an open access and curated anthology for the ToM and AI research community.

AI.tldr: 这是AAAI 2026研讨会论文集的前言，介绍了第二届"通过心智理论推进人工智能"研讨会的论文选集，旨在为ToM和AI研究社区提供开放获取的精选文集。
AI.motivation: 为心智理论(ToM)和人工智能研究社区提供一个开放获取的精选文集，促进该领域的研究交流和发展。
AI.method: 通过组织AAAI 2026研讨会，征集和筛选相关论文，编辑成开放获取的论文集。
AI.result: 成功举办了第二届研讨会并出版了包含精选论文的开放获取论文集。
AI.conclusion: 该论文集为ToM和AI研究社区提供了有价值的学术资源，有助于推动心智理论在人工智能领域的应用和发展。

title: AU Codes, Language, and Synthesis: Translating Anatomy to Text for Facial Behavior Synthesis
summary: Facial behavior synthesis remains a critical yet underexplored challenge. While text-to-face models have made progress, they often rely on coarse emotion categories, which lack the nuance needed to capture the full spectrum of human nonverbal communication. Action Units (AUs) provide a more precise and anatomically grounded alternative. However, current AU-based approaches typically encode AUs as one-hot vectors, modeling compound expressions as simple linear combinations of individual AUs. This linearity becomes problematic when handling conflicting AUs--defined as those which activate the same facial muscle with opposing actions. Such cases lead to anatomically implausible artifacts and unnatural motion superpositions. To address this, we propose a novel method that represents facial behavior through natural language descriptions of AUs. This approach preserves the expressiveness of the AU framework while enabling explicit modeling of complex and conflicting AUs. It also unlocks the potential of modern text-to-image models for high-fidelity facial synthesis. Supporting this direction, we introduce BP4D-AUText, the first large-scale text-image paired dataset for complex facial behavior. It is synthesized by applying a rule-based Dynamic AU Text Processor to the BP4D and BP4D+ datasets. We further propose VQ-AUFace, a generative model that leverages facial structural priors to synthesize realistic and diverse facial behaviors from text. Extensive quantitative experiments and user studies demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods. It excels in generating facial expressions that are anatomically plausible, behaviorally rich, and perceptually convincing, particularly under challenging conditions involving conflicting AUs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于自然语言描述动作单元（AU）的面部行为合成新方法，解决了传统线性组合方法在处理冲突AU时产生解剖学上不合理伪影的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于动作单元（AU）的面部行为合成方法通常将AU编码为one-hot向量，将复合表情建模为单个AU的简单线性组合。这种线性方法在处理冲突AU（激活相同面部肌肉但作用相反）时会产生解剖学上不合理的伪影和不自然的运动叠加，限制了面部非语言交流的细微表达。
AI.method: 1. 提出使用AU的自然语言描述来表示面部行为，保留了AU框架的表达能力，同时能够显式建模复杂和冲突的AU；2. 引入BP4D-AUText数据集，这是首个用于复杂面部行为的大规模文本-图像配对数据集，通过对BP4D和BP4D+数据集应用基于规则的动态AU文本处理器合成；3. 提出VQ-AUFace生成模型，利用面部结构先验从文本合成真实多样的面部行为。
AI.result: 广泛的定量实验和用户研究表明，该方法显著优于现有方法，在生成解剖学上合理、行为丰富且感知上令人信服的面部表情方面表现出色，特别是在涉及冲突AU的挑战性条件下。
AI.conclusion: 通过将AU表示为自然语言描述，该方法不仅解决了冲突AU的问题，还释放了现代文本到图像模型用于高保真面部合成的潜力，为更精确、自然的面部行为合成开辟了新途径。

title: RADIUS: Ranking, Distribution, and Significance - A Comprehensive Alignment Suite for Survey Simulation
summary: Simulation of surveys using LLMs is emerging as a powerful application for generating human-like responses at scale. Prior work evaluates survey simulation using metrics borrowed from other domains, which are often ad hoc, fragmented, and non-standardized, leading to results that are difficult to compare. Moreover, existing metrics focus mainly on accuracy or distributional measures, overlooking the critical dimension of ranking alignment. In practice, a simulation can achieve high accuracy while still failing to capture the option most preferred by humans - a distinction that is critical in decision-making applications. We introduce RADIUS, a comprehensive two-dimensional alignment suite for survey simulation that captures: 1) RAnking alignment and 2) DIstribUtion alignment, each complemented by statistical Significance testing. RADIUS highlights the limitations of existing metrics, enables more meaningful evaluation of survey simulation, and provides an open-source implementation for reproducible and comparable assessment.

AI.tldr: RADIUS是一个用于调查模拟的全面评估套件，包含排名对齐和分布对齐两个维度，每个维度都配有统计显著性检验，解决了现有评估指标碎片化、非标准化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有调查模拟评估使用从其他领域借用的指标，这些指标通常是临时性的、碎片化的且非标准化的，导致结果难以比较。现有指标主要关注准确性或分布度量，忽略了关键的排名对齐维度。在实践中，模拟可能实现高准确性，但仍无法捕捉人类最偏好的选项，这在决策应用中至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了RADIUS评估套件，包含两个维度的对齐：1) 排名对齐(RAnking alignment)和2) 分布对齐(DIstribUtion alignment)，每个维度都配有统计显著性检验。提供了开源实现，确保评估的可重复性和可比性。
AI.result: RADIUS揭示了现有评估指标的局限性，能够更有效地评估调查模拟的质量，特别是捕捉人类偏好的排名对齐维度。
AI.conclusion: RADIUS提供了一个全面、标准化的评估框架，解决了调查模拟评估中的碎片化问题，特别强调了排名对齐在决策应用中的重要性，为可重复和可比较的评估提供了开源工具。

title: dTRPO: Trajectory Reduction in Policy Optimization of Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) introduce a new paradigm for language generation, which in turn presents new challenges for aligning them with human preferences. In this work, we aim to improve the policy optimization for dLLMs by reducing the cost of the trajectory probability calculation, thereby enabling scaled-up offline policy training. We prove that: (i) under reference policy regularization, the probability ratio of the newly unmasked tokens is an unbiased estimate of that of intermediate diffusion states, and (ii) the probability of the full trajectory can be effectively estimated with a single forward pass of a re-masked final state. By integrating these two trajectory reduction strategies into a policy optimization objective, we propose Trajectory Reduction Policy Optimization (dTRPO). We evaluate dTRPO on 7B dLLMs across instruction-following and reasoning benchmarks. Results show that it substantially improves the core performance of state-of-the-art dLLMs, achieving gains of up to 9.6% on STEM tasks, up to 4.3% on coding tasks, and up to 3.0% on instruction-following tasks. Moreover, dTRPO exhibits strong training efficiency due to its offline, single-forward nature, and achieves improved generation efficiency through high-quality outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了dTRPO方法，通过轨迹概率计算优化来提升扩散大语言模型的策略训练效率和性能
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型(dLLMs)为语言生成带来了新范式，但也带来了与人类偏好对齐的新挑战。现有方法在策略优化中轨迹概率计算成本高，限制了离线策略训练的规模化。
AI.method: 提出轨迹缩减策略优化(dTRPO)：1) 证明在参考策略正则化下，新解掩码token的概率比是中间扩散状态概率比的无偏估计；2) 通过重新掩码最终状态的单次前向传播有效估计完整轨迹概率。将这两种轨迹缩减策略整合到策略优化目标中。
AI.result: 在7B参数的dLLMs上进行评估，在指令跟随和推理基准测试中显著提升性能：STEM任务提升达9.6%，编码任务提升达4.3%，指令跟随任务提升达3.0%。同时展现出强大的训练效率和生成效率。
AI.conclusion: dTRPO通过降低轨迹概率计算成本，实现了扩散大语言模型的高效策略优化，显著提升了模型性能，为dLLMs的规模化离线训练提供了有效解决方案。

title: myMNIST: Benchmark of PETNN, KAN, and Classical Deep Learning Models for Burmese Handwritten Digit Recognition
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, Accepted to ICNLP 2026, Xi'an, China
summary: We present the first systematic benchmark on myMNIST (formerly BHDD), a publicly available Burmese handwritten digit dataset important for Myanmar NLP/AI research. We evaluate eleven architectures spanning classical deep learning models (Multi-Layer Perceptron, Convolutional Neural Network, Long Short-Term Memory, Gated Recurrent Unit, Transformer), recent alternatives (FastKAN, EfficientKAN), an energy-based model (JEM), and physics-inspired PETNN variants (Sigmoid, GELU, SiLU). Using Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and Accuracy as evaluation metrics, our results show that the CNN remains a strong baseline, achieving the best overall scores (F1 = 0.9959, Accuracy = 0.9970). The PETNN (GELU) model closely follows (F1 = 0.9955, Accuracy = 0.9966), outperforming LSTM, GRU, Transformer, and KAN variants. JEM, representing energy-based modeling, performs competitively (F1 = 0.9944, Accuracy = 0.9958). KAN-based models (FastKAN, EfficientKAN) trail the top performers but provide a meaningful alternative baseline (Accuracy ~0.992). These findings (i) establish reproducible baselines for myMNIST across diverse modeling paradigms, (ii) highlight PETNN's strong performance relative to classical and Transformer-based models, and (iii) quantify the gap between energy-inspired PETNNs and a true energy-based model (JEM). We release this benchmark to facilitate future research on Myanmar digit recognition and to encourage broader evaluation of emerging architectures on regional scripts.

AI.tldr: 该研究对缅甸手写数字数据集myMNIST进行了首个系统性基准测试，评估了11种不同架构，发现CNN表现最佳，PETNN(GELU)紧随其后，为缅甸数字识别研究建立了可复现的基准。
AI.motivation: 缅甸手写数字数据集myMNIST对缅甸NLP/AI研究很重要，但缺乏系统性基准测试。研究旨在为这个公开数据集建立可复现的基准，评估不同建模范式在缅甸数字识别任务上的表现。
AI.method: 评估了11种架构：经典深度学习模型（MLP、CNN、LSTM、GRU、Transformer）、近期替代方案（FastKAN、EfficientKAN）、能量基模型（JEM）和物理启发的PETNN变体（Sigmoid、GELU、SiLU）。使用精确率、召回率、F1分数和准确率作为评估指标。
AI.result: CNN表现最佳（F1=0.9959，准确率=0.9970），PETNN(GELU)紧随其后（F1=0.9955，准确率=0.9966），优于LSTM、GRU、Transformer和KAN变体。JEM表现有竞争力（F1=0.9944，准确率=0.9958）。KAN基模型准确率约0.992。
AI.conclusion: 研究为myMNIST建立了跨不同建模范式的可复现基准，展示了PETNN相对于经典和Transformer模型的强大性能，量化了物理启发PETNN与真实能量基模型（JEM）之间的差距。基准发布旨在促进缅甸数字识别研究，并鼓励对区域文字上新兴架构的更广泛评估。

title: Hypothesis-Conditioned Query Rewriting for Decision-Useful Retrieval
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding generation in external, non-parametric knowledge. However, when a task requires choosing among competing options, simply grounding generation in broadly relevant context is often insufficient to drive the final decision. Existing RAG methods typically rely on a single initial query, which often favors topical relevance over decision-relevant evidence, and therefore retrieves background information that can fail to discriminate among answer options. To address this issue, here we propose Hypothesis-Conditioned Query Rewriting (HCQR), a training-free pre-retrieval framework that reorients RAG from topic-oriented retrieval to evidence-oriented retrieval. HCQR first derives a lightweight working hypothesis from the input question and candidate options, and then rewrites retrieval into three targeted queries that seek evidence to: (1) support the hypothesis, (2) distinguish it from competing alternatives, and (3) verify salient clues in the question. This approach enables context retrieval that is more directly aligned with answer selection, allowing the generator to confirm or overturn the initial hypothesis based on the retrieved evidence. Experiments on MedQA and MMLU-Med show that HCQR consistently outperforms single-query RAG and re-rank/filter baselines, improving average accuracy over Simple RAG by 5.9 and 3.6 points, respectively. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HCQR-1C2E.

AI.tldr: HCQR提出假设条件查询重写框架，将RAG从主题导向检索转向证据导向检索，通过生成三个针对性查询来获取支持假设、区分备选方案和验证线索的证据，提升多选项决策任务的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法通常依赖单一初始查询，偏向主题相关性而非决策相关证据，导致检索的背景信息难以区分答案选项，在需要从竞争选项中选择的任务中表现不足。
AI.method: HCQR首先从输入问题和候选选项中推导轻量级工作假设，然后重写检索为三个针对性查询：(1)支持假设的证据，(2)区分假设与竞争替代方案的证据，(3)验证问题中关键线索的证据。
AI.result: 在MedQA和MMLU-Med数据集上的实验表明，HCQR持续优于单查询RAG和重排/过滤基线方法，平均准确率分别比Simple RAG提高了5.9和3.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: HCQR通过假设条件查询重写框架，将RAG从主题导向检索转向证据导向检索，显著提升了多选项决策任务的性能，为需要从竞争选项中选择的问答任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Can LLM generate interesting mathematical research problems?
summary: This paper is the second one in a series of work on the mathematical creativity of LLM. In the first paper, the authors proposed three criteria for evaluating the mathematical creativity of LLM and constructed a benchmark dataset to measure it. This paper further explores the mathematical creativity of LLM, with a focus on investigating whether LLM can generate valuable and cutting-edge mathematical research problems. We develop an agent to generate unknown problems and produced 665 research problems in differential geometry. Through human verification, we find that many of these mathematical problems are unknown to experts and possess unique research value.

AI.tldr: 该论文是LLM数学创造力系列研究的第二篇，重点探索LLM能否生成有价值的前沿数学研究问题，在微分几何领域生成了665个研究问题，经专家验证发现许多问题是未知且具有独特研究价值的。
AI.motivation: 在第一篇论文建立了LLM数学创造力评估标准和基准数据集的基础上，本文进一步探索LLM的数学创造力，特别是关注LLM能否生成有价值的前沿数学研究问题，这是衡量数学创造力的重要方面。
AI.method: 开发了一个智能体来生成未知的数学问题，在微分几何领域生成了665个研究问题，然后通过人类专家验证这些问题的原创性和研究价值。
AI.result: 生成的665个微分几何研究问题中，许多被专家验证为未知问题，并且具有独特的研究价值，这表明LLM确实能够生成有价值的前沿数学研究问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM在数学创造力方面表现出潜力，能够生成未知且具有研究价值的数学问题，这为数学研究提供了新的可能性，也验证了LLM在创造性数学思维方面的能力。

title: Complementary Text-Guided Attention for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness
comment: Accepted to TPAMI 2026. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2410.21802
summary: Due to the impressive zero-shot capabilities, pre-trained vision-language models (e.g., CLIP), have attracted widespread attention and adoption across various domains. Nonetheless, CLIP has been observed to be susceptible to adversarial examples. Through experimental analysis, we have observed a phenomenon wherein adversarial perturbations induce shifts in text-guided attention. Building upon this observation, we propose a simple yet effective strategy: Text-Guided Attention for Zero-Shot Robustness (TGA-ZSR). This framework incorporates two components: Local Attention Refinement Module and Global Attention Constraint Module. Our goal is to maintain the generalization of the CLIP model and enhance its adversarial robustness. Additionally, the Global Attention Constraint Module acquires text-guided attention from both the target and original models using clean examples. Its objective is to maintain model performance on clean samples while enhancing overall robustness. However, we observe that the method occasionally focuses on irrelevant or spurious features, which can lead to suboptimal performance and undermine its robustness in certain scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we further propose a novel approach called Complementary Text-Guided Attention (Comp-TGA). This method integrates two types of foreground attention: attention guided by the class prompt and reversed attention driven by the non-class prompt. These complementary attention mechanisms allow the model to capture a more comprehensive and accurate representation of the foreground. The experiments validate that TGA-ZSR and Comp-TGA yield 9.58% and 11.95% improvements respectively, in zero-shot robust accuracy over the current state-of-the-art techniques across 16 datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CLIP模型在零样本场景下的对抗鲁棒性问题，提出了两种基于文本引导注意力的方法：TGA-ZSR和Comp-TGA，分别通过注意力精炼与约束以及互补注意力机制来提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉语言模型（如CLIP）虽然具有强大的零样本能力，但被发现容易受到对抗样本的攻击。研究发现对抗扰动会导致文本引导注意力发生偏移，因此需要开发方法来保持CLIP的泛化能力同时增强其对抗鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出了两种方法：1) TGA-ZSR框架，包含局部注意力精炼模块和全局注意力约束模块；2) Comp-TGA方法，整合类别提示引导的前景注意力和非类别提示引导的反向注意力，形成互补注意力机制。
AI.result: 实验验证TGA-ZSR和Comp-TGA分别在16个数据集上比当前最先进技术提升了9.58%和11.95%的零样本鲁棒准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过文本引导注意力机制可以有效提升CLIP模型在零样本场景下的对抗鲁棒性，其中互补注意力机制能够更全面地捕捉前景特征，获得更好的性能提升。

title: What Really Controls Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models: Tokenisation or Representation of Time?
summary: We present MultiTempBench, a multilingual temporal reasoning benchmark spanning three tasks, date arithmetic, time zone conversion, and temporal relation extraction across five languages (English, German, Chinese, Arabic, and Hausa) and multiple calendar conventions (Gregorian, Hijri, and Chinese Lunar). MultiTempBench contains $15,000$ examples built by translating $750$ curated English questions and expanding each into controlled date-format variants. We evaluate 20 LLMs and introduce the multilingual Date Fragmentation Ratio (mDFR), calibrated with human severity ratings, together with geometric-probing analyses of internal temporal representations. We find tokenisation quality of temporal artefacts is a resource-dependent bottleneck: in low-resource languages and rarer calendar formats, fragmentation disrupts Year/Month/Day separation and accuracy collapses, while high-resource settings are often robust to digit-level splitting. Beyond tokenisation, crossed mixed-effects regression shows that temporal linearity is the strongest predictor of temporal reasoning in high-resource languages, whereas fragmentation is the stronger predictor in low-resource languages. Code is available at: https://github.com/gagan3012/mtb

AI.tldr: MultiTempBench是一个多语言时间推理基准，涵盖三个任务（日期运算、时区转换、时间关系提取），涉及5种语言和3种日历系统。研究发现分词质量是时间推理的关键瓶颈，特别是在低资源语言和稀有日历格式中。
AI.motivation: 现有时间推理基准主要关注英语，缺乏多语言和跨日历系统的评估。需要研究不同语言和日历系统中语言模型的时间推理能力，特别是分词对时间表示的影响。
AI.method: 构建包含15,000个示例的多语言时间推理基准MultiTempBench，涵盖5种语言和3种日历系统。评估20个LLM，引入多语言日期碎片化比率(mDFR)指标，并进行几何探测分析和交叉混合效应回归。
AI.result: 时间标记的分词质量是资源依赖的瓶颈：在低资源语言和稀有日历格式中，碎片化破坏年月日分离，导致准确性崩溃；而在高资源设置中，数字级分割通常具有鲁棒性。时间线性是高资源语言时间推理的最强预测因子，而碎片化是低资源语言的主要预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 多语言时间推理能力受语言资源和日历系统影响显著。分词质量是关键因素，特别是在低资源语言中。研究强调了改进多语言时间表示和分词策略的重要性。

title: ProRL Agent: Rollout-as-a-Service for RL Training of Multi-Turn LLM Agents
summary: Multi-turn LLM agents are increasingly important for solving complex, interactive tasks, and reinforcement learning (RL) is a key ingredient for improving their long-horizon behavior. However, RL training requires generating large numbers of sandboxed rollout trajectories, and existing infrastructures often couple rollout orchestration with the training loop, making systems hard to migrate and maintain. Under the rollout-as-a-service philosophy, we present ProRL Agent , a scalable infrastructure that serves the full agentic rollout lifecycle through an API service. ProRL Agent also provides standardized and extensible sandbox environments that support diverse agentic tasks in rootless HPC settings. We validate ProRL Agent through RL training on software engineering, math, STEM, and coding tasks. ProRL Agent is open-sourced and integrated as part of NVIDIA NeMo Gym.

AI.tldr: ProRL Agent是一个基于"rollout即服务"理念的可扩展基础设施，通过API服务提供完整的智能体rollout生命周期管理，支持在无根HPC环境中进行多样化的智能体任务训练。
AI.motivation: 多轮LLM智能体在解决复杂交互任务中越来越重要，强化学习是改进其长期行为的关键方法。然而，现有基础设施通常将rollout编排与训练循环耦合，导致系统难以迁移和维护，且RL训练需要生成大量沙盒化rollout轨迹。
AI.method: 提出ProRL Agent基础设施，采用rollout-as-a-service理念，通过API服务提供完整的智能体rollout生命周期管理。提供标准化且可扩展的沙盒环境，支持在无根HPC环境中进行多样化的智能体任务训练。
AI.result: 在软件工程、数学、STEM和编程任务上验证了ProRL Agent的RL训练效果。该系统已开源并集成到NVIDIA NeMo Gym中。
AI.conclusion: ProRL Agent提供了一个可扩展的基础设施解决方案，解决了现有RL训练系统中rollout编排与训练循环耦合的问题，支持多轮LLM智能体在复杂任务上的高效训练。

title: SJD-PAC: Accelerating Speculative Jacobi Decoding via Proactive Drafting and Adaptive Continuation
summary: Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) offers a draft-model-free approach to accelerate autoregressive text-to-image synthesis. However, the high-entropy nature of visual generation yields low draft-token acceptance rates in complex regions, creating a bottleneck that severely limits overall throughput. To overcome this, we introduce SJD-PAC, an enhanced SJD framework. First, SJD-PAC employs a proactive drafting strategy to improve local acceptance rates in these challenging high-entropy regions. Second, we introduce an adaptive continuation mechanism that sustains sequence validation after an initial rejection, bypassing the need for full resampling. Working in tandem, these optimizations significantly increase the average acceptance length per step, boosting inference speed while strictly preserving the target distribution. Experiments on standard text-to-image benchmarks demonstrate that SJD-PAC achieves a $3.8\times$ speedup with lossless image quality.

AI.tldr: SJD-PAC通过主动草稿策略和自适应延续机制，在保持无损图像质量的同时，将文本到图像合成的推理速度提升3.8倍
AI.motivation: 现有的Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD)方法在视觉生成的高熵区域存在草稿token接受率低的问题，这严重限制了整体吞吐量，需要改进
AI.method: 提出SJD-PAC框架：1) 采用主动草稿策略提高高熵区域的本地接受率；2) 引入自适应延续机制，在初始拒绝后维持序列验证，避免完全重采样
AI.result: 在标准文本到图像基准测试中，SJD-PAC实现了3.8倍的加速，同时保持无损的图像质量
AI.conclusion: SJD-PAC通过协同优化显著提高了每步的平均接受长度，在保持目标分布严格不变的前提下大幅提升了推理速度

title: MoRI: Learning Motivation-Grounded Reasoning for Scientific Ideation in Large Language Models
summary: Scientific ideation aims to propose novel solutions within a given scientific context. Existing LLM-based agentic approaches emulate human research workflows, yet inadequately model scientific reasoning, resulting in surface-level conceptual recombinations that lack technical depth and scientific grounding. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MoRI} (\textbf{Mo}tivation-grounded \textbf{R}easoning for Scientific \textbf{I}deation), a framework that enables LLMs to explicitly learn the reasoning process from research motivations to methodologies. The base LLM is initialized via supervised fine-tuning to generate a research motivation from a given context, and is subsequently trained under a composite reinforcement learning reward that approximates scientific rigor: (1) entropy-aware information gain encourages the model to uncover and elaborate high-complexity technical details grounded in ground-truth methodologies, and (2) contrastive semantic gain constrains the reasoning trajectory to maintain conceptually aligned with scientifically valid solutions. Empirical results show that MoRI significantly outperforms strong commercial LLMs and complex agentic baselines across multiple dimensions, including novelty, technical rigor, and feasibility. The code will be made available on \href{https://github.com/ECNU-Text-Computing/IdeaGeneration}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: MoRI框架通过动机驱动的推理过程提升科学创意生成，结合监督微调和强化学习奖励机制，显著优于现有LLM和智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体方法模拟人类研究流程，但未能充分建模科学推理过程，导致生成的概念重组停留在表面层次，缺乏技术深度和科学基础。
AI.method: 提出MoRI框架，通过监督微调让基础LLM从给定研究背景生成研究动机，然后使用复合强化学习奖励机制：1）熵感知信息增益鼓励模型揭示和阐述基于真实方法的高复杂度技术细节；2）对比语义增益约束推理轨迹以保持与科学有效解决方案的概念一致性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MoRI在多个维度上显著优于强大的商业LLM和复杂智能体基线，包括新颖性、技术严谨性和可行性。
AI.conclusion: MoRI框架通过显式学习从研究动机到方法的推理过程，有效提升了科学创意生成的质量，解决了现有方法缺乏技术深度和科学基础的问题。

title: RewardFlow: Topology-Aware Reward Propagation on State Graphs for Agentic RL with Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) holds significant promise for enhancing the agentic reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) with external environments. However, the inherent sparsity of terminal rewards hinders fine-grained, state-level optimization. Although process reward modeling offers a promising alternative, training dedicated reward models often entails substantial computational costs and scaling difficulties. To address these challenges, we introduce RewardFlow, a lightweight method for estimating state-level rewards tailored to agentic reasoning tasks. RewardFlow leverages the intrinsic topological structure of states within reasoning trajectories by constructing state graphs. This enables an analysis of state-wise contributions to success, followed by topology-aware graph propagation to quantify contributions and yield objective, state-level rewards. When integrated as dense rewards for RL optimization, RewardFlow substantially outperforms prior RL baselines across four agentic reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance, robustness, and training efficiency. The implementation of RewardFlow is publicly available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/RewardFlow.

AI.tldr: RewardFlow是一种轻量级方法，通过构建状态图分析推理轨迹中的状态贡献，为智能体推理任务提供密集的状态级奖励，显著提升强化学习性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习能增强大语言模型在外部环境中的智能推理能力，但终端奖励的稀疏性阻碍了细粒度状态级优化。虽然过程奖励建模是替代方案，但训练专用奖励模型计算成本高且难以扩展。
AI.method: RewardFlow利用推理轨迹中状态的内在拓扑结构构建状态图，分析状态对成功的贡献，然后通过拓扑感知的图传播量化贡献，生成客观的状态级奖励。
AI.result: RewardFlow作为密集奖励集成到RL优化中，在四个智能体推理基准测试中显著优于先前的RL基线方法，表现出更优的性能、鲁棒性和训练效率。
AI.conclusion: RewardFlow提供了一种轻量级、高效的方法来解决智能体推理任务中的奖励稀疏性问题，通过拓扑感知的状态贡献分析实现了更好的强化学习优化。

title: Improving Joint Audio-Video Generation with Cross-Modal Context Learning
summary: The dual-stream transformer architecture-based joint audio-video generation method has become the dominant paradigm in current research. By incorporating pre-trained video diffusion models and audio diffusion models, along with a cross-modal interaction attention module, high-quality, temporally synchronized audio-video content can be generated with minimal training data. In this paper, we first revisit the dual-stream transformer paradigm and further analyze its limitations, including model manifold variations caused by the gating mechanism controlling cross-modal interactions, biases in multi-modal background regions introduced by cross-modal attention, and the inconsistencies in multi-modal classifier-free guidance (CFG) during training and inference, as well as conflicts between multiple conditions. To alleviate these issues, we propose Cross-Modal Context Learning (CCL), equipped with several carefully designed modules. Temporally Aligned RoPE and Partitioning (TARP) effectively enhances the temporal alignment between audio latent and video latent representations. The Learnable Context Tokens (LCT) and Dynamic Context Routing (DCR) in the Cross-Modal Context Attention (CCA) module provide stable unconditional anchors for cross-modal information, while dynamically routing based on different training tasks, further enhancing the model's convergence speed and generation quality. During inference, Unconditional Context Guidance (UCG) leverages the unconditional support provided by LCT to facilitate different forms of CFG, improving train-inference consistency and further alleviating conflicts.
