Through comprehensive evaluations, CCL achieves state-of-the-art performance compared with recent academic methods while requiring substantially fewer resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cross-Modal Context Learning (CCL)方法，通过多个精心设计的模块解决双流transformer在音视频联合生成中的局限性，包括时间对齐、跨模态注意力偏差和多模态CFG不一致等问题，以更少资源实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前基于双流transformer的音视频联合生成方法存在多个局限性：门控机制导致的模型流形变化、跨模态注意力引入的多模态背景区域偏差、训练推理中多模态无分类器引导(CFG)的不一致性，以及多条件之间的冲突。这些限制了生成质量和效率。
AI.method: 提出Cross-Modal Context Learning (CCL)框架，包含：1) TARP模块增强音频和视频潜在表示的时间对齐；2) CCA模块中的LCT提供稳定的无条件锚点，DCR根据训练任务动态路由；3) UCG在推理时利用LCT的无条件支持促进不同形式的CFG，提高训练推理一致性。
AI.result: CCL在全面评估中相比近期学术方法实现了最先进的性能，同时需要显著更少的资源。具体在生成质量、时间同步性和训练效率方面都有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: CCL通过解决双流transformer架构在音视频联合生成中的关键局限性，提供了一种高效且高质量的解决方案。该方法不仅提升了生成性能，还通过精心设计的模块改善了训练稳定性和推理一致性，为多模态生成任务提供了新的思路。

title: Parallelograms Strike Back: LLMs Generate Better Analogies than People
summary: Four-term word analogies (A:B::C:D) are classically modeled geometrically as ''parallelograms,'' yet recent work suggests this model poorly captures how humans produce analogies, with simple local-similarity heuristics often providing a better account (Peterson et al., 2020). But does the parallelogram model fail because it is a bad model of analogical relations, or because people are not very good at generating relation-preserving analogies? We compared human and large language model (LLM) analogy completions on the same set of analogy problems from (Peterson et al., 2020). We find that LLM-generated analogies are reliably judged as better than human-generated ones, and are also more closely aligned with the parallelogram structure in a distributional embedding space (GloVe). Crucially, we show that the improvement over human analogies was driven by greater parallelogram alignment and reduced reliance on accessible words rather than enhanced sensitivity to local similarity. Moreover, the LLM advantage is driven not by uniformly superior responses by LLMs, but by humans producing a long tail of weak completions: when only modal (most frequent) responses by both systems are compared, the LLM advantage disappears. However, greater parallelogram alignment and lower word frequency continue to predict which LLM completions are rated higher than those of humans. Overall, these results suggest that the parallelogram model is not a poor account of word analogy. Rather, humans may often fail to produce completions that satisfy this relational constraint, whereas LLMs do so more consistently.

AI.tldr: 研究表明平行四边形模型并非词类比关系的不良模型，而是人类在生成满足关系约束的类比时存在困难，而大语言模型在这方面表现更一致。
AI.motivation: 传统上四词类比（A:B::C:D）被建模为几何"平行四边形"，但近期研究发现该模型对人类类比生成行为的解释力较差，而简单的局部相似性启发式方法反而更好。研究者想探究平行四边形模型失败的原因：究竟是模型本身对类比关系的描述不佳，还是人类不擅长生成保持关系的类比？
AI.method: 比较人类和大语言模型在相同类比问题集上的完成情况，使用Peterson等人（2020）的数据集。评估LLM生成的类比是否优于人类生成的类比，并分析它们在分布嵌入空间（GloVe）中与平行四边形结构的对齐程度。
AI.result: LLM生成的类比被可靠地评为优于人类生成的类比，且在分布嵌入空间中更符合平行四边形结构。LLM的优势源于更高的平行四边形对齐度和更少依赖高频词，而非增强的局部相似性敏感性。LLM优势主要源于人类产生了大量弱完成：当仅比较两者最常见的回答时，LLM优势消失。然而，更高的平行四边形对齐度和更低的词频仍能预测哪些LLM完成评分高于人类完成。
AI.conclusion: 平行四边形模型并非词类比关系的不良模型。问题在于人类经常无法生成满足关系约束的完成，而LLM在这方面表现更一致。研究结果支持平行四边形模型作为类比关系的有效描述，挑战了先前认为该模型对人类类比行为解释力不足的观点。

title: Conflict-Based Search for Multi Agent Path Finding with Asynchronous Actions
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their respective start locations to their respective goal locations while minimizing path costs. Most existing MAPF algorithms rely on a common assumption of synchronized actions, where the actions of all agents start at the same time and always take a time unit, which may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. To get rid of this assumption, Continuous-time Conflict-Based Search (CCBS) is a popular approach that can find optimal solutions for MAPF with asynchronous actions (MAPF-AA). However, CCBS has recently been identified to be incomplete due to an uncountably infinite state space created by continuous wait durations. This paper proposes a new method, Conflict-Based Search with Asynchronous Actions (CBS-AA), which bypasses this theoretical issue and can solve MAPF-AA with completeness and solution optimality guarantees. Based on CBS-AA, we also develop conflict resolution techniques to improve the scalability of CBS-AA further. Our test results show that our method can reduce the number of branches by up to 90%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CBS-AA方法解决异步动作的多智能体路径规划问题，克服了CCBS的不完备性，保证最优解，并通过冲突解析技术将分支数减少90%。
AI.motivation: 现有MAPF算法大多基于同步动作假设，限制了实际应用。CCBS虽然能处理异步动作但被证明不完备，需要新的方法来解决异步动作MAPF问题。
AI.method: 提出CBS-AA方法，基于冲突搜索框架处理异步动作，避免连续等待时间导致的无限状态空间问题，并开发冲突解析技术提升可扩展性。
AI.result: CBS-AA能保证完备性和最优性，测试结果显示冲突解析技术可将分支数减少高达90%，显著提升算法效率。
AI.conclusion: CBS-AA成功解决了异步动作MAPF问题，克服了CCBS的理论缺陷，在保证最优解的同时大幅提升了算法性能。

title: OpenT2M: No-frill Motion Generation with Open-source,Large-scale, High-quality Data
summary: Text-to-motion (T2M) generation aims to create realistic human movements from text descriptions, with promising applications in animation and robotics. Despite recent progress, current T2M models perform poorly on unseen text descriptions due to the small scale and limited diversity of existing motion datasets. To address this problem, we introduce OpenT2M, a million-level, high-quality, and open-source motion dataset containing over 2800 hours of human motion. Each sequence undergoes rigorous quality control through physical feasibility validation and multi-granularity filtering, with detailed second-wise text annotations. We also develop an automated pipeline for creating long-horizon sequences, enabling complex motion generation. Building upon OpenT2M, we introduce MonoFrill, a pretrained motion model that achieves compelling T2M results without complicated designs or technique tricks as "frills". Its core component is 2D-PRQ, a novel motion tokenizer that captures spatiotemporal dependencies by dividing the human body into biology parts. Experiments show that OpenT2M significantly improves generalization of existing T2M models, while 2D-PRQ achieves superior reconstruction and strong zero-shot performance. We expect OpenT2M and MonoFrill will advance the T2M field by addressing longstanding data quality and benchmarking challenges.

AI.tldr: OpenT2M是一个包含2800小时高质量人体运动数据的大规模开源数据集，通过物理可行性验证和多粒度过滤确保质量，并配有详细的逐秒文本标注。基于此数据集开发的MonoFrill模型采用新颖的2D-PRQ运动分词器，无需复杂设计就能实现优秀的文本到运动生成效果。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到运动生成模型在未见过的文本描述上表现不佳，主要原因是现有运动数据集规模小、多样性有限。为了解决数据质量和基准测试的长期挑战，需要构建大规模高质量的运动数据集。
AI.method: 1) 构建OpenT2M数据集：包含2800小时人体运动数据，通过物理可行性验证和多粒度过滤进行质量控制，提供详细的逐秒文本标注；2) 开发自动化流程创建长时程序列；3) 提出MonoFrill模型：核心是2D-PRQ运动分词器，通过将人体划分为生物部位来捕捉时空依赖关系。
AI.result: OpenT2M显著提升了现有T2M模型的泛化能力，2D-PRQ在重建任务上表现优异并具有强大的零样本性能。实验表明该数据集和模型能够有效解决数据质量和基准测试问题。
AI.conclusion: OpenT2M和MonoFrill通过提供大规模高质量数据集和简单有效的模型架构，有望推动文本到运动生成领域的发展，解决长期存在的数据质量和基准测试挑战。

title: DaPT: A Dual-Path Framework for Multilingual Multi-hop Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have made significant progress in solving complex multi-hop question answering (QA) tasks in the English scenario. However, RAG systems inevitably face the application scenario of retrieving across multilingual corpora and queries, leaving several open challenges. The first one involves the absence of benchmarks that assess RAG systems' capabilities under the multilingual multi-hop (MM-hop) QA setting. The second centers on the overreliance on LLMs' strong semantic understanding in English, which diminishes effectiveness in multilingual scenarios. To address these challenges, we first construct multilingual multi-hop QA benchmarks by translating English-only benchmarks into five languages, and then we propose DaPT, a novel multilingual RAG framework. DaPT generates sub-question graphs in parallel for both the source-language query and its English translation counterpart, then merges them before employing a bilingual retrieval-and-answer strategy to sequentially solve sub-questions. Our experimental results demonstrate that advanced RAG systems suffer from a significant performance imbalance in multilingual scenarios. Furthermore, our proposed method consistently yields more accurate and concise answers compared to the baselines, significantly enhancing RAG performance on this task. For instance, on the most challenging MuSiQue benchmark, DaPT achieves a relative improvement of 18.3\% in average EM score over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出DaPT框架解决多语言多跳问答问题，通过并行生成子问题图并合并，实现双语检索与回答，显著提升多语言RAG性能
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统在英语场景表现良好，但在多语言跨语料检索场景面临挑战：缺乏多语言多跳问答基准测试，以及过度依赖英语语义理解导致多语言场景效果下降
AI.method: 首先构建多语言多跳问答基准（将英语基准翻译为5种语言），然后提出DaPT框架：为源语言查询及其英语翻译并行生成子问题图，合并后采用双语检索与回答策略顺序解决子问题
AI.result: 实验表明先进RAG系统在多语言场景存在显著性能不平衡，DaPT方法相比基线能产生更准确简洁的答案，在最具挑战性的MuSiQue基准上，平均EM得分相对最强基线提升18.3%
AI.conclusion: DaPT框架有效解决了多语言多跳问答中的挑战，显著提升了RAG系统在多语言场景下的性能，为跨语言信息检索与问答提供了新思路

title: Geography According to ChatGPT -- How Generative AI Represents and Reasons about Geography
summary: Understanding how AI will represent and reason about geography should be a key concern for all of us, as the broader public increasingly interacts with spaces and places through these systems. Similarly, in line with the nature of foundation models, our own research often relies on pre-trained models. Hence, understanding what world AI systems construct is as important as evaluating their accuracy, including factual recall. To motivate the need for such studies, we provide three illustrative vignettes, i.e., exploratory probes, in the hope that they will spark lively discussions and follow-up work: (1) Do models form strong defaults, and how brittle are model outputs to minute syntactic variations? (2) Can distributional shifts resurface from the composition of individually benign tasks, e.g., when using AI systems to create personas? (3) Do we overlook deeper questions of understanding when solely focusing on the ability of systems to recall facts such as geographic principles?

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨AI系统如何表示和推理地理知识，强调理解AI构建的世界观与评估其准确性同等重要，并通过三个案例研究说明需要关注AI地理认知的深层问题。
AI.motivation: 随着公众越来越多地通过AI系统与空间和地点互动，理解AI如何表示和推理地理知识至关重要。同时，研究本身也依赖预训练模型，因此理解AI构建的世界观与评估其事实准确性同等重要。
AI.method: 通过三个探索性案例研究（vignettes）来激发讨论和后续研究：1）模型是否形成强烈默认值，以及模型输出对微小语法变化的脆弱性；2）分布偏移是否可能从单个良性任务的组合中重新出现；3）当仅关注系统回忆地理事实的能力时，是否忽视了更深层的理解问题。
AI.result: 论文未提供具体实验结果，而是提出了三个需要进一步研究的核心问题，旨在激发关于AI地理认知的讨论和后续工作。
AI.conclusion: 需要系统性地研究AI如何表示和推理地理知识，这不仅是准确性问题，更涉及AI构建的世界观及其对公众认知的影响。三个案例研究指出了当前研究可能忽视的重要方向。

title: GenVideoLens: Where LVLMs Fall Short in AI-Generated Video Detection?
comment: ECCV 2026 submission. 14 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material included
summary: In recent years, AI-generated videos have become increasingly realistic and sophisticated. Meanwhile, Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for detecting such content. However, existing evaluation protocols largely treat the task as a binary classification problem and rely on coarse-grained metrics such as overall accuracy, providing limited insight into where LVLMs succeed or fail. To address this limitation, we introduce GenVideoLens, a fine-grained benchmark that enables dimension-wise evaluation of LVLM capabilities in AI-generated video detection. The benchmark contains 400 highly deceptive AI-generated videos and 100 real videos, annotated by experts across 15 authenticity dimensions covering perceptual, optical, physical, and temporal cues. We evaluate eleven representative LVLMs on this benchmark. Our analysis reveals a pronounced dimensional imbalance. While LVLMs perform relatively well on perceptual cues, they struggle with optical consistency, physical interactions, and temporal-causal reasoning. Model performance also varies substantially across dimensions, with smaller open-source models sometimes outperforming stronger proprietary models on specific authenticity cues. Temporal perturbation experiments further show that current LVLMs make limited use of temporal information. Overall, GenVideoLens provides diagnostic insights into LVLM behavior, revealing key capability gaps and offering guidance for improving future AI-generated video detection systems.

AI.tldr: GenVideoLens是一个细粒度基准测试，用于评估大视觉语言模型在AI生成视频检测中的能力，发现模型在感知线索上表现较好，但在光学一致性、物理交互和时序因果推理方面存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI生成视频检测评估方法大多将其视为二元分类问题，依赖整体准确率等粗粒度指标，无法深入了解大视觉语言模型在哪些方面成功或失败。需要更细粒度的评估方法来诊断模型的能力差距。
AI.method: 提出了GenVideoLens基准测试，包含400个高度欺骗性的AI生成视频和100个真实视频，由专家在15个真实性维度上进行标注，涵盖感知、光学、物理和时序线索。评估了11个代表性的大视觉语言模型，并进行时序扰动实验。
AI.result: 分析显示存在明显的维度不平衡：模型在感知线索上表现相对较好，但在光学一致性、物理交互和时序因果推理方面表现不佳。不同维度间性能差异显著，较小的开源模型有时在特定真实性线索上优于更强的专有模型。时序扰动实验表明当前模型对时序信息的利用有限。
AI.conclusion: GenVideoLens为大视觉语言模型的行为提供了诊断性洞察，揭示了关键能力差距，为改进未来的AI生成视频检测系统提供了指导。该基准测试有助于更全面地评估模型在细粒度维度上的表现。

title: UGID: Unified Graph Isomorphism for Debiasing Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit pronounced social biases. Output-level or data-optimization--based debiasing methods cannot fully resolve these biases, and many prior works have shown that biases are embedded in internal representations. We propose \underline{U}nified \underline{G}raph \underline{I}somorphism for \underline{D}ebiasing large language models (\textit{\textbf{UGID}}), an internal-representation--level debiasing framework for large language models that models the Transformer as a structured computational graph, where attention mechanisms define the routing edges of the graph and hidden states define the graph nodes. Specifically, debiasing is formulated as enforcing invariance of the graph structure across counterfactual inputs, with differences allowed only on sensitive attributes. \textit{\textbf{UGID}} jointly constrains attention routing and hidden representations in bias-sensitive regions, effectively preventing bias migration across architectural components. To achieve effective behavioral alignment without degrading general capabilities, we introduce a log-space constraint on sensitive logits and a selective anchor-based objective to preserve definitional semantics. Extensive experiments on large language models demonstrate that \textit{\textbf{UGID}} effectively reduces bias under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, significantly reduces internal structural discrepancies, and preserves model safety and utility.

AI.tldr: UGID提出了一种基于图同构的大语言模型内部表示层面去偏框架，通过建模Transformer为计算图，在反事实输入上强制图结构不变性，有效减少社会偏见同时保持模型能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型存在明显的社会偏见，基于输出层面或数据优化的去偏方法无法完全解决这些问题，许多研究表明偏见嵌入在内部表示中，需要从内部表示层面进行去偏。
AI.method: UGID将Transformer建模为结构化计算图（注意力机制定义路由边，隐藏状态定义节点），将去偏问题表述为在反事实输入上强制图结构不变性（仅允许敏感属性差异）。该方法联合约束注意力路由和隐藏表示，引入对数空间敏感logits约束和选择性锚点目标来保持定义语义。
AI.result: 在大语言模型上的广泛实验表明，UGID有效减少了分布内和分布外设置下的偏见，显著降低了内部结构差异，同时保持了模型的安全性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: UGID提供了一个有效的内部表示层面去偏框架，通过图同构方法解决大语言模型中的社会偏见问题，在减少偏见的同时保持了模型的通用能力。

title: Reasoning over mathematical objects: on-policy reward modeling and test time aggregation
summary: The ability to precisely derive mathematical objects is a core requirement for downstream STEM applications, including mathematics, physics, and chemistry, where reasoning must culminate in formally structured expressions. Yet, current LM evaluations of mathematical and scientific reasoning rely heavily on simplified answer formats such as numerical values or multiple choice options due to the convenience of automated assessment. In this paper we provide three contributions for improving reasoning over mathematical objects: (i) we build and release training data and benchmarks for deriving mathematical objects, the Principia suite; (ii) we provide training recipes with strong LLM-judges and verifiers, where we show that on-policy judge training boosts performance; (iii) we show how on-policy training can also be used to scale test-time compute via aggregation. We find that strong LMs such as Qwen3-235B and o3 struggle on Principia, while our training recipes can bring significant improvements over different LLM backbones, while simultaneously improving results on existing numerical and MCQA tasks, demonstrating cross-format generalization of reasoning abilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Principia套件，用于改进语言模型在数学对象推导方面的推理能力，包括训练数据、基准测试和训练方法，显著提升了模型性能并展示了跨格式的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型在数学和科学推理评估中过度依赖简化的答案格式（如数值或多选题），而STEM应用需要精确推导形式化数学对象的能力，这促使研究者开发更全面的评估和训练方法。
AI.method: 构建Principia训练数据和基准测试套件；开发包含强LLM-judges和验证器的训练方法，采用on-policy judge训练；利用on-policy训练通过聚合扩展测试时计算。
AI.result: Qwen3-235B和o3等强语言模型在Principia上表现不佳，但提出的训练方法能显著提升不同LLM骨干的性能，同时改进现有数值和MCQA任务的结果，展示了推理能力的跨格式泛化。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的Principia套件和训练方法有效提升了语言模型在数学对象推导方面的能力，证明了on-policy训练和强验证机制的重要性，为STEM领域的语言模型应用提供了重要工具。

title: GEAR: Geography-knowledge Enhanced Analog Recognition Framework in Extreme Environments
summary: The Mariana Trench and the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau exhibit significant similarities in geological origins and microbial metabolic functions. Given that deep-sea biological sampling faces prohibitive costs, recognizing structurally homologous terrestrial analogs of the Mariana Trench on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is of great significance. Yet, no existing model adequately addresses cross-domain topographic similarity retrieval, either neglecting geographical knowledge or sacrificing computational efficiency. To address these challenges, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}eography-knowledge \underline{\textbf{E}}nhanced \underline{\textbf{A}}nalog \underline{\textbf{R}}ecognition (\textbf{GEAR}) Framework, a three-stage pipeline designed to efficiently retrieve analogs from 2.5 million square kilometers of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau: (1) Skeleton guided Screening and Clipping: Recognition of candidate valleys and initial screening based on size and linear morphological criteria. (2) Physics aware Filtering: The Topographic Waveform Comparator (TWC) and Morphological Texture Module (MTM) evaluate the waveform and texture and filter out inconsistent candidate valleys. (3) Graph based Fine Recognition: We design a \underline{\textbf{M}}orphology-integrated \underline{\textbf{S}}iamese \underline{\textbf{G}}raph \underline{\textbf{N}}etwork (\textbf{MSG-Net}) based on geomorphological metrics. Correspondingly, we release an expert-annotated topographic similarity dataset targeting tectonic collision zones. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of every stage. Besides, MSG-Net achieved an F1-Score 1.38 percentage points higher than the SOTA baseline. Using features extracted by MSG-Net, we discovered a significant correlation with biological data, providing evidence for future biological analysis.

AI.tldr: GEAR框架是一个三阶段的地理知识增强类比识别系统，用于从青藏高原250万平方公里区域中高效检索与马里亚纳海沟结构同源的陆地类比地形。
AI.motivation: 由于深海生物采样成本极高，识别青藏高原上与马里亚纳海沟结构同源的陆地类比地形具有重要意义。现有模型要么忽略地理知识，要么牺牲计算效率，无法充分解决跨域地形相似性检索问题。
AI.method: GEAR框架包含三个阶段：1) 骨架引导的筛选与裁剪：基于大小和线性形态标准识别候选谷地；2) 物理感知过滤：使用地形波形比较器(TWC)和形态纹理模块(MTM)评估波形和纹理；3) 基于图的精细识别：设计基于地貌指标的形态集成孪生图网络(MSG-Net)。
AI.result: 实验证明了每个阶段的有效性。MSG-Net的F1分数比SOTA基线高出1.38个百分点。使用MSG-Net提取的特征与生物数据存在显著相关性，为未来生物分析提供了证据。
AI.conclusion: GEAR框架成功解决了跨域地形相似性检索问题，通过地理知识增强和高效计算流程，在青藏高原上识别出与马里亚纳海沟结构同源的陆地类比地形，为低成本生物采样提供了重要工具。

title: Optimal Splitting of Language Models from Mixtures to Specialized Domains
summary: Language models achieve impressive performance on a variety of knowledge, language, and reasoning tasks due to the scale and diversity of pretraining data available. The standard training recipe is a two-stage paradigm: pretraining first on the full corpus of data followed by specialization on a subset of high quality, specialized data from the full corpus. In the multi-domain setting, this involves continued pretraining of multiple models on each specialized domain, referred to as split model training. We propose a method for pretraining multiple models independently over a general pretraining corpus, and determining the optimal compute allocation between pretraining and continued pretraining using scaling laws. Our approach accurately predicts the loss of a model of size N with D pretraining and D' specialization tokens, and extrapolates to larger model sizes and number of tokens. Applied to language model training, our approach improves performance consistently across common sense knowledge and reasoning benchmarks across different model sizes and compute budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于缩放定律的多领域语言模型预训练方法，通过优化计算资源分配来提升模型性能
AI.motivation: 传统两阶段训练范式（先全数据预训练后高质量数据微调）在多领域场景下需要为每个领域单独训练模型，计算效率低。需要一种能优化计算资源分配的方法来提升多领域模型的性能。
AI.method: 提出一种方法：在通用预训练语料上独立预训练多个模型，使用缩放定律确定预训练和持续预训练之间的最优计算分配。该方法能准确预测模型在D个预训练token和D'个专业化token下的损失，并可外推到更大模型规模和token数量。
AI.result: 应用于语言模型训练时，该方法在不同模型规模和计算预算下，在常识知识和推理基准测试中持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于缩放定律的计算分配优化方法能有效提升多领域语言模型的训练效率和性能表现。

title: Quantitative Introspection in Language Models: Tracking Internal States Across Conversation
summary: Tracking the internal states of large language models across conversations is important for safety, interpretability, and model welfare, yet current methods are limited. Linear probes and other white-box methods compress high-dimensional representations imperfectly and are harder to apply with increasing model size. Taking inspiration from human psychology, where numeric self-report is a widely used tool for tracking internal states, we ask whether LLMs' own numeric self-reports can track probe-defined emotive states over time. We study four concept pairs (wellbeing, interest, focus, and impulsivity) in 40 ten-turn conversations, operationalizing introspection as the causal informational coupling between a model's self-report and a concept-matched probe-defined internal state. We find that greedy-decoded self-reports collapse outputs to few uninformative values, but introspective capacity can be unmasked by calculating logit-based self-reports. This metric tracks interpretable internal states (Spearman $ρ= 0.40$-$0.76$; isotonic $R^2 = 0.12$-$0.54$ in LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct), follows how those states change over time, and activation steering confirms the coupling is causal. Furthermore, we find that introspection is present at turn 1 but evolves through conversation, and can be selectively improved by steering along one concept to boost introspection for another ($ΔR^2$ up to $0.30$). Crucially, these phenomena scale with model size in some cases, approaching $R^2 \approx 0.93$ in LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, and partially replicate in other model families. Together, these results position numeric self-report as a viable, complementary tool for tracking internal emotive states in conversational AI systems.

AI.tldr: LLM的数值自我报告可以追踪其内部情感状态，通过logit-based方法可以揭示模型的反思能力，这种能力随对话进展而变化，且可通过激活引导增强。
AI.motivation: 追踪大型语言模型在对话中的内部状态对安全性、可解释性和模型福利很重要，但现有方法（如线性探针）在高维表示压缩上不完美，且难以应用于越来越大的模型。
AI.method: 受心理学中数值自我报告的启发，研究LLM的数值自我报告是否能追踪探针定义的情感状态。研究四个概念对（幸福感、兴趣、专注度、冲动性），在40个十轮对话中操作化反思能力，定义为模型自我报告与概念匹配探针定义内部状态之间的因果信息耦合。
AI.result: 贪婪解码的自我报告输出会坍缩到少数无信息值，但通过计算基于logit的自我报告可以揭示反思能力。该指标能追踪可解释的内部状态（Spearman ρ=0.40-0.76；等渗R²=0.12-0.54），跟随这些状态随时间变化，激活引导确认耦合是因果性的。反思能力在第一轮就存在但随对话演变，可通过沿一个概念引导来选择性提升另一个概念的反思能力（ΔR²最高达0.30）。这些现象在某些情况下随模型规模扩展，在LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct中R²≈0.93。
AI.conclusion: 数值自我报告是追踪对话AI系统中内部情感状态的可行补充工具，为模型内部状态监控提供了新方法。

title: SwiftGS: Episodic Priors for Immediate Satellite Surface Recovery
summary: Rapid, large-scale 3D reconstruction from multi-date satellite imagery is vital for environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster response, yet remains difficult due to illumination changes, sensor heterogeneity, and the cost of per-scene optimization. We introduce SwiftGS, a meta-learned system that reconstructs 3D surfaces in a single forward pass by predicting geometry-radiation-decoupled Gaussian primitives together with a lightweight SDF, replacing expensive per-scene fitting with episodic training that captures transferable priors. The model couples a differentiable physics graph for projection, illumination, and sensor response with spatial gating that blends sparse Gaussian detail and global SDF structure, and incorporates semantic-geometric fusion, conditional lightweight task heads, and multi-view supervision from a frozen geometric teacher under an uncertainty-aware multi-task loss. At inference, SwiftGS operates zero-shot with optional compact calibration and achieves accurate DSM reconstruction and view-consistent rendering at significantly reduced computational cost, with ablations highlighting the benefits of the hybrid representation, physics-aware rendering, and episodic meta-training.

AI.tldr: SwiftGS是一个元学习系统，通过单次前向传播实现大规模3D重建，使用几何-辐射解耦的高斯基元与轻量SDF混合表示，替代昂贵的逐场景优化，显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 多日期卫星图像的大规模3D重建在环境监测、城市规划、灾害响应中至关重要，但由于光照变化、传感器异质性以及逐场景优化的高成本，该任务仍然困难。
AI.method: 提出元学习系统SwiftGS，使用几何-辐射解耦的高斯基元与轻量SDF混合表示；结合可微分物理图（投影、光照、传感器响应）和空间门控机制；包含语义-几何融合、条件轻量任务头、冻结几何教师的多视角监督以及不确定性感知多任务损失。
AI.result: SwiftGS在推理时实现零样本操作，支持可选紧凑校准，能够准确重建数字表面模型（DSM）并保持视角一致的渲染，同时显著降低计算成本。消融实验验证了混合表示、物理感知渲染和元训练的优势。
AI.conclusion: SwiftGS通过元学习和混合表示方法，解决了卫星图像3D重建中的光照变化、传感器异质性和计算成本问题，为大规模环境监测提供了高效解决方案。

title: VEPO: Variable Entropy Policy Optimization for Low-Resource Language Foundation Models
comment: 23 pages. Includes figures and tables. Conference submission
summary: Large language models frequently exhibit suboptimal performance on low resource languages, primarily due to inefficient subword segmentation and systemic training data imbalances. In this paper, we propose Variable Entropy Policy Optimization (VEPO), which leverages Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards to incorporate deterministic structural constraints into the policy alignment process. This framework ensures prescribed sequence length, robust format consistency, and rigorous linguistic well formedness, all enforced during training. Central to our approach is a variable entropy mechanism that enables the model to dynamically calibrate the equilibrium between literal fidelity and semantic naturalness by modulating the exploration exploitation manifold. By integrating entropy tempered advantage estimation with asymmetric clipping, VEPO sustains robust exploration while mitigating policy collapse. Empirical evaluations across 90 FLORES-200, COMET-22, chrF directions demonstrate that VEPO yields substantial improvements in both tokenization efficiency and translation quality, bridging the performance gap for underrepresented languages.

AI.tldr: VEPO框架通过强化学习优化低资源语言的子词分割，提升翻译质量和分词效率
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在低资源语言上表现不佳，主要原因是低效的子词分割和训练数据不平衡问题
AI.method: 提出可变熵策略优化(VEPO)，利用带可验证奖励的强化学习，在策略对齐过程中融入确定性结构约束，包括可变熵机制和熵温优势估计
AI.result: 在90个FLORES-200、COMET-22、chrF方向上评估，VEPO显著提升了分词效率和翻译质量
AI.conclusion: VEPO框架有效缩小了低资源语言的性能差距，通过动态平衡字面保真度和语义自然性来优化语言模型表现

title: I Can't Believe It's Corrupt: Evaluating Corruption in Multi-Agent Governance Systems
summary: Large language models are increasingly proposed as autonomous agents for high-stakes public workflows, yet we lack systematic evidence about whether they would follow institutional rules when granted authority. We present evidence that integrity in institutional AI should be treated as a pre-deployment requirement rather than a post-deployment assumption. We evaluate multi-agent governance simulations in which agents occupy formal governmental roles under different authority structures, and we score rule-breaking and abuse outcomes with an independent rubric-based judge across 28,112 transcript segments. While we advance this position, the core contribution is empirical: among models operating below saturation, governance structure is a stronger driver of corruption-related outcomes than model identity, with large differences across regimes and model--governance pairings. Lightweight safeguards can reduce risk in some settings but do not consistently prevent severe failures. These results imply that institutional design is a precondition for safe delegation: before real authority is assigned to LLM agents, systems should undergo stress testing under governance-like constraints with enforceable rules, auditable logs, and human oversight on high-impact actions.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了大型语言模型作为政府机构自主代理时的规则遵守情况，发现治理结构比模型本身对腐败结果的影响更大，需要将制度完整性作为部署前要求而非部署后假设。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被提议作为高风险公共工作流程的自主代理，但缺乏系统证据表明它们在获得权力时是否会遵守制度规则。需要验证AI在制度环境中的完整性是否应作为部署前要求而非部署后假设。
AI.method: 采用多智能体治理模拟方法，让智能体在不同权威结构下担任正式政府角色。通过独立的基于规则的评分系统对28,112个转录片段进行评分，评估规则违反和滥用结果。比较不同治理结构和模型组合下的表现。
AI.result: 在未达到饱和的模型中，治理结构是腐败相关结果的更强驱动因素，不同制度和模型-治理配对之间存在显著差异。轻量级安全措施在某些设置中可以降低风险，但不能持续防止严重失败。
AI.conclusion: 制度设计是安全授权的先决条件：在将实际权力分配给LLM代理之前，系统应在类似治理的约束下进行压力测试，包括可执行规则、可审计日志和对高影响行动的人工监督。

title: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Fast Video Generation via Offline Layer-Wise Sparsity Profiling and Online Bidirectional Co-Clustering
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve strong video generation quality but suffer from high inference cost due to dense 3D attention, leading to the development of sparse attention technologies to improve efficiency. However, existing training-free sparse attention methods in video generation still face two unresolved limitations: ignoring layer heterogeneity in attention pruning and ignoring query-key coupling in block partitioning, which hinder a better quality-speedup trade-off. In this work, we uncover a critical insight that the attention sparsity of each layer is its intrinsic property, with minor effects across different inputs. Motivated by this, we propose SVOO, a training-free Sparse attention framework for fast Video generation via Offline layer-wise sparsity profiling and Online bidirectional co-clustering. Specifically, SVOO adopts a two-stage paradigm: (i) offline layer-wise sensitivity profiling to derive intrinsic per-layer pruning levels, and (ii) online block-wise sparse attention via a novel bidirectional co-clustering algorithm. Extensive experiments on seven widely used video generation models demonstrate that SVOO achieves a superior quality-speedup trade-off over state-of-the-art methods, delivering up to $1.93\times$ speedup while maintaining a PSNR of up to 29 dB on Wan2.1.

AI.tldr: SVOO是一种无需训练的视频生成稀疏注意力框架，通过离线层间稀疏度分析和在线双向协同聚类，在保持视频质量的同时实现高达1.93倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成中的稀疏注意力方法存在两个未解决的局限性：忽略注意力剪枝中的层间异质性和忽略块划分中的查询-键耦合，这阻碍了更好的质量-加速权衡。
AI.method: 提出SVOO框架，采用两阶段范式：(1) 离线层间敏感度分析，推导每层固有的剪枝水平；(2) 在线块级稀疏注意力，通过新颖的双向协同聚类算法实现。
AI.result: 在七个广泛使用的视频生成模型上进行实验，SVOO在质量-加速权衡方面优于最先进方法，在Wan2.1上实现高达1.93倍加速，同时保持高达29 dB的PSNR。
AI.conclusion: SVOO通过揭示注意力稀疏性是每层固有属性这一关键洞察，提出有效的离线-在线结合框架，为视频生成提供了优越的质量-加速权衡解决方案。

title: Evaluating Counterfactual Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: We evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) in repeated game-theoretic settings to assess whether strategic performance reflects genuine reasoning or reliance on memorized patterns. We consider two canonical games, Prisoner's Dilemma (PD) and Rock-Paper-Scissors (RPS), upon which we introduce counterfactual variants that alter payoff structures and action labels, breaking familiar symmetries and dominance relations. Our multi-metric evaluation framework compares default and counterfactual instantiations, showcasing LLM limitations in incentive sensitivity, structural generalization and strategic reasoning within counterfactual environments.

AI.tldr: 评估大语言模型在重复博弈环境中的战略表现，区分其是基于真实推理还是依赖记忆模式
AI.motivation: 研究大语言模型在博弈论环境中的战略推理能力，检验其是否真正理解游戏结构和激励机制，还是仅仅依赖训练数据中的记忆模式
AI.method: 使用囚徒困境和石头剪刀布两个经典博弈，创建反事实变体改变收益结构和行动标签，打破熟悉的对称性和支配关系，通过多指标评估框架比较默认和反事实版本
AI.result: 展示了大语言模型在反事实环境中的局限性，包括对激励的敏感性不足、结构泛化能力有限以及战略推理能力不足
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在战略推理方面存在明显局限，更多依赖记忆模式而非真正的推理能力，特别是在面对反事实环境时表现不佳

title: Secure Linear Alignment of Large Language Models
summary: Language models increasingly appear to learn similar representations, despite differences in training objectives, architectures, and data modalities. This emerging compatibility between independently trained models introduces new opportunities for cross-model alignment to downstream objectives. Moreover, it unlocks new potential application domains, such as settings where security, privacy, or competitive constraints prohibit direct data or model sharing. In this work, we propose a privacy-preserving framework that exploits representational convergence to enable cross-silo inference between independent language models. The framework learns an affine transformation over a shared public dataset and applies homomorphic encryption to protect client queries during inference. By encrypting only the linear alignment and classification operations, the method achieves sub-second inference latency while maintaining strong security guarantees. We support this framework with an empirical investigation into representational convergence, in which we learn linear transformations between the final hidden states of independent models. We evaluate these cross-model mappings on embedding classification and out-of-distribution detection, observing minimal performance degradation across model pairs. Additionally, we show for the first time that linear alignment sometimes enables text generation across independently trained models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于表示收敛的隐私保护跨模型推理框架，利用同态加密保护客户端查询，实现亚秒级推理延迟
AI.motivation: 语言模型在不同训练目标、架构和数据模态下学习到相似表示，这种表示收敛性为跨模型对齐下游任务提供了新机会，特别是在安全、隐私或竞争约束禁止直接数据或模型共享的场景中
AI.method: 提出隐私保护框架：1）在共享公共数据集上学习仿射变换对齐独立语言模型；2）使用同态加密保护客户端推理查询；3）仅加密线性对齐和分类操作以降低延迟；4）通过实证研究验证表示收敛性，学习独立模型最终隐藏状态间的线性变换
AI.result: 1）在嵌入分类和分布外检测任务中，跨模型映射性能下降最小；2）首次展示线性对齐有时能实现独立训练模型间的文本生成；3）框架实现亚秒级推理延迟同时保持强安全保证
AI.conclusion: 表示收敛性为跨模型对齐提供了理论基础，提出的隐私保护框架在安全约束场景中具有实际应用价值，为独立训练模型间的协作推理开辟了新途径

title: PhysVideo: Physically Plausible Video Generation with Cross-View Geometry Guidance
summary: Recent progress in video generation has led to substantial improvements in visual fidelity, yet ensuring physically consistent motion remains a fundamental challenge. Intuitively, this limitation can be attributed to the fact that real-world object motion unfolds in three-dimensional space, while video observations provide only partial, view-dependent projections of such dynamics. To address these issues, we propose PhysVideo, a two-stage framework that first generates physics-aware orthogonal foreground videos and then synthesizes full videos with background. In the first stage, Phys4View leverages physics-aware attention to capture the influence of physical attributes on motion dynamics, and enhances spatio-temporal consistency by incorporating geometry-enhanced cross-view attention and temporal attention. In the second stage, VideoSyn uses the generated foreground videos as guidance and learns the interactions between foreground dynamics and background context for controllable video synthesis. To support training, we construct PhysMV, a dataset containing 40K scenes, each consisting of four orthogonal viewpoints, resulting in a total of 160K video sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysVideo significantly improves physical realism and spatial-temporal coherence over existing video generation methods. Home page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/Phys4D/.

AI.tldr: PhysVideo是一个两阶段视频生成框架，首先生成物理感知的正交前景视频，然后合成带背景的完整视频，显著提升了物理真实性和时空一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成方法在视觉保真度方面取得了进展，但确保物理一致的运动仍然是一个基本挑战。真实世界物体运动发生在三维空间，而视频观测仅提供这种动态的部分、视角依赖的投影。
AI.method: 提出PhysVideo两阶段框架：第一阶段Phys4View使用物理感知注意力捕捉物理属性对运动动态的影响，并通过几何增强的跨视角注意力和时间注意力增强时空一致性；第二阶段VideoSyn使用生成的前景视频作为指导，学习前景动态与背景上下文之间的交互以实现可控视频合成。
AI.result: 构建了PhysMV数据集（包含40K场景，每个场景有四个正交视角，总计160K视频序列）。实验表明PhysVideo在物理真实性和时空一致性方面显著优于现有视频生成方法。
AI.conclusion: PhysVideo通过两阶段框架有效解决了视频生成中的物理一致性挑战，通过物理感知注意力机制和正交视角处理，显著提升了生成视频的物理真实性和时空连贯性。

title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation
comment: We release the model and data at https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/nemotron-cascade-2
summary: We introduce Nemotron-Cascade 2, an open 30B MoE model with 3B activated parameters that delivers best-in-class reasoning and strong agentic capabilities. Despite its compact size, its mathematical and coding reasoning performance approaches that of frontier open models. It is the second open-weight LLM, after DeepSeekV3.2-Speciale-671B-A37B, to achieve Gold Medal-level performance in the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO), the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI), and the ICPC World Finals, demonstrating remarkably high intelligence density with 20x fewer parameters. In contrast to Nemotron-Cascade 1, the key technical advancements are as follows. After SFT on a meticulously curated dataset, we substantially expand Cascade RL to cover a much broader spectrum of reasoning and agentic domains. Furthermore, we introduce multi-domain on-policy distillation from the strongest intermediate teacher models for each domain throughout the Cascade RL process, allowing us to efficiently recover benchmark regressions and sustain strong performance gains along the way. We release the collection of model checkpoint and training data.

AI.tldr: Nemotron-Cascade 2是一个300亿参数的开放权重MoE模型，仅激活30亿参数，在数学和编程推理方面接近前沿模型性能，是第二个在IMO、IOI和ICPC世界总决赛中达到金牌级别性能的开放模型。
AI.motivation: 开发一个参数效率高、推理能力强且具备优秀智能代理能力的开放权重模型，在保持较小模型规模的同时实现接近前沿模型的数学和编程推理性能。
AI.method: 1. 使用精心策划的数据集进行监督微调(SFT)；2. 大幅扩展Cascade RL以覆盖更广泛的推理和代理领域；3. 引入多领域在线策略蒸馏，在整个Cascade RL过程中从各领域最强的中间教师模型进行知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 1. 在2025年国际数学奥林匹克(IMO)、国际信息学奥林匹克(IOI)和ICPC世界总决赛中达到金牌级别性能；2. 数学和编程推理性能接近前沿开放模型；3. 以20倍更少的参数实现高智能密度；4. 模型检查点和训练数据已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: Nemotron-Cascade 2展示了通过精心设计的训练策略，可以在相对较小的模型规模下实现卓越的推理和代理能力，为高效智能模型的发展提供了重要参考。

title: MeInTime: Bridging Age Gap in Identity-Preserving Face Restoration
summary: To better preserve an individual's identity, face restoration has evolved from reference-free to reference-based approaches, which leverage high-quality reference images of the same identity to enhance identity fidelity in the restored outputs. However, most existing methods implicitly assume that the reference and degraded input are age-aligned, limiting their effectiveness in real-world scenarios where only cross-age references are available, such as historical photo restoration. This paper proposes MeInTime, a diffusion-based face restoration method that extends reference-based restoration from same-age to cross-age settings. Given one or few reference images along with an age prompt corresponding to the degraded input, MeInTime achieves faithful restoration with both identity fidelity and age consistency. Specifically, we decouple the modeling of identity and age conditions. During training, we focus solely on effectively injecting identity features through a newly introduced attention mechanism and introduce Gated Residual Fusion modules to facilitate the integration between degraded features and identity representations. At inference, we propose Age-Aware Gradient Guidance, a training-free sampling strategy, using an age-driven direction to iteratively nudge the identity-aware denoising latent toward the desired age semantic manifold. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeInTime outperforms existing face restoration methods in both identity preservation and age consistency. Our code is available at: https://github.com/teer4/MeInTime

AI.tldr: MeInTime是一种基于扩散模型的跨年龄人脸修复方法，通过解耦身份和年龄条件建模，在仅有跨年龄参考图像的情况下实现身份保真和年龄一致性的高质量修复。
AI.motivation: 现有基于参考的人脸修复方法通常假设参考图像与退化输入年龄对齐，但在实际场景（如历史照片修复）中往往只能获得跨年龄的参考图像，限制了这些方法的实用性。
AI.method: 1) 解耦身份和年龄条件建模：训练时专注于通过新的注意力机制有效注入身份特征，引入门控残差融合模块整合退化特征和身份表示；2) 推理时提出年龄感知梯度引导，使用年龄驱动方向迭代地将身份感知去噪潜在向量推向目标年龄语义流形。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MeInTime在身份保持和年龄一致性方面优于现有的人脸修复方法。
AI.conclusion: MeInTime成功将基于参考的人脸修复从同年龄设置扩展到跨年龄设置，通过解耦建模和训练自由采样策略实现了高质量的身份保真和年龄一致性修复。

title: F2LLM-v2: Inclusive, Performant, and Efficient Embeddings for a Multilingual World
summary: We present F2LLM-v2, a new family of general-purpose, multilingual embedding models in 8 distinct sizes ranging from 80M to 14B. Trained on a newly curated composite of 60 million publicly available high-quality data samples, F2LLM-v2 supports more than 200 languages, with a particular emphasis on previously underserved mid- and low-resource languages. By integrating a two-stage LLM-based embedding training pipeline with matryoshka learning, model pruning, and knowledge distillation techniques, we present models that are far more efficient than previous LLM-based embedding models while retaining competitive performances. Extensive evaluations confirm that F2LLM-v2-14B ranks first on 11 MTEB benchmarks, while the smaller models in the family also set a new state of the art for resource-constrained applications. To facilitate open-source embedding model research, we release all models, data, code, and intermediate checkpoints.

AI.tldr: F2LLM-v2是一个多语言嵌入模型家族，包含8种规模（80M到14B），支持200多种语言，特别关注中低资源语言，在效率和性能上都有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 开发一个通用、多语言且高效的嵌入模型家族，特别关注之前服务不足的中低资源语言，同时通过技术创新提高模型效率。
AI.method: 采用两阶段LLM嵌入训练流程，结合matryoshka学习、模型剪枝和知识蒸馏技术，使用6000万高质量公开数据样本进行训练。
AI.result: F2LLM-v2-14B在11个MTEB基准测试中排名第一，家族中较小模型也在资源受限应用中创造了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: F2LLM-v2系列模型在多语言嵌入任务中表现出色，特别在效率和资源受限场景下具有优势，所有模型、数据、代码和中间检查点都已开源。

title: Teleological Inference in Structural Causal Models via Intentional Interventions
summary: Structural causal models (SCMs) were conceived to formulate and answer causal questions. This paper shows that SCMs can also be used to formulate and answer teleological questions, concerning the intentions of a state-aware, goal-directed agent intervening in a causal system. We review limitations of previous approaches to modeling such agents, and then introduce intentional interventions, a new time-agnostic operator that induces a twin SCM we call a structural final model (SFM). SFMs treat observed values as the outcome of intentional interventions and relate them to the counterfactual conditions of those interventions (what would have happened had the agent not intervened). We show how SFMs can be used to empirically detect agents and to discover their intentions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新方法，将结构因果模型（SCMs）扩展到能够处理目的论问题，通过引入"意向干预"操作符和结构最终模型（SFMs）来检测和发现智能体的意图。
AI.motivation: 传统结构因果模型主要用于回答因果问题，但无法处理目的论问题，即无法建模具有状态感知和目标导向的智能体在因果系统中的干预行为。现有方法在建模这类智能体时存在局限性，需要新的理论框架来理解和分析智能体的意图。
AI.method: 引入"意向干预"这一时间无关的操作符，该操作符诱导出一个称为结构最终模型（SFM）的双胞胎SCM。SFMs将观测值视为意向干预的结果，并将这些值与干预的反事实条件（如果智能体没有干预会发生什么）联系起来。
AI.result: 研究表明，SFMs可以用于经验性地检测系统中是否存在智能体，并发现这些智能体的意图。该方法为分析目标导向行为提供了新的理论工具。
AI.conclusion: 结构因果模型不仅可以用于因果推理，还可以扩展到目的论分析。通过引入意向干预和结构最终模型，我们能够形式化地处理智能体的意图问题，为理解目标导向行为提供了新的分析框架。

title: Click-to-Ask: An AI Live Streaming Assistant with Offline Copywriting and Online Interactive QA
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, Accepted at WWW2026 Demos
summary: Live streaming commerce has become a prominent form of broadcasting in the modern era. To facilitate more efficient and convenient product promotions for streamers, we present Click-to-Ask, an AI-driven assistant for live streaming commerce with complementary offline and online components. The offline module processes diverse multimodal product information, transforming complex inputs into structured product data and generating compliant promotional copywriting. During live broadcasts, the online module enables real-time responses to viewer inquiries by allowing streamers to click on questions and leveraging both the structured product information generated by the offline module and an event-level historical memory maintained in a streaming architecture. This system significantly reduces the time needed for promotional preparation, enhances content engagement, and enables prompt interaction with audience inquiries, ultimately improving the effectiveness of live streaming commerce. On our collected dataset of TikTok live stream frames, the proposed method achieves a Question Recognition Accuracy of 0.913 and a Response Quality score of 0.876, demonstrating considerable potential for practical application. The video demonstration can be viewed here: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/mWIXK-SWhiE.

AI.tldr: Click-to-Ask是一个用于直播电商的AI助手系统，包含离线和在线组件，通过处理多模态产品信息生成结构化数据和促销文案，并在直播中实时响应观众问题，显著提升直播效果。
AI.motivation: 直播电商已成为现代重要的传播形式，但主播在推广产品时需要处理复杂的产品信息并实时回应观众问题，这需要大量准备时间和精力。为了帮助主播更高效、便捷地进行产品推广，需要开发一个智能助手系统。
AI.method: 系统包含离线和在线两个模块：离线模块处理多模态产品信息（如图片、视频、文本等），将其转化为结构化产品数据并生成合规的促销文案；在线模块在直播过程中，允许主播点击观众问题，利用离线模块生成的结构化产品信息和流式架构维护的事件级历史记忆，实时生成回答。
AI.result: 在收集的TikTok直播帧数据集上，该方法实现了0.913的问题识别准确率和0.876的回答质量评分。系统显著减少了促销准备时间，增强了内容参与度，并能及时回应观众询问，提高了直播电商的效果。
AI.conclusion: Click-to-Ask系统通过结合离线和在线AI组件，为直播电商提供了一个高效的智能助手解决方案，展示了在实际应用中的巨大潜力，能够帮助主播更好地进行产品推广和观众互动。

title: Benchmarking PDF Parsers on Table Extraction with LLM-based Semantic Evaluation
summary:
Reliably extracting tables from PDFs is essential for large-scale scientific data mining and knowledge base construction, yet existing evaluation approaches rely on rule-based metrics that fail to capture semantic equivalence of table content. We present a benchmarking framework based on synthetically generated PDFs with precise LaTeX ground truth, using tables sourced from arXiv to ensure realistic complexity and diversity. As our central methodological contribution, we apply LLM-as-a-judge for semantic table evaluation, integrated into a matching pipeline that accommodates inconsistencies in parser outputs. Through a human validation study comprising over 1,500 quality judgments on extracted table pairs, we show that LLM-based evaluation achieves substantially higher correlation with human judgment (Pearson r=0.93) compared to Tree Edit Distance-based Similarity (TEDS, r=0.68) and Grid Table Similarity (GriTS, r=0.70). Evaluating 21 contemporary PDF parsers across 100 synthetic documents containing 451 tables reveals significant performance disparities. Our results offer practical guidance for selecting parsers for tabular data extraction and establish a reproducible, scalable evaluation methodology for this critical task.
  Code and data: https://github.com/phorn1/pdf-parse-bench Metric study and human evaluation: https://github.com/phorn1/table-metric-study

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于合成PDF和LLM评估的表格提取基准框架，通过人类验证显示LLM评估比传统指标更接近人类判断，并评估了21个PDF解析器的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 从PDF中可靠提取表格对于大规模科学数据挖掘和知识库构建至关重要，但现有评估方法依赖基于规则的指标，无法捕捉表格内容的语义等价性。
AI.method: 1) 使用arXiv表格创建合成PDF基准，包含精确的LaTeX真值；2) 采用LLM作为评估器进行语义表格评估；3) 构建匹配管道处理解析器输出的不一致性；4) 进行包含1500多个质量判断的人类验证研究。
AI.result: LLM评估与人类判断的相关性显著更高（Pearson r=0.93），优于树编辑距离相似度（TEDS，r=0.68）和网格表格相似度（GriTS，r=0.70）。评估21个PDF解析器在100个合成文档的451个表格上显示出显著性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为选择表格数据提取解析器提供了实用指导，并为这一关键任务建立了可重复、可扩展的评估方法学。

title: Unmasking Algorithmic Bias in Predictive Policing: A GAN-Based Simulation Framework with Multi-City Temporal Analysis
summary:
Predictive policing systems that direct patrol resources based on algorithmically generated crime forecasts have been widely deployed across US cities, yet their tendency to encode and amplify racial disparities remains poorly understood in quantitative terms. We present a reproducible simulation framework that couples a Generative Adversarial Network GAN with a Noisy OR patrol detection model to measure how racial bias propagates through the full enforcement pipeline from crime occurrence to police contact. Using 145000 plus Part 1 crime records from Baltimore 2017 to 2019 and 233000 plus records from Chicago 2022, augmented with US Census ACS demographic data, we compute four monthly bias metrics across 264 city year mode observations: the Disparate Impact Ratio DIR, Demographic Parity Gap, Gini Coefficient, and a composite Bias Amplification Score.
  Our experiments reveal extreme and year variant bias in Baltimores detected mode, with mean annual DIR up to 15714 in 2019, moderate under detection of Black residents in Chicago DIR equals 0.22, and persistent Gini coefficients of 0.43 to 0.62 across all conditions. We further demonstrate that a Conditional Tabular GAN CTGAN debiasing approach partially redistributes detection rates but cannot eliminate structural disparity without accompanying policy intervention. Socioeconomic regression analysis confirms strong correlations between neighborhood racial composition and detection likelihood Pearson r equals 0.83 for percent White and r equals negative 0.81 for percent Black. A sensitivity analysis over patrol radius, officer count, and citizen reporting probability reveals that outcomes are most sensitive to officer deployment levels. The code and data are publicly available at this repository.

AI.tldr: 研究开发了一个可重复的模拟框架，结合GAN和Noisy OR模型，量化预测性警务系统中种族偏见的传播和放大效应，发现存在显著的种族差异，仅靠技术去偏方法无法消除结构性不平等。
AI.motivation: 预测性警务系统在美国城市广泛部署，但其编码和放大种族差异的倾向在定量上仍未被充分理解。需要系统性地测量种族偏见如何在整个执法流程中传播。
AI.method: 开发可重复的模拟框架，结合生成对抗网络(GAN)和Noisy OR巡逻检测模型。使用巴尔的摩(2017-2019)和芝加哥(2022)的犯罪记录数据，结合美国人口普查ACS人口统计数据，计算四个月度偏见指标。采用条件表格GAN(CTGAN)去偏方法，并进行社会经济回归分析和敏感性分析。
AI.result: 巴尔的摩检测模式存在极端且年度变化的偏见(2019年平均DIR高达15714)，芝加哥存在对黑人居民的中度欠检测(DIR=0.22)。所有条件下的基尼系数持续在0.43-0.62之间。CTGAN去偏方法只能部分重新分配检测率，无法消除结构性差异。社会经济分析显示社区种族构成与检测可能性强相关。敏感性分析表明结果对警官部署水平最敏感。
AI.conclusion: 预测性警务系统确实会编码和放大种族偏见，仅靠技术去偏方法无法解决结构性不平等问题。需要配套的政策干预措施来减少执法中的种族差异。研究提供了量化偏见传播的框架和证据。

title: Evaluating Game Difficulty in Tetris Block Puzzle
summary: Tetris Block Puzzle is a single player stochastic puzzle in which a player places blocks on an 8 x 8 grid to complete lines; its popular variants have amassed tens of millions of downloads. Despite this reach, there is little principled assessment of which rule sets are more difficult. Inspired by prior work that uses AlphaZero as a strong evaluator for chess variants, we study difficulty in this domain using Stochastic Gumbel AlphaZero (SGAZ), a budget-aware planning agent for stochastic environments. We evaluate rule changes including holding block h, preview holding block p, and additional Tetris block variants using metrics such as training reward and convergence iterations. Empirically, increasing h and p reduces difficulty (higher reward and faster convergence), while adding more Tetris block variants increases difficulty, with the T-pentomino producing the largest slowdown. Through analysis, SGAZ delivers strong play under small simulation budgets, enabling efficient, reproducible comparisons across rule sets and providing a reference for future design in stochastic puzzle games.

AI.tldr: 使用Stochastic Gumbel AlphaZero评估Tetris Block Puzzle规则集的难度，发现增加持有块和预览块会降低难度，而添加更多方块变体会增加难度。
AI.motivation: Tetris Block Puzzle拥有数百万下载量，但缺乏对哪些规则集更难的原理性评估，需要一种系统方法来衡量不同规则对游戏难度的影响。
AI.method: 使用Stochastic Gumbel AlphaZero作为预算感知的随机环境规划代理，评估规则变化（持有块h、预览块p、Tetris方块变体），通过训练奖励和收敛迭代等指标进行分析。
AI.result: 增加h和p会降低难度（更高的奖励和更快的收敛），而添加更多Tetris方块变体会增加难度，其中T-pentomino导致最大的减速效应。
AI.conclusion: SGAZ在小模拟预算下提供强大的游戏表现，实现了跨规则集的高效、可重复比较，为随机拼图游戏的未来设计提供了参考。

title: Regret Bounds for Competitive Resource Allocation with Endogenous Costs
comment: This is Paper 7 in a 9-paper series on Super-Alignment via Wuxing Institutional Architecture. The series explores resource competition and institutional design for human-aligned AI systems
summary:
We study online resource allocation among N interacting modules over T rounds. Unlike standard online optimization, costs are endogenous: they depend on the full allocation vector through an interaction matrix W encoding pairwise cooperation and competition.
  We analyze three paradigms: (I) uniform allocation (cost-ignorant), (II) gated allocation (cost-estimating), and (III) competitive allocation via multiplicative weights update with interaction feedback (cost-revealing). Our main results establish a strict separation under adversarial sequences with bounded variation: uniform incurs Omega(T) regret, gated achieves O(T^{2/3}), and competitive achieves O(sqrt(T log N)). The performance gap stems from competitive allocation's ability to exploit endogenous cost information revealed through interactions.
  We further show that W's topology governs a computation-regret tradeoff. Full interaction (|E|=O(N^2)) yields the tightest bound but highest per-step cost, while sparse topologies (|E|=O(N)) increase regret by at most O(sqrt(log N)) while reducing per-step cost from O(N^2) to O(N). Ring-structured topologies with both cooperative and competitive links - of which the five-element Wuxing topology is canonical - minimize the computation x regret product.
  These results provide the first formal regret-theoretic justification for decentralized competitive allocation in modular architectures and establish cost endogeneity as a fundamental challenge distinct from partial observability.
  Keywords: online learning, regret bounds, resource allocation, endogenous costs, interaction topology, multiplicative weights, modular systems, Wuxing topology

AI.tldr: 该论文研究具有内生成本的在线资源分配问题，分析了三种分配范式在对抗序列下的性能差异，发现竞争性分配能最好地利用交互反馈信息，并揭示了交互拓扑结构对计算-遗憾权衡的影响。
AI.motivation: 研究模块化系统中在线资源分配问题，其中成本是内生的，即成本取决于通过交互矩阵编码的模块间合作与竞争关系。这与标准在线优化不同，需要新的理论框架来分析这种内生成本环境下的分配策略性能。
AI.method: 分析三种分配范式：(I) 均匀分配（忽略成本），(II) 门控分配（估计成本），(III) 竞争性分配（通过交互反馈的乘性权重更新）。在具有有界变化的对抗序列下建立严格分离结果，并研究交互矩阵W的拓扑结构对计算-遗憾权衡的影响。
AI.result: 在对抗序列下：均匀分配产生Ω(T)遗憾，门控分配达到O(T^{2/3})遗憾，竞争性分配达到O(√(T log N))遗憾。交互拓扑结构影响计算-遗憾权衡：完全交互（O(N^2)边）获得最紧界但计算成本最高；稀疏拓扑（O(N)边）最多增加O(√(log N))遗憾但将每步成本从O(N^2)降至O(N)。环状拓扑（如五行拓扑）最小化计算×遗憾乘积。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次为模块化架构中的分散竞争性分配提供了形式化的遗憾理论证明，并确立了成本内生性作为与部分可观测性不同的基本挑战。交互拓扑结构在计算效率和性能之间提供了可调节的权衡，其中环状拓扑（如五行拓扑）在计算-遗憾乘积方面表现最优。

title: Towards High-Quality Image Segmentation: Improving Topology Accuracy by Penalizing Neighbor Pixels
summary: Standard deep learning models for image segmentation cannot guarantee topology accuracy, failing to preserve the correct number of connected components or structures. This, in turn, affects the quality of the segmentations and compromises the reliability of the subsequent quantification analyses. Previous works have proposed to enhance topology accuracy with specialized frameworks, architectures, and loss functions. However, these methods are often cumbersome to integrate into existing training pipelines, they are computationally very expensive, or they are restricted to structures with tubular morphology. We present SCNP, an efficient method that improves topology accuracy by penalizing the logits with their poorest-classified neighbor, forcing the model to improve the prediction at the pixels' neighbors before allowing it to improve the pixels themselves. We show the effectiveness of SCNP across 13 datasets, covering different structure morphologies and image modalities, and integrate it into three frameworks for semantic and instance segmentation. Additionally, we show that SCNP can be integrated into several loss functions, making them improve topology accuracy. Our code can be found at https://jmlipman.github.io/SCNP-SameClassNeighborPenalization.

AI.tldr: SCNP是一种通过惩罚最差分类邻居来提升图像分割拓扑准确性的高效方法，适用于多种结构形态和图像模态
AI.motivation: 传统的深度学习图像分割模型无法保证拓扑准确性，无法保持正确的连通组件数量或结构，这影响了分割质量并损害后续量化分析的可靠性。现有方法要么难以集成到现有训练流程，要么计算成本高，要么仅限于管状结构。
AI.method: SCNP通过惩罚logits中最差分类的邻居来提升拓扑准确性，强制模型在改进像素本身之前先改进其邻居的预测。该方法可以集成到语义分割和实例分割的多个框架中，并能与多种损失函数结合使用。
AI.result: 在13个不同结构形态和图像模态的数据集上验证了SCNP的有效性，能够显著提升拓扑准确性，并且可以集成到三种语义分割和实例分割框架中。
AI.conclusion: SCNP是一种高效、通用的提升图像分割拓扑准确性的方法，易于集成到现有训练流程，适用于多种结构形态和图像模态。

title: Behavioral Fingerprints for LLM Endpoint Stability and Identity
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, submitted to CAIS 2026 System Demonstrations
summary: The consistency of AI-native applications depends on the behavioral consistency of the model endpoints that power them. Traditional reliability metrics such as uptime, latency and throughput do not capture behavioral change, and an endpoint can remain "healthy" while its effective model identity changes due to updates to weights, tokenizers, quantization, inference engines, kernels, caching, routing, or hardware. We introduce Stability Monitor, a black-box stability monitoring system that periodically fingerprints an endpoint by sampling outputs from a fixed prompt set and comparing the resulting output distributions over time. Fingerprints are compared using a summed energy distance statistic across prompts, with permutation-test p-values as evidence of distribution shift aggregated sequentially to detect change events and define stability periods. In controlled validation, Stability Monitor detects changes to model family, version, inference stack, quantization, and behavioral parameters. In real-world monitoring of the same model hosted by multiple providers, we observe substantial provider-to-provider and within-provider stability differences.

AI.tldr: 提出Stability Monitor系统，用于监控AI模型端点的行为一致性，通过定期采样输出分布来检测模型身份变化，弥补传统可靠性指标无法捕捉行为变化的不足。
AI.motivation: AI原生应用的一致性依赖于模型端点的行为一致性。传统可靠性指标（如正常运行时间、延迟和吞吐量）无法捕捉行为变化，模型端点可能在保持"健康"状态的同时，由于权重更新、分词器、量化、推理引擎、内核、缓存、路由或硬件的变化而导致其有效模型身份发生变化。
AI.method: 提出Stability Monitor黑盒稳定性监控系统，通过定期对端点进行指纹识别：从固定提示集中采样输出，并比较随时间变化的输出分布。使用跨提示的求和能量距离统计量比较指纹，通过排列检验p值作为分布偏移证据，顺序聚合以检测变化事件并定义稳定期。
AI.result: 在受控验证中，Stability Monitor能够检测模型系列、版本、推理堆栈、量化和行为参数的变化。在多个提供商托管的同一模型的实际监控中，观察到显著的提供商间和提供商内稳定性差异。
AI.conclusion: Stability Monitor提供了一种有效的方法来监控AI模型端点的行为稳定性，能够检测传统指标无法捕捉的模型身份变化，对于确保AI原生应用的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: Ontology-Guided Diffusion for Zero-Shot Visual Sim2Real Transfer
summary: Bridging the simulation-to-reality (sim2real) gap remains challenging as labelled real-world data is scarce. Existing diffusion-based approaches rely on unstructured prompts or statistical alignment, which do not capture the structured factors that make images look real. We introduce Ontology- Guided Diffusion (OGD), a neuro-symbolic zero-shot sim2real image translation framework that represents realism as structured knowledge. OGD decomposes realism into an ontology of interpretable traits -- such as lighting and material properties -- and encodes their relationships in a knowledge graph. From a synthetic image, OGD infers trait activations and uses a graph neural network to produce a global embedding. In parallel, a symbolic planner uses the ontology traits to compute a consistent sequence of visual edits needed to narrow the realism gap. The graph embedding conditions a pretrained instruction-guided diffusion model via cross-attention, while the planned edits are converted into a structured instruction prompt. Across benchmarks, our graph-based embeddings better distinguish real from synthetic imagery than baselines, and OGD outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion methods in sim2real image translations. Overall, OGD shows that explicitly encoding realism structure enables interpretable, data-efficient, and generalisable zero-shot sim2real transfer.

AI.tldr: OGD是一种神经符号零样本sim2real图像翻译框架，通过将真实感分解为可解释特征的ontology知识图谱，结合图神经网络和符号规划器来指导扩散模型，实现可解释、数据高效和可泛化的零样本仿真到真实转换。
AI.motivation: 仿真到真实（sim2real）转换面临标注真实数据稀缺的挑战。现有基于扩散的方法依赖非结构化提示或统计对齐，无法捕捉使图像看起来真实的结构化因素。
AI.method: 提出Ontology-Guided Diffusion (OGD)框架：1) 将真实感分解为可解释特征（如光照、材质属性）的ontology；2) 用知识图谱编码特征关系；3) 从合成图像推断特征激活，用图神经网络生成全局嵌入；4) 符号规划器使用ontology特征计算一致的视觉编辑序列；5) 图嵌入通过交叉注意力条件化预训练的指令引导扩散模型，规划编辑转换为结构化指令提示。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，OGD的基于图的嵌入比基线方法能更好地区分真实与合成图像，并且在sim2real图像翻译任务上优于最先进的扩散方法。
AI.conclusion: OGD表明，显式编码真实感结构能够实现可解释、数据高效和可泛化的零样本sim2real转换，为仿真到真实转换提供了新的神经符号方法。

title: Man and machine: artificial intelligence and judicial decision making
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies into judicial decision-making - particularly in pretrial, sentencing, and parole contexts - has generated substantial concerns about transparency, reliability, and accountability. At the same time, these developments have brought the limitations of human judgment into sharper relief and underscored the importance of understanding how judges interact with AI-based decision aids. Using criminal justice risk assessment as a focal case, we conduct a synthetic review connecting three intertwined aspects of AI's role in judicial decision-making: the performance and fairness of AI tools, the strengths and biases of human judges, and the nature of AI+human interactions. Across the fields of computer science, economics, law, criminology and psychology, researchers have made significant progress in evaluating the predictive validity of automated risk assessment instruments, documenting biases in judicial decision-making, and, to a more limited extent, examining how judges use algorithmic recommendations. While the existing empirical evidence indicates that the impact of AI decision aid tools on pretrial and sentencing decisions is modest or inexistent, our review also reveals important gaps in the canvassed literatures. Further research is needed to evaluate the performance of AI risk assessment instruments, understand how judges navigate noisy decision making environments and how individual characteristics influence judges' responses to AI advice. We argue that AI vs Human comparisons have the potential to yield new insights into both algorithmic tools and human decision-makers and advocate greater interdisciplinary integration and cross-fertilization in future research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性综述探讨AI在司法决策中的作用，重点关注风险评估工具的性能与公平性、人类法官的优势与偏见、以及人机交互三个方面，发现AI辅助工具对审前和量刑决策影响有限，并指出未来需要更多跨学科研究。
AI.motivation: AI技术在司法决策中的应用引发了透明度、可靠性和问责制方面的担忧，同时也凸显了人类判断的局限性。本文旨在通过系统性综述，理解AI在司法决策中的角色，特别是风险评估工具与法官决策的交互关系。
AI.method: 采用综合性文献综述方法，整合计算机科学、经济学、法学、犯罪学和心理学等多个领域的研究成果，聚焦于刑事司法风险评估这一具体案例，分析AI工具性能、人类法官决策以及人机交互三个相互关联的方面。
AI.result: 现有实证证据表明，AI决策辅助工具对审前和量刑决策的影响有限甚至不存在。研究揭示了AI风险评估工具的预测有效性评估进展、司法决策偏见的记录，以及法官使用算法建议的有限研究。同时发现了文献中的重要空白。
AI.conclusion: AI与人类决策的比较研究有助于深入理解算法工具和人类决策者。未来需要更多研究来评估AI风险评估工具的性能，理解法官在嘈杂决策环境中的行为，以及个体特征如何影响法官对AI建议的反应。提倡跨学科整合与交叉研究。

title: Serendipity by Design: Evaluating the Impact of Cross-domain Mappings on Human and LLM Creativity
summary: Are large language models (LLMs) creative in the same way humans are, and can the same interventions increase creativity in both? We evaluate a promising but largely untested intervention for creativity: forcing creators to draw an analogy from a random, remote source domain (''cross-domain mapping''). Human participants and LLMs generated novel features for ten daily products (e.g., backpack, TV) under two prompts: (i) cross-domain mapping, which required translating a property from a randomly assigned source (e.g., octopus, cactus, GPS), and (ii) user-need, which required proposing innovations targeting unmet user needs. We show that humans reliably benefit from randomly assigned cross-domain mappings, while LLMs, on average, generate more original ideas than humans and do not show a statistically significant effect of cross-domain mappings. However, in both systems, the impact of cross-domain mapping increases when the inspiration source becomes more semantically distant from the target. Our results highlight both the role of remote association in creative ideation and systematic differences in how humans and LLMs respond to the same intervention for creativity.

AI.tldr: 研究比较人类与大型语言模型在创造力方面的差异，测试跨领域映射干预对两者创意生成的影响。人类从随机远程领域类比中受益，而LLMs整体创意更原创但对跨领域映射干预不敏感，不过两者都随语义距离增加而效果增强。
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型是否与人类具有相似的创造力机制，以及相同的干预措施（跨领域映射）是否对两者都能提升创造力。通过比较人类和LLMs对相同创造力干预的反应，揭示两者在创造性思维方面的系统性差异。
AI.method: 让人类参与者和LLMs为10种日常产品生成新功能，使用两种提示：(1)跨领域映射：要求从随机分配的远程源领域（如章鱼、仙人掌、GPS）翻译属性；(2)用户需求：针对未满足的用户需求提出创新。比较两种干预下的创意原创性。
AI.result: 人类可靠地从随机跨领域映射中受益，而LLMs平均生成比人类更原创的想法，但对跨领域映射干预没有统计学显著效果。在两种系统中，当灵感源与目标的语义距离增加时，跨领域映射的影响都会增强。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了远程关联在创意构思中的作用，以及人类和LLMs对相同创造力干预的系统性差异。LLMs虽然能生成原创想法，但其创造力机制与人类不同，对跨领域映射干预的反应模式存在差异。

title: 6Bit-Diffusion: Inference-Time Mixed-Precision Quantization for Video Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion transformers have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in generating videos. However, their practical deployment is severely constrained by high memory usage and computational cost. Post-Training Quantization provides a practical way to reduce memory usage and boost computation speed. Existing quantization methods typically apply a static bit-width allocation, overlooking the quantization difficulty of activations across diffusion timesteps, leading to a suboptimal trade-off between efficiency and quality. In this paper, we propose a inference time NVFP4/INT8 Mixed-Precision Quantization framework. We find a strong linear correlation between a block's input-output difference and the quantization sensitivity of its internal linear layers. Based on this insight, we design a lightweight predictor that dynamically allocates NVFP4 to temporally stable layers to maximize memory compression, while selectively preserving INT8 for volatile layers to ensure robustness. This adaptive precision strategy enables aggressive quantization without compromising generation quality. Beside this, we observe that the residual between the input and output of a Transformer block exhibits high temporal consistency across timesteps. Leveraging this temporal redundancy, we introduce Temporal Delta Cache (TDC) to skip computations for these invariant blocks, further reducing the computational cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves 1.92$\times$ end-to-end acceleration and 3.32$\times$ memory reduction, setting a new baseline for efficient inference in Video DiTs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对视频扩散变换器的推理时混合精度量化框架，通过动态分配NVFP4/INT8精度和引入时间增量缓存，实现了1.92倍端到端加速和3.32倍内存减少。
AI.motivation: 扩散变换器在视频生成方面表现出色，但实际部署受到高内存使用和计算成本限制。现有量化方法通常采用静态位宽分配，忽略了不同扩散时间步中激活量化的难度，导致效率与质量之间的权衡不够优化。
AI.method: 提出推理时NVFP4/INT8混合精度量化框架：1）发现模块输入输出差异与其内部线性层量化敏感度存在强线性相关性；2）设计轻量级预测器动态分配NVFP4给时间稳定层以最大化内存压缩，选择性保留INT8给易变层确保鲁棒性；3）利用Transformer块输入输出残差的时间一致性，引入时间增量缓存跳过不变块的计算。
AI.result: 实验证明该方法实现了1.92倍的端到端加速和3.32倍的内存减少，为视频扩散变换器的高效推理设立了新的基准。
AI.conclusion: 提出的自适应精度策略和时间增量缓存机制能够在不影响生成质量的前提下实现激进的量化，显著提升了视频扩散变换器的推理效率。

title: SAVeS: Steering Safety Judgments in Vision-Language Models via Semantic Cues
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world and embodied settings where safety decisions depend on visual context. However, it remains unclear which visual evidence drives these judgments. We study whether multimodal safety behavior in VLMs can be steered by simple semantic cues. We introduce a semantic steering framework that applies controlled textual, visual, and cognitive interventions without changing the underlying scene content. To evaluate these effects, we propose SAVeS, a benchmark for situational safety under semantic cues, together with an evaluation protocol that separates behavioral refusal, grounded safety reasoning, and false refusals. Experiments across multiple VLMs and an additional state-of-the-art benchmark show that safety decisions are highly sensitive to semantic cues, indicating reliance on learned visual-linguistic associations rather than grounded visual understanding. We further demonstrate that automated steering pipelines can exploit these mechanisms, highlighting a potential vulnerability in multimodal safety systems.

AI.tldr: 研究发现视觉语言模型的安全决策高度依赖语义线索而非真实的视觉理解，存在被操控的脆弱性
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多地部署在现实世界和具身环境中，安全决策依赖于视觉上下文，但尚不清楚哪些视觉证据驱动这些判断。研究者希望探究多模态安全行为是否可以通过简单的语义线索被操控。
AI.method: 提出了语义引导框架，在不改变底层场景内容的情况下应用受控的文本、视觉和认知干预。创建了SAVeS基准测试，用于评估语义线索下的情境安全，并设计了评估协议来区分行为拒绝、基于事实的安全推理和错误拒绝。
AI.result: 实验表明，多个视觉语言模型的安全决策对语义线索高度敏感，表明模型依赖学习的视觉-语言关联而非基于事实的视觉理解。进一步证明自动化引导管道可以利用这些机制。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的多模态安全系统存在潜在脆弱性，安全决策容易被语义线索操控，这揭示了模型缺乏真正的视觉理解能力。

title: How Uncertainty Estimation Scales with Sampling in Reasoning Models
summary:
Uncertainty estimation is critical for deploying reasoning language models, yet remains poorly understood under extended chain-of-thought reasoning. We study parallel sampling as a fully black-box approach using verbalized confidence and self-consistency. Across three reasoning models and 17 tasks spanning mathematics, STEM, and humanities, we characterize how these signals scale.
  Both self-consistency and verbalized confidence scale in reasoning models, but self-consistency exhibits lower initial discrimination and lags behind verbalized confidence under moderate sampling. Most uncertainty gains, however, arise from signal combination: with just two samples, a hybrid estimator improves AUROC by up to $+12$ on average and already outperforms either signal alone even when scaled to much larger budgets, after which returns diminish. These effects are domain-dependent: in mathematics, the native domain of RLVR-style post-training, reasoning models achieve higher uncertainty quality and exhibit both stronger complementarity and faster scaling than in STEM or humanities.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了在扩展思维链推理中不确定性估计的方法，通过并行采样结合口头置信度和自一致性两种信号，发现在不同领域（数学、STEM、人文）中，信号组合能显著提升不确定性估计质量。
AI.motivation: 不确定性估计对于部署推理语言模型至关重要，但在扩展思维链推理中的表现仍不明确。作者旨在研究并行采样作为完全黑盒方法，使用口头置信度和自一致性信号来评估不确定性估计的效果。
AI.method: 采用并行采样作为完全黑盒方法，结合口头置信度和自一致性两种不确定性信号。在三个推理模型和17个任务上进行实验，涵盖数学、STEM和人文领域，分析这些信号的扩展特性。
AI.result: 自一致性和口头置信度在推理模型中都能扩展，但自一致性初始区分度较低，在中等采样下落后于口头置信度。信号组合带来最大收益：仅用两个样本，混合估计器平均提升AUROC高达+12分，即使扩展到更大预算也优于单独信号。效果具有领域依赖性：在数学领域（RLVR风格后训练的本土领域），推理模型获得更高的不确定性质量，表现出更强的互补性和更快的扩展速度。
AI.conclusion: 在扩展思维链推理中，结合口头置信度和自一致性信号能显著提升不确定性估计质量，特别是在数学领域效果最佳。信号组合在少量样本下就能实现显著改进，而单独扩展任一信号的效果有限。

title: Implicit Patterns in LLM-Based Binary Analysis
summary: Binary vulnerability analysis is increasingly performed by LLM-based agents in an iterative, multi-pass manner, with the model as the core decision-maker. However, how such systems organize exploration over hundreds of reasoning steps remains poorly understood, due to limited context windows and implicit token-level behaviors. We present the first large-scale, trace-level study showing that multi-pass LLM reasoning gives rise to structured, token-level implicit patterns. Analyzing 521 binaries with 99,563 reasoning steps, we identify four dominant patterns: early pruning, path-dependent lock-in, targeted backtracking, and knowledge-guided prioritization that emerge implicitly from reasoning traces. These token-level implicit patterns serve as an abstraction of LLM reasoning: instead of explicit control-flow or predefined heuristics, exploration is organized through implicit decisions regulating path selection, commitment, and revision. Our analysis shows these patterns form a stable, structured system with distinct temporal roles and measurable characteristics. Our results provide the first systematic characterization of LLM-driven binary analysis and a foundation for more reliable analysis systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次大规模追踪分析了LLM在多轮推理中的隐式模式，发现了四种主导模式，为理解LLM驱动的二进制漏洞分析提供了系统性框架。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的二进制漏洞分析系统以模型为核心决策者进行迭代式多轮推理，但对其如何组织数百个推理步骤的探索过程缺乏理解，主要受限于有限的上下文窗口和隐式的token级行为。
AI.method: 研究分析了521个二进制文件和99,563个推理步骤，通过追踪级别的分析识别LLM在多轮推理中产生的结构化、token级隐式模式。
AI.result: 识别出四种主导的隐式模式：早期剪枝、路径依赖锁定、针对性回溯和知识引导优先级排序。这些模式形成了稳定的结构化系统，具有不同的时间角色和可测量特征。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次系统性地表征了LLM驱动的二进制分析，为构建更可靠的分析系统奠定了基础，揭示了LLM推理通过隐式决策而非显式控制流或预定义启发式来组织探索过程。

title: ProCal: Probability Calibration for Neighborhood-Guided Source-Free Domain Adaptation
summary: Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) adapts pre-trained models to unlabeled target domains without requiring access to source data. Although state-of-the-art methods leveraging local neighborhood structures show promise for SFDA, they tend to over-rely on prediction similarity among neighbors. This over-reliance accelerates the forgetting of source knowledge and increases susceptibility to local noise overfitting. To address these issues, we introduce ProCal, a probability calibration method that dynamically calibrates neighborhood-based predictions through a dual-model collaborative prediction mechanism. ProCal integrates the source model's initial predictions with the current model's online outputs to effectively calibrate neighbor probabilities. This strategy not only mitigates the interference of local noise but also preserves the discriminative information from the source model, thereby achieving a balance between knowledge retention and domain adaptation. Furthermore, we design a joint optimization objective that combines a soft supervision loss with a diversity loss to guide the target model. Our theoretical analysis shows that ProCal converges to an equilibrium where source knowledge and target information are effectively fused, reducing both knowledge forgetting and overfitting. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments on 31 cross-domain tasks across four public datasets. Our code is available at: https://github.com/zhengyinghit/ProCal.

AI.tldr: ProCal是一种概率校准方法，通过双模型协作预测机制动态校准基于邻域的预测，解决SFDA中过度依赖邻域预测相似性导致源知识遗忘和局部噪声过拟合的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的无源域自适应方法过度依赖邻域预测相似性，这会加速源知识的遗忘并增加对局部噪声过拟合的敏感性，需要一种平衡知识保留和域适应的方法。
AI.method: 提出ProCal概率校准方法，通过双模型协作预测机制动态校准邻域预测，结合源模型的初始预测和当前模型的在线输出来校准邻居概率，并设计结合软监督损失和多样性损失的联合优化目标。
AI.result: 在四个公共数据集的31个跨域任务上进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。理论分析表明ProCal收敛到源知识和目标信息有效融合的均衡状态。
AI.conclusion: ProCal通过概率校准机制有效缓解局部噪声干扰，保留源模型的判别信息，在知识保留和域适应之间取得平衡，减少了知识遗忘和过拟合问题。

title: Box Maze: A Process-Control Architecture for Reliable LLM Reasoning
comment: 10 pages, 5 tables, 0 figures. Conceptual architecture with preliminary simulation-based validation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generative capabilities but remain vulnerable to hallucination and unreliable reasoning under adversarial prompting. Existing safety approaches -- such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and output filtering -- primarily operate at the behavioral level and may lack explicit architectural mechanisms for enforcing reasoning process integrity.
  This paper proposes the Box Maze framework, a conceptual process-control architecture that decomposes LLM reasoning into three explicit layers: memory grounding, structured inference, and boundary enforcement. We introduce preliminary simulation-based evaluation involving progressive boundary erosion scenarios across multiple heterogeneous LLM systems (DeepSeek-V3, Doubao, Qwen). Results from n=50 adversarial scenarios suggest that explicit cognitive control layers may improve consistency in boundary maintenance, with architectural constraints reducing boundary failure rates from approximately 40% (baseline RLHF) to below 1% under adversarial conditions.
  While current validation is simulation-based, these preliminary results indicate that process-level control may offer a promising direction for improving reliability in large language model reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了Box Maze框架，一种三层认知控制架构，通过显式的过程控制来增强大语言模型的推理可靠性，减少对抗性提示下的幻觉和边界违规。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然具有强大的生成能力，但在对抗性提示下容易产生幻觉和不可靠的推理。现有的安全方法（如RLHF和输出过滤）主要在行为层面操作，缺乏确保推理过程完整性的显式架构机制。
AI.method: 提出了Box Maze框架，将LLM推理分解为三个显式层次：记忆基础化、结构化推理和边界执行。该架构通过过程控制来确保推理完整性，并在多个异构LLM系统（DeepSeek-V3、Doubao、Qwen）上进行了模拟评估。
AI.result: 在n=50个对抗性场景的初步模拟评估中，显式认知控制层提高了边界维护的一致性。架构约束将边界失败率从基线RLHF的约40%降低到对抗条件下低于1%。
AI.conclusion: 虽然当前验证是基于模拟的，但初步结果表明，过程级控制可能为提高大语言模型推理的可靠性提供了一个有前景的方向。Box Maze框架展示了显式认知控制层在增强LLM推理完整性方面的潜力。

title: D5P4: Partition Determinantal Point Process for Diversity in Parallel Discrete Diffusion Decoding
summary: Discrete diffusion models are promising alternatives to autoregressive approaches for text generation, yet their decoding methods remain under-studied. Standard decoding methods for autoregressive models, such as beam search, do not directly apply to iterative denoising, and existing diffusion decoding techniques provide limited control over in-batch diversity. To bridge this gap, we introduce a generalized beam-search framework for discrete diffusion that generates candidates in parallel and supports modular beam-selection objectives. As a diversity-focused instantiation, we propose D5P4, which formulates the selection step as MAP inference over a Determinantal Point Process. Leveraging a scalable greedy solver, D5P4 maintains multi-GPU compatibility and enables an explicit trade-off between model probability and target diversity with near-zero compute overhead. Experiments on free-form generation and question answering demonstrate that D5P4 improves diversity over strong baselines while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于离散扩散模型的广义束搜索框架D5P4，通过基于行列式点过程的候选选择机制，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升批次内多样性。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型是文本生成中自回归模型的有前景替代方案，但其解码方法研究不足。标准的自回归解码方法（如束搜索）不适用于迭代去噪过程，现有扩散解码技术对批次内多样性的控制有限。
AI.method: 提出广义束搜索框架，支持并行生成候选序列和模块化束选择目标。具体实现D5P4将选择步骤建模为行列式点过程的MAP推断，采用可扩展的贪心求解器，保持多GPU兼容性，在几乎零计算开销下实现模型概率与目标多样性的显式权衡。
AI.result: 在自由文本生成和问答任务上的实验表明，D5P4在保持竞争力的生成质量的同时，相比强基线显著提升了多样性。
AI.conclusion: D5P4为离散扩散模型提供了一种有效的解码框架，通过行列式点过程的选择机制实现了生成质量与多样性的平衡，填补了该领域解码方法研究的空白。

title: SEAR: Simple and Efficient Adaptation of Visual Geometric Transformers for RGB+Thermal 3D Reconstruction
summary: Foundational feed-forward visual geometry models enable accurate and efficient camera pose estimation and scene reconstruction by learning strong scene priors from massive RGB datasets. However, their effectiveness drops when applied to mixed sensing modalities, such as RGB-thermal (RGB-T) images. We observe that while a visual geometry grounded transformer pretrained on RGB data generalizes well to thermal-only reconstruction, it struggles to align RGB and thermal modalities when processed jointly. To address this, we propose SEAR, a simple yet efficient fine-tuning strategy that adapts a pretrained geometry transformer to multimodal RGB-T inputs. Despite being trained on a relatively small RGB-T dataset, our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods for 3D reconstruction and camera pose estimation, achieving significant improvements over all metrics (e.g., over 29\% in AUC@30) and delivering higher detail and consistency between modalities with negligible overhead in inference time compared to the original pretrained model. Notably, SEAR enables reliable multimodal pose estimation and reconstruction even under challenging conditions, such as low lighting and dense smoke. We validate our architecture through extensive ablation studies, demonstrating how the model aligns both modalities. Additionally, we introduce a new dataset featuring RGB and thermal sequences captured at different times, viewpoints, and illumination conditions, providing a robust benchmark for future work in multimodal 3D scene reconstruction. Code and models are publicly available at https://www.github.com/Schindler-EPFL-Lab/SEAR.

AI.tldr: SEAR是一种简单高效的微调策略，用于将预训练的视觉几何变换器适配到RGB-热成像多模态输入，显著提升3D重建和相机姿态估计性能
AI.motivation: 现有的基础前馈视觉几何模型在RGB数据上表现良好，但在处理RGB-热成像等多模态传感数据时效果下降，特别是在对齐不同模态方面存在困难
AI.method: 提出SEAR微调策略，在相对较小的RGB-T数据集上微调预训练的几何变换器，使其能够有效处理多模态RGB-T输入，对齐不同模态信息
AI.result: 在所有指标上显著优于现有方法（如AUC@30提升超过29%），在低光照和浓烟等挑战性条件下仍能可靠工作，推理时间开销可忽略不计
AI.conclusion: SEAR成功将预训练几何模型适配到多模态RGB-T输入，实现了高质量的3D场景重建和相机姿态估计，并提供了新的RGB-T数据集作为未来研究的基准

title: cuGenOpt: A GPU-Accelerated General-Purpose Metaheuristic Framework for Combinatorial Optimization
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures. Code available at https://github.com/L-yang-yang/cugenopt
summary:
Combinatorial optimization problems arise in logistics, scheduling, and resource allocation, yet existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off among generality, performance, and usability. We present cuGenOpt, a GPU-accelerated general-purpose metaheuristic framework that addresses all three dimensions simultaneously.
  At the engine level, cuGenOpt adopts a "one block evolves one solution" CUDA architecture with a unified encoding abstraction (permutation, binary, integer), a two-level adaptive operator selection mechanism, and hardware-aware resource management. At the extensibility level, a user-defined operator registration interface allows domain experts to inject problem-specific CUDA search operators. At the usability level, a JIT compilation pipeline exposes the framework as a pure-Python API, and an LLM-based modeling assistant converts natural-language problem descriptions into executable solver code.
  Experiments across five thematic suites on three GPU architectures (T4, V100, A800) show that cuGenOpt outperforms general MIP solvers by orders of magnitude, achieves competitive quality against specialized solvers on instances up to n=150, and attains 4.73% gap on TSP-442 within 30s. Twelve problem types spanning five encoding variants are solved to optimality. Framework-level optimizations cumulatively reduce pcb442 gap from 36% to 4.73% and boost VRPTW throughput by 75-81%.
  Code: https://github.com/L-yang-yang/cugenopt

AI.tldr: cuGenOpt是一个GPU加速的通用元启发式框架，通过CUDA架构、自适应算子选择和硬件感知资源管理，在通用性、性能和易用性三个维度上取得平衡，显著优于传统MIP求解器。
AI.motivation: 组合优化问题在物流、调度和资源分配中普遍存在，但现有方法在通用性、性能和易用性之间存在根本性权衡。需要一种能同时解决这三个维度的方法。
AI.method: 采用"一个块演化一个解"的CUDA架构，包含统一编码抽象（排列、二进制、整数）、两级自适应算子选择机制和硬件感知资源管理。提供用户自定义算子注册接口，支持JIT编译的纯Python API，以及基于LLM的自然语言问题描述转换功能。
AI.result: 在三种GPU架构（T4、V100、A800）上测试五个主题套件，cuGenOpt比通用MIP求解器快几个数量级，在n=150实例上与专用求解器质量相当，TSP-442在30秒内达到4.73%差距。12种问题类型跨越5种编码变体达到最优解。框架级优化将pcb442差距从36%降至4.73%，VRPTW吞吐量提升75-81%。
AI.conclusion: cuGenOpt成功解决了组合优化中通用性、性能和易用性的权衡问题，通过GPU加速和智能框架设计，为广泛的实际应用提供了高效的解决方案。

title: OS-Themis: A Scalable Critic Framework for Generalist GUI Rewards
